private lemma Set.sumNcardLeOfDisjoint {α ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {S : Set α} (hS : S.Finite) (A : ι → Set α) (hsub : ∀ i, A i ⊆ S)
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (A i) (A j))) :
    ∑ i, (A i).ncard ≤ S.ncard := by
  classical

  let F (i : ι) := (hS.subset (hsub i)).toFinset
  have hFdisj : ((Finset.univ : Finset ι) : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint F := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hxi hxj
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj hij)
      ((hS.subset (hsub i)).mem_toFinset.mp hxi)
      ((hS.subset (hsub j)).mem_toFinset.mp hxj)
  have hFsub : Finset.univ.biUnion F ⊆ hS.toFinset := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hx
    exact hS.mem_toFinset.mpr (hsub i ((hS.subset (hsub i)).mem_toFinset.mp hxi))
  calc
    ∑ i, (A i).ncard = ∑ i, (F i).card := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card (A i) (hS.subset (hsub i))
    _ = (Finset.univ.biUnion F).card := (Finset.card_biUnion hFdisj).symm
    _ ≤ hS.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card hFsub
    _ = S.ncard := (Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card S hS).symm


private lemma Set.sumNcardEqOfDisjoint {α ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {S : Set α} (hS : S.Finite) (A : ι → Set α) (hsub : ∀ i, A i ⊆ S)
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (A i) (A j)))
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ i, x ∈ A i) : ∑ i, (A i).ncard = S.ncard := by
  classical

  let F (i : ι) := (hS.subset (hsub i)).toFinset
  have hFdisj : ((Finset.univ : Finset ι) : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint F := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hxi hxj
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj hij)
      ((hS.subset (hsub i)).mem_toFinset.mp hxi)
      ((hS.subset (hsub j)).mem_toFinset.mp hxj)
  have hunion : Finset.univ.biUnion F = hS.toFinset := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hx
      exact hS.mem_toFinset.mpr (hsub i ((hS.subset (hsub i)).mem_toFinset.mp hxi))
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hcover x (hS.mem_toFinset.mp hx)
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
        ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, (hS.subset (hsub i)).mem_toFinset.mpr hxi⟩
  calc
    ∑ i, (A i).ncard = ∑ i, (F i).card := by
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card (A i) (hS.subset (hsub i)))
    _ = (Finset.univ.biUnion F).card := (Finset.card_biUnion hFdisj).symm
    _ = S.ncard := by rw [hunion, ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card S hS]

namespace Graph

variable {V : Type u} {E : Type v} {G H : Graph V E}


private def partitionLink (H : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet)
    (e : E) (A B : P.parts) : Prop :=
  ∃ x ∈ A.val, ∃ y ∈ B.val, H.IsLink e x y


private lemma partitionLinkSymm {P : Partition G.vertexSet} {e : E} {A B : P.parts}
    (h : partitionLink H P e A B) : partitionLink H P e B A := by

  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := h
  exact ⟨y, hy, x, hx, hxy.symm⟩


private lemma partitionLinkUnique {P : Partition G.vertexSet} {e : E}
    {A B C D : P.parts} (h : partitionLink H P e A B)
    (h' : partitionLink H P e C D) : s(A, B) = s(C, D) := by

  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨z, hz, w, hw, hzw⟩ := h'
  rcases hxy.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hzw with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inl
      ⟨Subtype.ext (P.eq_of_mem_of_mem A.property C.property hx hz),
        Subtype.ext (P.eq_of_mem_of_mem B.property D.property hy hw)⟩)
  · exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inr
      ⟨Subtype.ext (P.eq_of_mem_of_mem A.property D.property hx hw),
        Subtype.ext (P.eq_of_mem_of_mem B.property C.property hy hz)⟩)


private def partitionGraph (H : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) :
    SimpleGraph P.parts :=
  .fromRel (fun A B ↦ ∃ e, partitionLink H P e A B)


private lemma partitionGraphAdj (P : Partition G.vertexSet) (A B : P.parts) :
    (partitionGraph H P).Adj A B ↔ A ≠ B ∧ ∃ e, partitionLink H P e A B := by

  rw [partitionGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨hne, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
      exact ⟨hne, e, partitionLinkSymm he⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, h⟩
    exact ⟨hne, Or.inl h⟩


private lemma partitionLinkCross {P : Partition G.vertexSet} (hHG : H ≤ G)
    {e : E} {A B : P.parts} (hne : A ≠ B) (h : partitionLink H P e A B) :
    e ∈ H.edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P := by

  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hxy.edge_mem, x, y, hHG.isLink_mono hxy, ?_⟩
  intro hrel
  apply hne
  exact Subtype.ext (P.eq_of_mem_of_mem A.property B.property hx
    ((hrel.forall B.property).mpr hy))


private lemma partitionGraphReachable {P : Partition G.vertexSet}
    (hHG : H ≤ G) {x y : V} (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen H.Adj x y) :
    ∀ (A B : P.parts), x ∈ A.val → y ∈ B.val →
      (partitionGraph H P).Reachable A B := by

  induction hxy with
  | refl =>
    intro A B hx hy
    have hab : A = B := Subtype.ext
      (P.eq_of_mem_of_mem A.property B.property hx hy)
    subst B
    exact .rfl
  | @tail y z hpath hyz ih =>
    intro A B hx hz
    have hy : y ∈ G.vertexSet := hHG.vertexSet_mono hyz.left_mem
    let C : P.parts := ⟨P.partOf y, P.partOf_mem hy⟩
    have hAC := ih A C hx (P.mem_partOf hy)
    by_cases hCB : C = B
    · exact hCB ▸ hAC
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hyz
      exact hAC.trans ((partitionGraphAdj P C B).mpr
        ⟨hCB, e, y, P.mem_partOf hy, z, hz, he⟩).reachable


private lemma partitionGraphConnected (hHG : H.IsSpanningSubgraph G)
    (hH : H.IsTree) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) :
    (partitionGraph H P).Connected := by

  refine (SimpleGraph.connected_iff _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro A B
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := P.nonempty_of_mem A.property
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := P.nonempty_of_mem B.property
    have hxH : x ∈ H.vertexSet := hHG.vertexSet_eq.symm ▸ P.subset_of_mem A.property hx
    have hyH : y ∈ H.vertexSet := hHG.vertexSet_eq.symm ▸ P.subset_of_mem B.property hy
    exact partitionGraphReachable hHG.le (hH.connected x hxH y hyH) A B hx hy
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hH.vertexSet_nonempty
    have hxG : x ∈ G.vertexSet := hHG.vertexSet_eq ▸ hx
    exact ⟨⟨P.partOf x, P.partOf_mem hxG⟩⟩


private lemma partitionGraphEdgeWitness (hHG : H ≤ G) (P : Partition G.vertexSet)
    (a : Sym2 P.parts) (ha : a ∈ (partitionGraph H P).edgeSet) :
    ∃ e, e ∈ H.edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P ∧
      ∃ A B, a = s(A, B) ∧ partitionLink H P e A B := by

  induction a using Sym2.inductionOn with
  | _ A B =>
    obtain ⟨hne, e, he⟩ := (partitionGraphAdj P A B).mp ha
    exact ⟨e, partitionLinkCross hHG hne he, A, B, rfl, he⟩


private lemma partitionGraphEdgeCount (hHG : H ≤ G) (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (P : Partition G.vertexSet) :
    Nat.card (partitionGraph H P).edgeSet ≤ (H.edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P).ncard := by
  classical

  choose f hf hends using fun a : (partitionGraph H P).edgeSet ↦
    partitionGraphEdgeWitness hHG P a.val a.property
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun a ↦ (⟨f a, hf a⟩ : ↥(H.edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P))) := by
    intro a b hab
    have he : f a = f b := congrArg Subtype.val hab
    obtain ⟨A, B, ha, hA⟩ := hends a
    obtain ⟨C, D, hb, hC⟩ := hends b
    rw [he] at hA
    exact Subtype.ext (ha.trans ((partitionLinkUnique hA hC).trans hb.symm))
  have hfinite : (H.edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P).Finite :=
    h_edges.subset (fun _ he ↦ hHG.edgeSet_mono he.1)
  exact @Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ _ hfinite.to_subtype
    (fun a ↦ (⟨f a, hf a⟩ : ↥(H.edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P))) hinj


private lemma crossEdgesLowerBoundOfTree (hHG : H.IsSpanningSubgraph G)
    (hH : H.IsTree) (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) :
    P.parts.ncard - 1 ≤ (H.edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P).ncard := by

  have hconn := (partitionGraphConnected hHG hH P).card_vert_le_card_edgeSet_add_one
  have hcount := partitionGraphEdgeCount hHG.le h_edges P
  exact Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr (hconn.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hcount 1))


private def componentSet (H : Graph V E) (x : V) : Set V :=
  {y | y ∈ H.vertexSet ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen H.Adj x y}


private lemma componentSetEq {x y : V} (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen H.Adj x y) :
    componentSet H x = componentSet H y := by

  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, hxz⟩
    exact ⟨hz, (_root_.symm hxy).trans hxz⟩
  · rintro ⟨hz, hyz⟩
    exact ⟨hz, hxy.trans hyz⟩


private lemma componentSetsIndependent (H : Graph V E) :
    sSupIndep (componentSet H '' H.vertexSet) := by

  apply Set.PairwiseDisjoint.sSupIndep
  rintro A ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ B ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ hne
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hxz hyz
  exact hne (componentSetEq (hxz.2.trans (_root_.symm hyz.2)))


private lemma emptyNotComponentSet (H : Graph V E) :
    (⊥ : Set V) ∉ componentSet H '' H.vertexSet := by

  rintro ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
  have hself : x ∈ componentSet H x := ⟨hx, .refl⟩
  rw [heq] at hself
  exact hself


private lemma componentSetsUnion (H : Graph V E) :
    sSup (componentSet H '' H.vertexSet) = H.vertexSet := by

  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hx⟩
    exact hx.1
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨componentSet H x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hx, .refl⟩


private def componentPartition (H : Graph V E) : Partition H.vertexSet :=
  { parts := componentSet H '' H.vertexSet
    sSupIndep' := componentSetsIndependent H
    bot_notMem' := emptyNotComponentSet H
    sSup_eq' := componentSetsUnion H }


private lemma componentPartitionRel (H : Graph V E) (x y : V) :
    (componentPartition H).Rel x y ↔
      x ∈ H.vertexSet ∧ y ∈ H.vertexSet ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen H.Adj x y := by

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, hx, hy⟩
    exact ⟨hx.1, hy.1, (_root_.symm hx.2).trans hy.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨componentSet H x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ⟨hx, .refl⟩, hy, hxy⟩


private lemma componentPartitionFinite (h_vertices : H.vertexSet.Finite) :
    (componentPartition H).parts.Finite := by

  exact h_vertices.image (componentSet H)


private lemma componentPartitionRestrictRel (H : Graph V E) (F : Set E) (x y : V) :
    (componentPartition (H.restrict F)).Rel x y ↔
      x ∈ H.vertexSet ∧ y ∈ H.vertexSet ∧
        Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b ↦ ∃ e ∈ F, H.IsLink e a b) x y := by

  exact componentPartitionRel (H.restrict F) x y


private def IsForest (H : Graph V E) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ H.edgeSet, ∃ x y, H.IsLink e x y ∧
    ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b ↦ ∃ f, f ≠ e ∧ H.IsLink f a b) x y


private lemma IsForest.ofLE (hH : IsForest H) (hGH : G ≤ H) : IsForest G := by

  intro e he
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hn⟩ := hH e (hGH.edgeSet_mono he)
  refine ⟨x, y, (hGH.isLink_iff he).mpr hxy, ?_⟩
  intro hpath
  apply hn
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.mono
    (fun _ _ ⟨f, hf, hlink⟩ ↦ ⟨f, hf, hGH.isLink_mono hlink⟩) _ _ hpath


private lemma IsForest.restrict (hH : IsForest H) (F : Set E) :
    IsForest (H.restrict F) := by

  exact hH.ofLE restrict_le


private lemma IsForest.linkNe (hH : IsForest H) {e : E} {x y : V}
    (hxy : H.IsLink e x y) : x ≠ y := by

  intro heq
  subst y
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hn⟩ := hH e hxy.edge_mem
  rcases hxy.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hab with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact hn .refl
  · exact hn .refl


private lemma IsForest.linkUnique (hH : IsForest H) {e f : E} {x y : V}
    (he : H.IsLink e x y) (hf : H.IsLink f x y) : e = f := by

  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hn⟩ := hH e he.edge_mem
  rcases he.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hab with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact hn (.single ⟨f, Ne.symm hne, hf⟩)
  · exact hn (.single ⟨f, Ne.symm hne, hf.symm⟩)


private lemma restrictAdjInsert {e : E} {a b x y : V} (he : H.IsLink e a b)
    (F : Set E) :
    (H.restrict (insert e F)).Adj x y ↔
      (H.restrict F).Adj x y ∨ (x = a ∧ y = b) ∨ (x = b ∧ y = a) := by

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hxy⟩
    rcases hf with rfl | hf
    · exact Or.inr (hxy.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq he)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨f, hf, hxy⟩
  · rintro (⟨f, hf, hxy⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨f, Set.mem_insert_of_mem e hf, hxy⟩
    · exact ⟨e, Set.mem_insert e F, he⟩
    · exact ⟨e, Set.mem_insert e F, he.symm⟩


private lemma restrictReachableInsert {e : E} {a b x y : V} (he : H.IsLink e a b)
    (F : Set E) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict (insert e F)).Adj x y ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x y ∨
      (Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x a ∧
        Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj b y) ∨
      (Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x b ∧
        Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj a y) := by

  constructor
  · intro hpath
    induction hpath with
    | refl => exact Or.inl .refl
    | @tail y z hpath hyz ih =>
      rcases (restrictAdjInsert he F).mp hyz with hold | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rcases ih with hxy | ⟨hxa, hby⟩ | ⟨hxb, hay⟩
        · exact Or.inl (hxy.tail hold)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hxa, hby.tail hold⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hxb, hay.tail hold⟩)
      · rcases ih with hxa | ⟨hxa, hba⟩ | ⟨hxb, haa⟩
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hxa, .refl⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hxa, .refl⟩)
        · exact Or.inl hxb
      · rcases ih with hxb | ⟨hxa, hbb⟩ | ⟨hxb, hab⟩
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hxb, .refl⟩)
        · exact Or.inl hxa
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hxb, .refl⟩)
  · have hmono : ∀ {u v}, Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj u v →
        Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict (insert e F)).Adj u v :=
      fun h ↦ Relation.ReflTransGen.mono
        (fun _ _ huv ↦ (restrictAdjInsert he F).mpr (Or.inl huv)) _ _ h
    rintro (hxy | ⟨hxa, hby⟩ | ⟨hxb, hay⟩)
    · exact hmono hxy
    · exact (hmono hxa).trans (.head ⟨e, Set.mem_insert e F, he⟩ (hmono hby))
    · exact (hmono hxb).trans (.head ⟨e, Set.mem_insert e F, he.symm⟩ (hmono hay))


private lemma IsForest.notReachableWithoutEdge (hH : IsForest H) {e : E} {a b : V}
    (he : H.IsLink e a b) {F : Set E} (hne : e ∉ F) :
    ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj a b := by

  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hn⟩ := hH e he.edge_mem
  have havoid : ∀ {u v}, Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj u v →
      Relation.ReflTransGen (fun u v ↦ ∃ f, f ≠ e ∧ H.IsLink f u v) u v := by
    intro u v hpath
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.mono
      (fun _ _ ⟨f, hf, hlink⟩ ↦ ⟨f, fun hfe ↦ hne (hfe ▸ hf), hlink⟩) _ _ hpath
  intro hab
  rcases he.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hxy with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact hn (havoid hab)
  · exact hn (havoid (_root_.symm hab))


private lemma componentSetEqIff {x y : V} (_hx : x ∈ H.vertexSet)
    (hy : y ∈ H.vertexSet) :
    componentSet H x = componentSet H y ↔ Relation.ReflTransGen H.Adj x y := by

  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hself : y ∈ componentSet H y := ⟨hy, .refl⟩
    rw [← heq] at hself
    exact hself.2
  · exact componentSetEq


private lemma componentPartitionParts (H : Graph V E) :
    (componentPartition H).parts = componentSet H '' H.vertexSet := by

  rfl


private lemma componentSetInsertOfReachable {e : E} {a b x : V}
    (he : H.IsLink e a b) (F : Set E)
    (hxa : Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x a) :
    componentSet (H.restrict (insert e F)) x =
      componentSet (H.restrict F) a ∪ componentSet (H.restrict F) b := by

  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy, hxy⟩
    rcases (restrictReachableInsert he F).mp hxy with hxy | ⟨_, hby⟩ | ⟨_, hay⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, (_root_.symm hxa).trans hxy⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, hby⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hay⟩
  · rintro (⟨hy, hay⟩ | ⟨hy, hby⟩)
    · exact ⟨hy, (restrictReachableInsert he F).mpr (Or.inl (hxa.trans hay))⟩
    · exact ⟨hy, (restrictReachableInsert he F).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hxa, hby⟩))⟩


private lemma componentSetInsertUnchanged {e : E} {a b x : V}
    (he : H.IsLink e a b) (F : Set E)
    (hxa : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x a)
    (hxb : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x b) :
    componentSet (H.restrict (insert e F)) x = componentSet (H.restrict F) x := by

  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy, hxy⟩
    rcases (restrictReachableInsert he F).mp hxy with hxy | ⟨hxa', _⟩ | ⟨hxb', _⟩
    · exact ⟨hy, hxy⟩
    · exact (hxa hxa').elim
    · exact (hxb hxb').elim
  · rintro ⟨hy, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨hy, (restrictReachableInsert he F).mpr (Or.inl hxy)⟩


private lemma componentPartsInsert {e : E} {a b : V} (he : H.IsLink e a b)
    (F : Set E) :
    (componentPartition (H.restrict (insert e F))).parts =
      insert (componentSet (H.restrict F) a ∪ componentSet (H.restrict F) b)
        ((componentPartition (H.restrict F)).parts \
          {componentSet (H.restrict F) a, componentSet (H.restrict F) b}) := by
  classical

  ext C
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    by_cases hxa : Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x a
    · exact Or.inl (componentSetInsertOfReachable he F hxa)
    · by_cases hxb : Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x b
      · exact Or.inl ((componentSetInsertOfReachable he.symm F hxb).trans (Set.union_comm _ _))
      · rw [componentSetInsertUnchanged he F hxa hxb]
        refine Or.inr ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        intro hmem
        simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hmem
        rcases hmem with ha | hb
        · exact hxa ((componentSetEqIff (H := H.restrict F) hx he.left_mem).mp ha)
        · exact hxb ((componentSetEqIff (H := H.restrict F) hx he.right_mem).mp hb)
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hnot⟩)
    · exact ⟨a, he.left_mem, componentSetInsertOfReachable he F .refl⟩
    · have hxa : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x a := by
        intro hxa
        exact hnot (Or.inl (componentSetEq hxa))
      have hxb : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj x b := by
        intro hxb
        exact hnot (Or.inr (componentSetEq hxb))
      exact ⟨x, hx, componentSetInsertUnchanged he F hxa hxb⟩


private lemma componentCountInsert {e : E} {a b : V} (he : H.IsLink e a b)
    (F : Set E) (h_vertices : H.vertexSet.Finite)
    (hab : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (H.restrict F).Adj a b) :
    (componentPartition (H.restrict (insert e F))).parts.ncard + 1 =
      (componentPartition (H.restrict F)).parts.ncard := by
  classical

  let A := componentSet (H.restrict F) a
  let B := componentSet (H.restrict F) b
  let P := componentPartition (H.restrict F)
  have hA : A ∈ P.parts := ⟨a, he.left_mem, rfl⟩
  have hB : B ∈ P.parts := ⟨b, he.right_mem, rfl⟩
  have hne : A ≠ B := fun h ↦ hab ((componentSetEqIff (H := H.restrict F) he.left_mem he.right_mem).mp h)
  have hsub : {A, B} ⊆ P.parts := by
    rintro C (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hA
    · exact hB
  have hnew : A ∪ B ∉ P.parts \ {A, B} := by
    rintro ⟨hmem, _⟩
    have hrel : P.Rel a b := ⟨A ∪ B, hmem,
      Or.inl ⟨he.left_mem, .refl⟩, Or.inr ⟨he.right_mem, .refl⟩⟩
    exact hab ((componentPartitionRel (H.restrict F) a b).mp hrel).2.2
  have hfinite : P.parts.Finite := componentPartitionFinite h_vertices
  have hdiff := Set.ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset hsub hfinite
  rw [Set.ncard_pair hne] at hdiff
  rw [componentPartsInsert he F,
    Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hnew (hfinite.subset Set.sdiff_subset)]
  omega


private lemma componentSetRestrictEmpty {x : V} (hx : x ∈ H.vertexSet) :
    componentSet (H.restrict ∅) x = {x} := by

  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy, hpath⟩
    exact (Relation.reflTransGen_iff_eq (fun _ ⟨e, he, _⟩ ↦ he)).mp hpath
  · intro hy
    obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
    exact ⟨hx, .refl⟩


private lemma componentCountEmpty (H : Graph V E) :
    (componentPartition (H.restrict ∅)).parts.ncard = H.vertexSet.ncard := by

  have himage : componentSet (H.restrict ∅) '' H.vertexSet =
      (fun x : V ↦ ({x} : Set V)) '' H.vertexSet :=
    Set.image_congr (fun _ hx ↦ componentSetRestrictEmpty hx)
  rw [componentPartitionParts, vertexSet_restrict, himage]
  exact Set.singleton_injective.injOn.ncard_image


private lemma forestEdgeCount (hH : IsForest H) (h_vertices : H.vertexSet.Finite)
    (h_edges : H.edgeSet.Finite) :
    H.edgeSet.ncard + (componentPartition H).parts.ncard = H.vertexSet.ncard := by
  classical

  have rank : ∀ (F : Set E), F.Finite → F ⊆ H.edgeSet →
      F.ncard + (componentPartition (H.restrict F)).parts.ncard = H.vertexSet.ncard := by
    intro F hF
    induction F, hF using Set.Finite.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      intro _
      simp only [Set.ncard_empty, zero_add, componentCountEmpty]
    | @insert e F hne hF ih =>
      intro hsub
      obtain ⟨a, b, he⟩ := H.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet (hsub (Set.mem_insert e F))
      have hcount := componentCountInsert he F h_vertices (hH.notReachableWithoutEdge he hne)
      have hprevious := ih (fun f hf ↦ hsub (Set.mem_insert_of_mem e hf))
      rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem hne hF]
      omega
  have hfull := rank H.edgeSet h_edges Set.Subset.rfl
  rwa [restrict_self] at hfull


private lemma restrictReachableMono {F C : Set E} (hFC : F ⊆ C) {x y : V}
    (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj x y) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict C).Adj x y := by

  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.mono
    (fun _ _ h ↦ Graph.Adj.mono (G.restrict_mono_right hFC) h) _ _ hxy


private lemma forestNotReachableDelete {F : Set E} (hF : IsForest (G.restrict F))
    {e : E} {a b : V} (he : G.IsLink e a b) (heF : e ∈ F) :
    ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F \ {e})).Adj a b := by

  have hn := hF.notReachableWithoutEdge
    (⟨heF, he⟩ : (G.restrict F).IsLink e a b) (F := F \ {e})
    (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl)
  rwa [restrict_restrict, Set.inter_eq_right.mpr Set.sdiff_subset] at hn


private lemma forestPathEdgeEssential {F C : Set E} (hFsub : F ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hforest : IsForest (G.restrict F)) (hCF : C ⊆ F) {x y : V}
    (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict C).Adj x y) {e : E} (heC : e ∈ C)
    (hessential : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (C \ {e})).Adj x y) :
    ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F \ {e})).Adj x y := by

  obtain ⟨a, b, he⟩ := G.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet (hFsub (hCF heC))
  have hpath : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (insert e (C \ {e}))).Adj x y := by
    rwa [Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.insert_eq_of_mem heC]
  have hmono : C \ {e} ⊆ F \ {e} := Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left hCF
  intro havoid
  apply forestNotReachableDelete hforest he (hCF heC)
  rcases (restrictReachableInsert he (C \ {e})).mp hpath with hold | ⟨hxa, hby⟩ | ⟨hxb, hay⟩
  · exact (hessential hold).elim
  · exact (_root_.symm (restrictReachableMono hmono hxa)).trans
      (havoid.trans (_root_.symm (restrictReachableMono hmono hby)))
  · exact (restrictReachableMono hmono hay).trans
      ((_root_.symm havoid).trans (restrictReachableMono hmono hxb))


private def separatingEdges (G : Graph V E) (F : Set E) (x y : V) : Set E :=
  {e | e ∈ F ∧ ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F \ {e})).Adj x y}


private lemma separatingEdgesConnect {F : Set E} (hFsub : F ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hFfinite : F.Finite) (hforest : IsForest (G.restrict F)) {x y : V}
    (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj x y) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (separatingEdges G F x y)).Adj x y := by
  classical

  let S : Set (Set E) := {C | C ⊆ F ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict C).Adj x y}
  have hSfinite : S.Finite := hFfinite.powerset.subset (fun _ h ↦ h.1)
  obtain ⟨C, ⟨hCF, hCxy⟩, hmin⟩ :=
    Set.exists_min_image S Set.ncard hSfinite ⟨F, Set.Subset.rfl, hxy⟩
  have hsub : C ⊆ separatingEdges G F x y := by
    intro e heC
    have hessential : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (C \ {e})).Adj x y := by
      intro hpath
      have hle := hmin (C \ {e}) ⟨Set.sdiff_subset.trans hCF, hpath⟩
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) (Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_lt_of_mem heC (hFfinite.subset hCF))
    exact ⟨hCF heC, forestPathEdgeEssential hFsub hforest hCF hCxy heC hessential⟩
  exact restrictReachableMono hsub hCxy


private lemma forestInsert {F : Set E} (hforest : IsForest (G.restrict F))
    {e : E} {x y : V} (he : G.IsLink e x y)
    (hxy : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj x y) :
    IsForest (G.restrict (insert e F)) := by

  intro f hf
  rcases hf.2 with rfl | hfF
  · refine ⟨x, y, ⟨Set.mem_insert _ F, he⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hpath
    apply hxy
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.mono
      (fun _ _ ⟨g, hge, hg, hlink⟩ ↦ ⟨g, hg.resolve_left hge, hlink⟩) _ _ hpath
  · obtain ⟨a, b, hfab, _⟩ := hforest f ⟨hf.1, hfF⟩
    refine ⟨a, b, ⟨Set.mem_insert_of_mem e hfF, hfab.2⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hpath
    have hnormalized : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (insert e (F \ {f}))).Adj a b := by
      apply Relation.ReflTransGen.mono _ a b hpath
      rintro u v ⟨g, hgf, hg, hlink⟩
      refine ⟨g, ?_, hlink⟩
      rcases hg with hge | hgF
      · exact Or.inl hge
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hgF, hgf⟩
    rcases (restrictReachableInsert he (F \ {f})).mp hnormalized with
      hold | ⟨hax, hyb⟩ | ⟨hay, hxb⟩
    · exact forestNotReachableDelete hforest hfab.2 hfF hold
    · apply hxy
      exact (_root_.symm (restrictReachableMono Set.sdiff_subset hax)).trans
        (.head ⟨f, hfF, hfab.2⟩ (_root_.symm (restrictReachableMono Set.sdiff_subset hyb)))
    · apply hxy
      exact (restrictReachableMono Set.sdiff_subset hxb).trans
        (.head ⟨f, hfF, hfab.2.symm⟩ (restrictReachableMono Set.sdiff_subset hay))


private lemma restrictReachableInsertIffOfConnected {F : Set E} {e : E} {x y : V}
    (he : G.IsLink e x y) (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj x y)
    (u v : V) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (insert e F)).Adj u v ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj u v := by

  constructor
  · intro hpath
    rcases (restrictReachableInsert he F).mp hpath with hold | ⟨hux, hyv⟩ | ⟨huy, hxv⟩
    · exact hold
    · exact hux.trans (hxy.trans hyv)
    · exact huy.trans ((_root_.symm hxy).trans hxv)
  · exact restrictReachableMono (Set.subset_insert e F)


private lemma forestExchangeReachable {F : Set E} {e f : E} {x y : V}
    (he : G.IsLink e x y) (hf : f ∈ F) (hFsub : F ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj x y)
    (hessential : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F \ {f})).Adj x y)
    (u v : V) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (insert e (F \ {f}))).Adj u v ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj u v := by

  obtain ⟨a, b, hfab⟩ := G.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet (hFsub hf)
  have hpath : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (insert f (F \ {f}))).Adj x y := by
    rwa [Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.insert_eq_of_mem hf]
  have hreplace : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (insert e (F \ {f}))).Adj a b := by
    rcases (restrictReachableInsert hfab (F \ {f})).mp hpath with
      hold | ⟨hxa, hby⟩ | ⟨hxb, hay⟩
    · exact (hessential hold).elim
    · exact (_root_.symm (restrictReachableMono (Set.subset_insert e _) hxa)).trans
        (.head ⟨e, Set.mem_insert e _, he⟩
          (_root_.symm (restrictReachableMono (Set.subset_insert e _) hby)))
    · exact (restrictReachableMono (Set.subset_insert e _) hay).trans
        (.head ⟨e, Set.mem_insert e _, he.symm⟩
          (restrictReachableMono (Set.subset_insert e _) hxb))
  constructor
  · intro hnew
    exact (restrictReachableInsertIffOfConnected he hxy u v).mp
      (restrictReachableMono (Set.insert_subset_insert Set.sdiff_subset) hnew)
  · intro hold

    induction hold with
    | refl => exact .refl
    | @tail z w hpath hzw ih =>
      obtain ⟨g, hgF, hlink⟩ := hzw
      by_cases hgf : g = f
      · subst g
        rcases hfab.eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq hlink with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        · exact ih.trans hreplace
        · exact ih.trans (_root_.symm hreplace)
      · exact ih.tail ⟨g, Or.inr ⟨hgF, hgf⟩, hlink⟩


private lemma forestFundamentalExchange {F : Set E} (hFsub : F ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hforest : IsForest (G.restrict F)) {e f : E} {x y : V} (he : G.IsLink e x y)
    (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj x y)
    (hf : f ∈ separatingEdges G F x y) :
    IsForest (G.restrict (insert e (F \ {f}))) ∧
      ∀ u v, Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (insert e (F \ {f}))).Adj u v ↔
        Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj u v := by

  refine ⟨?_, fun u v ↦ forestExchangeReachable he hf.1 hFsub hxy hf.2 u v⟩
  exact forestInsert (hforest.ofLE (G.restrict_mono_right Set.sdiff_subset)) he hf.2


private lemma forestFundamentalPath {F : Set E} (hFsub : F ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hFfinite : F.Finite) (hforest : IsForest (G.restrict F))
    {x y : V} (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict F).Adj x y) :
    ∃ C ⊆ F, Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict C).Adj x y ∧
      ∀ A, C ⊆ A → A ⊆ F → ∀ e, G.IsLink e x y → ∀ f ∈ C,
        IsForest (G.restrict (insert e (A \ {f}))) ∧
        ∀ u v, Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (insert e (A \ {f}))).Adj u v ↔
          Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict A).Adj u v := by

  have hCxy := separatingEdgesConnect hFsub hFfinite hforest hxy
  refine ⟨separatingEdges G F x y, fun _ h ↦ h.1, hCxy, ?_⟩
  intro A hCA hAF e he f hf
  have hessential : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (A \ {f})).Adj x y := by
    intro hpath
    exact hf.2 (restrictReachableMono (Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left hAF) hpath)
  exact forestFundamentalExchange (hAF.trans hFsub)
    (hforest.ofLE (G.restrict_mono_right hAF)) he (restrictReachableMono hCA hCxy)
    ⟨hCA hf, hessential⟩


private lemma forestPackingUpdate {k : ℕ} {F : Fin k → Set E}
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (i : Fin k) (A : Set E) (hAsub : A ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    (hAforest : IsForest (G.restrict A))
    (hAdisj : ∀ j, i ≠ j → Disjoint A (F j)) :
    (∀ j, Function.update F i A j ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧
      IsForest (G.restrict (Function.update F i A j))) ∧
      Pairwise (fun j l ↦ Disjoint (Function.update F i A j) (Function.update F i A l)) := by
  classical

  constructor
  · intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simpa only [Function.update_self] using And.intro hAsub hAforest
    · simpa only [Function.update_of_ne hji] using hF j
  · intro j l hjl
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simpa only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hjl)] using hAdisj l hjl
    · by_cases hli : l = i
      · subst l
        simpa only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hji] using (hAdisj j (Ne.symm hji)).symm
      · simpa only [Function.update_of_ne hji, Function.update_of_ne hli] using hdisj hjl


private lemma maximumPackingUnusedConnected {k : ℕ} {F : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (hmax : ∀ F' : Fin k → Set E,
      (∀ i, F' i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F' i))) →
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F' i) (F' j)) →
      (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) ≤ ∑ i, (F i).ncard)
    {e : E} {x y : V} (he : G.IsLink e x y) (hunused : ∀ j, e ∉ F j)
    (i : Fin k) : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F i)).Adj x y := by
  classical

  by_contra hxy
  have hAsub : insert e (F i) ⊆ G.edgeSet := Set.insert_subset he.edge_mem (hF i).1
  have hAdisj : ∀ j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (insert e (F i)) (F j) := by
    intro j hij
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro f (rfl | hf) hfj
    · exact hunused j hfj
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj hij) hf hfj
  obtain ⟨hnewF, hnewDisj⟩ := forestPackingUpdate hF hdisj i (insert e (F i))
    hAsub (forestInsert (hF i).2 he hxy) hAdisj
  have hstrict : (∑ j, (F j).ncard) <
      ∑ j, (Function.update F i (insert e (F i)) j).ncard := by
    apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
    · intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        simp only [Function.update_self,
          Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem (hunused i) (h_edges.subset (hF i).1)]
        omega
      · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hji, le_refl]
    · refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, ?_⟩
      simp only [Function.update_self,
        Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem (hunused i) (h_edges.subset (hF i).1)]
      omega
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmax _ hnewF hnewDisj)) hstrict


private lemma forestEdgeBound (hH : IsForest H) (h_vertices : H.vertexSet.Finite)
    (h_edges : H.edgeSet.Finite) (h_nonempty : H.vertexSet.Nonempty) :
    H.edgeSet.ncard ≤ H.vertexSet.ncard - 1 := by

  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h_nonempty
  have hpos := (Set.ncard_pos (componentPartitionFinite h_vertices)).mpr
    ⟨componentSet H x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
  have hrank := forestEdgeCount hH h_vertices h_edges
  omega


private lemma forestIsTreeOfFullCard (hH : IsForest H) (h_vertices : H.vertexSet.Finite)
    (h_edges : H.edgeSet.Finite) (h_nonempty : H.vertexSet.Nonempty)
    (hcount : H.edgeSet.ncard = H.vertexSet.ncard - 1) : H.IsTree := by

  have hvpos := (Set.ncard_pos h_vertices).mpr h_nonempty
  have hrank := forestEdgeCount hH h_vertices h_edges
  have hc : (componentPartition H).parts.ncard ≤ 1 := by omega
  have hsingle := (Set.ncard_le_one (componentPartitionFinite h_vertices)).mp hc
  refine ⟨h_nonempty, ?_, hH⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  exact (componentSetEqIff hx hy).mp
    (hsingle (componentSet H x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ (componentSet H y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)


private lemma restrictEdgeSetOfSubset {F : Set E} (hF : F ⊆ G.edgeSet) :
    (G.restrict F).edgeSet = F := by

  exact Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hF


private lemma forestRestrictEmpty (G : Graph V E) : IsForest (G.restrict ∅) := by

  rintro e ⟨_, he⟩
  exact he.elim


private lemma existsMaximumForestPacking (G : Graph V E) (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ F : Fin k → Set E,
      (∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i))) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)) ∧
      ∀ F' : Fin k → Set E,
        (∀ i, F' i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F' i))) →
        Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F' i) (F' j)) →
        (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) ≤ ∑ i, (F i).ncard := by
  classical

  let S : Set ℕ := {m | ∃ F : Fin k → Set E,
    (∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i))) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)) ∧ (∑ i, (F i).ncard) = m}
  have hSfinite : S.Finite := by
    apply (Set.finite_Iic G.edgeSet.ncard).subset
    rintro m ⟨F, hF, hdisj, rfl⟩
    exact Set.sumNcardLeOfDisjoint h_edges F (fun i ↦ (hF i).1) hdisj
  have hSnonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, (fun _ ↦ ∅), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact ⟨Set.empty_subset G.edgeSet, forestRestrictEmpty G⟩
    · intro i j hij
      exact disjoint_bot_left
    · simp only [Set.ncard_empty, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  obtain ⟨m, ⟨F, hF, hdisj, hsize⟩, hmax⟩ :=
    Set.exists_max_image S id hSfinite hSnonempty
  refine ⟨F, hF, hdisj, ?_⟩
  intro F' hF' hdisj'

  exact (hmax (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) ⟨F', hF', hdisj', rfl⟩).trans_eq hsize.symm


private def ForestPackingExchange (G : Graph V E) {k : ℕ}
    (F F' : Fin k → Set E) : Prop :=
  ∃ i e f x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧ (∀ j, e ∉ F j) ∧
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F i)).Adj x y ∧
    f ∈ separatingEdges G (F i) x y ∧
    F' = Function.update F i (insert e (F i \ {f}))


private lemma packingRemovedUnused {k : ℕ} {F : Fin k → Set E}
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    {i : Fin k} {e f : E} (hunused : ∀ j, e ∉ F j) (hf : f ∈ F i) :
    ∀ j, f ∉ Function.update F i (insert e (F i \ {f})) j := by
  classical

  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    rw [Function.update_self]
    rintro (hfe | hmem)
    · exact hunused i (hfe ▸ hf)
    · exact hmem.2 rfl
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hji]
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj (Ne.symm hji)) hf


private lemma forestPackingExchangeSpec {k : ℕ} {F F' : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (hstep : ForestPackingExchange G F F') :
    (∀ i, F' i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F' i))) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F' i) (F' j)) ∧
      (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) = ∑ i, (F i).ncard := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨i, e, f, x, y, he, hunused, hxy, hf, rfl⟩ := hstep
  have hnewSub : insert e (F i \ {f}) ⊆ G.edgeSet :=
    Set.insert_subset he.edge_mem (Set.sdiff_subset.trans (hF i).1)
  have hnewDisj : ∀ j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (insert e (F i \ {f})) (F j) := by
    intro j hij
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro g (rfl | hg) hgj
    · exact hunused j hgj
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj hij) hg.1 hgj
  obtain ⟨hlegal, hdisjoint⟩ := forestPackingUpdate hF hdisj i _ hnewSub
    (forestFundamentalExchange (hF i).1 (hF i).2 he hxy hf).1 hnewDisj
  refine ⟨hlegal, hdisjoint, ?_⟩
  have hcard : (insert e (F i \ {f})).ncard = (F i).ncard := by
    rw [Set.ncard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ hunused i h.1)
      ((h_edges.subset (hF i).1).sdiff)]
    exact Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hf.1 (h_edges.subset (hF i).1)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simpa only [Function.update_self] using hcard
  · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hji]


private lemma forestPackingOrbitSpec {k : ℕ} {F F' : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (hpath : Relation.ReflTransGen (ForestPackingExchange G) F F') :
    (∀ i, F' i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F' i))) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F' i) (F' j)) ∧
      (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) = ∑ i, (F i).ncard := by

  induction hpath with
  | refl => exact ⟨hF, hdisj, rfl⟩
  | tail hpath hstep ih =>
    obtain ⟨hnew, hnewDisj, hsize⟩ := forestPackingExchangeSpec h_edges ih.1 ih.2.1 hstep
    exact ⟨hnew, hnewDisj, hsize.trans ih.2.2⟩


private def exchangeableEdges (G : Graph V E) {k : ℕ} (F : Fin k → Set E) : Set E :=
  {e | e ∈ G.edgeSet ∧ ∃ F', Relation.ReflTransGen (ForestPackingExchange G) F F' ∧
    ∀ i, e ∉ F' i}


private lemma fundamentalPathExchangeable {k : ℕ} {F A : Fin k → Set E}
    (hA : ∀ i, A i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (A i)))
    (hAdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (A i) (A j)))
    (hpath : Relation.ReflTransGen (ForestPackingExchange G) F A)
    {e : E} {x y : V} (he : G.IsLink e x y) (hunused : ∀ j, e ∉ A j)
    (i : Fin k) (hxy : Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (A i)).Adj x y) :
    separatingEdges G (A i) x y ⊆ exchangeableEdges G F := by

  intro f hf
  refine ⟨(hA i).1 hf.1, Function.update A i (insert e (A i \ {f})), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hpath.tail ⟨i, e, f, x, y, he, hunused, hxy, hf, rfl⟩
  · exact packingRemovedUnused hAdisj hunused hf.1


private lemma exchangeInter {A R : Set E} {e f : E} (heR : e ∈ R) :
    (insert e (A \ {f})) ∩ R = insert e ((A ∩ R) \ {f}) := by

  ext g
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hge | ⟨hgA, hgf⟩, hgR⟩
    · exact Or.inl hge
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hgA, hgR⟩, hgf⟩
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨⟨hgA, hgR⟩, hgf⟩)
    · exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, heR⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr ⟨hgA, hgf⟩, hgR⟩


private lemma exchangeRestrictedReachable {k : ℕ} {F A B : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hA : ∀ i, A i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (A i)))
    (hAdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (A i) (A j)))
    (hpath : Relation.ReflTransGen (ForestPackingExchange G) F A)
    (hstep : ForestPackingExchange G A B) (j : Fin k) (u v : V) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (B j ∩ exchangeableEdges G F)).Adj u v ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (A j ∩ exchangeableEdges G F)).Adj u v := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨i, e, f, x, y, he, hunused, hxy, hf, rfl⟩ := hstep
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    have heR : e ∈ exchangeableEdges G F := ⟨he.edge_mem, A, hpath, hunused⟩
    have hCR := fundamentalPathExchangeable hA hAdisj hpath he hunused i hxy
    have hCxy := separatingEdgesConnect (hA i).1 (h_edges.subset (hA i).1) (hA i).2 hxy
    have hCA : separatingEdges G (A i) x y ⊆ A i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F :=
      fun _ h ↦ ⟨h.1, hCR h⟩
    have hessential : ¬Relation.ReflTransGen
        (G.restrict ((A i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F) \ {f})).Adj x y := by
      intro h
      exact hf.2 (restrictReachableMono (Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left Set.inter_subset_left) h)
    rw [Function.update_self, exchangeInter heR]
    exact forestExchangeReachable (F := A i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F) he ⟨hf.1, hCR hf⟩
      (Set.inter_subset_left.trans (hA i).1) (restrictReachableMono hCA hCxy) hessential u v
  · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hji]


private lemma orbitRestrictedReachable {k : ℕ} {F A : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (hpath : Relation.ReflTransGen (ForestPackingExchange G) F A) (i : Fin k) (u v : V) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (A i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F)).Adj u v ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F)).Adj u v := by

  induction hpath with
  | refl => exact Iff.rfl
  | tail hpath hstep ih =>
    have hspec := forestPackingOrbitSpec h_edges hF hdisj hpath
    exact (exchangeRestrictedReachable h_edges hspec.1 hspec.2.1 hpath hstep i u v).trans ih


private lemma exchangeableLinkConnected {k : ℕ} {F : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (hmax : ∀ F' : Fin k → Set E,
      (∀ i, F' i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F' i))) →
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F' i) (F' j)) →
      (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) ≤ ∑ i, (F i).ncard)
    {e : E} {x y : V} (he : G.IsLink e x y) (heR : e ∈ exchangeableEdges G F)
    (i : Fin k) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F)).Adj x y := by

  obtain ⟨_, A, hpath, hunused⟩ := heR
  have hspec := forestPackingOrbitSpec h_edges hF hdisj hpath
  have hAmax : ∀ B : Fin k → Set E,
      (∀ j, B j ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (B j))) →
      Pairwise (fun j l ↦ Disjoint (B j) (B l)) →
      (∑ j, (B j).ncard) ≤ ∑ j, (A j).ncard := by
    intro B hB hBdisj
    exact (hmax B hB hBdisj).trans_eq hspec.2.2.symm
  have hxy := maximumPackingUnusedConnected h_edges hspec.1 hspec.2.1 hAmax he hunused i
  have hCxy := separatingEdgesConnect (hspec.1 i).1
    (h_edges.subset (hspec.1 i).1) (hspec.1 i).2 hxy
  have hCR := fundamentalPathExchangeable hspec.1 hspec.2.1 hpath he hunused i hxy
  have hsub : separatingEdges G (A i) x y ⊆ A i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F :=
    fun _ h ↦ ⟨h.1, hCR h⟩
  exact (orbitRestrictedReachable h_edges hF hdisj hpath i x y).mp
    (restrictReachableMono hsub hCxy)


private lemma exchangeableReachableIff {k : ℕ} {F : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (hmax : ∀ F' : Fin k → Set E,
      (∀ i, F' i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F' i))) →
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F' i) (F' j)) →
      (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) ≤ ∑ i, (F i).ncard)
    (i : Fin k) (x y : V) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (exchangeableEdges G F)).Adj x y ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict (F i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F)).Adj x y := by

  constructor
  · intro hpath
    apply Relation.reflTransGen_closed _ x y hpath
    rintro a b ⟨e, heR, he⟩
    exact exchangeableLinkConnected h_edges hF hdisj hmax he heR i
  · exact restrictReachableMono Set.inter_subset_right


private lemma componentPartsEqOfReachable {A B : Set E}
    (h : ∀ x y, Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict A).Adj x y ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (G.restrict B).Adj x y) :
    (componentPartition (G.restrict A)).parts =
      (componentPartition (G.restrict B)).parts := by

  have hsets (x : V) : componentSet (G.restrict A) x = componentSet (G.restrict B) x := by
    ext y
    exact and_congr Iff.rfl (h x y)
  exact congrArg (fun f : V → Set V ↦ f '' G.vertexSet) (funext hsets)


private lemma exchangeableCrossEdges {k : ℕ} {F : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (hmax : ∀ F' : Fin k → Set E,
      (∀ i, F' i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F' i))) →
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F' i) (F' j)) →
      (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) ≤ ∑ i, (F i).ncard) :
    G.crossEdges (componentPartition (G.restrict (exchangeableEdges G F))) =
      G.edgeSet \ exchangeableEdges G F := by
  classical

  ext e
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, y, he, hn⟩
    refine ⟨he.edge_mem, ?_⟩
    intro heR
    exact hn ((componentPartitionRel _ x y).mpr
      ⟨he.left_mem, he.right_mem, .single ⟨e, heR, he⟩⟩)
  · rintro ⟨heG, heR⟩
    obtain ⟨x, y, he⟩ := G.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet heG
    have hused : ∃ i, e ∈ F i := by
      by_contra h
      apply heR
      exact ⟨heG, F, .refl, fun i hi ↦ h ⟨i, hi⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hei⟩ := hused
    refine ⟨x, y, he, ?_⟩
    intro hrel
    have hpath := (exchangeableReachableIff h_edges hF hdisj hmax i x y).mp
      ((componentPartitionRel _ x y).mp hrel).2.2
    have hsub : F i ∩ exchangeableEdges G F ⊆ F i \ {e} :=
      fun f hf ↦ ⟨hf.1, fun hfe ↦ heR (hfe ▸ hf.2)⟩
    exact forestNotReachableDelete (hF i).2 he hei (restrictReachableMono hsub hpath)


private lemma forestPackingCertificate {k : ℕ} {F : Fin k → Set E}
    (h_vertices : G.vertexSet.Finite) (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i)))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)))
    (hmax : ∀ F' : Fin k → Set E,
      (∀ i, F' i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F' i))) →
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F' i) (F' j)) →
      (∑ i, (F' i).ncard) ≤ ∑ i, (F i).ncard) :
    ∃ P : Partition G.vertexSet,
      (∑ i, (F i).ncard) + k * P.parts.ncard =
        k * G.vertexSet.ncard + (G.crossEdges P).ncard := by
  classical
  let R := exchangeableEdges G F
  let P := componentPartition (G.restrict R)

  have hinner (i : Fin k) : (F i ∩ R).ncard + P.parts.ncard = G.vertexSet.ncard := by
    have hrank := forestEdgeCount (H := G.restrict (F i ∩ R))
      ((hF i).2.ofLE (G.restrict_mono_right Set.inter_subset_left)) h_vertices
      (h_edges.subset Set.inter_subset_left)
    have hparts := componentPartsEqOfReachable
      (fun x y ↦ (exchangeableReachableIff h_edges hF hdisj hmax i x y).symm)
    rw [restrictEdgeSetOfSubset (Set.inter_subset_left.trans (hF i).1), hparts] at hrank
    exact hrank
  have hinnerSum : (∑ i, (F i ∩ R).ncard) + k * P.parts.ncard = k * G.vertexSet.ncard := by
    have hsum : (∑ i, ((F i ∩ R).ncard + P.parts.ncard)) =
        ∑ _ : Fin k, G.vertexSet.ncard :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ hinner i)
    simpa only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul] using hsum

  have houter : (∑ i, (F i \ R).ncard) = (G.edgeSet \ R).ncard := by
    apply Set.sumNcardEqOfDisjoint (h_edges.sdiff) (fun i ↦ F i \ R)
    · exact fun i ↦ Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left (hF i).1
    · exact fun i j hij ↦ (hdisj hij).mono Set.sdiff_subset Set.sdiff_subset
    · intro e he
      by_contra hn
      apply he.2
      refine ⟨he.1, F, .refl, ?_⟩
      intro i hei
      exact hn ⟨i, hei, he.2⟩
  have hsplit : (∑ i, (F i).ncard) =
      (∑ i, (F i ∩ R).ncard) + ∑ i, (F i \ R).ncard := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦
      (Set.ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard (F i) R (h_edges.subset (hF i).1)).symm)
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩

  have hcross : G.crossEdges P = G.edgeSet \ R :=
    exchangeableCrossEdges h_edges hF hdisj hmax
  calc
    (∑ i, (F i).ncard) + k * P.parts.ncard =
        ((∑ i, (F i ∩ R).ncard) + k * P.parts.ncard) + ∑ i, (F i \ R).ncard := by
      rw [hsplit]
      omega
    _ = k * G.vertexSet.ncard + (G.edgeSet \ R).ncard := by rw [hinnerSum, houter]
    _ = k * G.vertexSet.ncard + (G.crossEdges P).ncard := by rw [hcross]


private lemma spanningTreesOfForestCertificate (G : Graph V E)
    (h_vertices : G.vertexSet.Finite) (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (h_nonempty : G.vertexSet.Nonempty) (k : ℕ)
    (hpartition : ∀ P : Partition G.vertexSet,
      k * (P.parts.ncard - 1) ≤ (G.crossEdges P).ncard)
    (hcertificate : ∃ F : Fin k → Set E,
      (∀ i, F i ⊆ G.edgeSet ∧ IsForest (G.restrict (F i))) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (F i) (F j)) ∧
      ∃ P : Partition G.vertexSet,
        (∑ i, (F i).ncard) + k * P.parts.ncard =
          k * G.vertexSet.ncard + (G.crossEdges P).ncard) :
    ∃ T : Fin k → Graph V E,
      (∀ i, (T i).IsSpanningSubgraph G ∧ (T i).IsTree) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (T i).edgeSet (T j).edgeSet) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hdisj, P, hcert⟩ := hcertificate

  have hpartsFinite : P.parts.Finite := h_vertices.powerset.subset
    (fun _ hmem ↦ P.subset_of_mem hmem)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h_nonempty
  have hpartsPos := (Set.ncard_pos hpartsFinite).mpr
    ⟨P.partOf x, P.partOf_mem hx⟩
  have hcross := hpartition P
  have htotal : k * (G.vertexSet.ncard - 1) ≤ ∑ i, (F i).ncard := by
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hpartsPos
    simp only [Nat.mul_one] at hmul
    rw [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_one] at hcross ⊢
    omega
  have hbound (i : Fin k) : (F i).ncard ≤ G.vertexSet.ncard - 1 := by
    have h := forestEdgeBound (hF i).2 h_vertices
      (h_edges.subset (Set.inter_subset_left)) ⟨x, hx⟩
    rwa [restrictEdgeSetOfSubset (hF i).1] at h
  have hsum : (∑ i, (F i).ncard) = ∑ _ : Fin k, (G.vertexSet.ncard - 1) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ hbound i)
    · simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
        using htotal
  have heach : ∀ i : Fin k, (F i).ncard = G.vertexSet.ncard - 1 := by
    exact fun i ↦ (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le (fun j _ ↦ hbound j)).mp hsum i
      (Finset.mem_univ i)

  refine ⟨fun i ↦ G.restrict (F i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine ⟨⟨restrict_le, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    apply forestIsTreeOfFullCard (hF i).2 h_vertices
      (h_edges.subset Set.inter_subset_left) ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [restrictEdgeSetOfSubset (hF i).1]
    exact heach i
  · intro i j hij
    rw [restrictEdgeSetOfSubset (hF i).1, restrictEdgeSetOfSubset (hF j).1]
    exact hdisj hij

end Graph







theorem Graph.nashWilliamsTutte {V : Type u} {E : Type v} (G : Graph V E)
    (h_vertices : G.vertexSet.Finite) (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite)
    (h_nonempty : G.vertexSet.Nonempty) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∃ T : Fin k → Graph V E,
      (∀ i, (T i).IsSpanningSubgraph G ∧ (T i).IsTree) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (T i).edgeSet (T j).edgeSet)) ↔
    ∀ P : Partition G.vertexSet, k * (P.parts.ncard - 1) ≤ (G.crossEdges P).ncard := by

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, hdisj⟩ P
    have hcross : (G.crossEdges P).Finite := h_edges.subset
      (fun e ⟨x, y, hxy, hne⟩ ↦ hxy.edge_mem)
    have hsum := Set.sumNcardLeOfDisjoint hcross
      (fun i ↦ (T i).edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P)
      (fun _ ↦ Set.inter_subset_right) (fun i j hij ↦
        (hdisj hij).mono Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left)
    calc
      k * (P.parts.ncard - 1) = ∑ i : Fin k, (P.parts.ncard - 1) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin k, ((T i).edgeSet ∩ G.crossEdges P).ncard := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ ↦
          Graph.crossEdgesLowerBoundOfTree (hT i).1 (hT i).2 h_edges P)
      _ ≤ (G.crossEdges P).ncard := hsum
  · intro hpartition
    apply Graph.spanningTreesOfForestCertificate G h_vertices h_edges h_nonempty k hpartition
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hdisj, hmax⟩ := Graph.existsMaximumForestPacking G h_edges k
    refine ⟨F, hF, hdisj, ?_⟩

    exact Graph.forestPackingCertificate h_vertices h_edges hF hdisj hmax

def SixPointAction.generator : Equiv.Perm (Fin 6) :=
  Equiv.swap 0 1 * ([2, 3, 4, 5] : List (Fin 6)).formPerm


def SixPointAction.group : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (Fin 6)) :=
  Subgroup.zpowers SixPointAction.generator

open SixPointAction


theorem SixPointAction.generator_sq :
    generator ^ 2 = Equiv.swap 2 4 * Equiv.swap 3 5 := by

  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals decide


theorem SixPointAction.generator_inv :
    generator⁻¹ = Equiv.swap 0 1 * ([2, 5, 4, 3] : List (Fin 6)).formPerm := by

  refine inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one.mpr ?_
  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals decide


private lemma SixPointAction.generatorPowFour : generator ^ 4 = 1 := by

  ext x
  fin_cases x
  all_goals decide


private lemma SixPointAction.generatorPowThree : generator ^ 3 = generator⁻¹ := by

  refine eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one.mpr ?_
  simpa only [← pow_succ] using generatorPowFour


theorem SixPointAction.mem_group (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 6)) :
    p ∈ group ↔ p = 1 ∨ p = generator ∨ p = generator ^ 2 ∨ p = generator⁻¹ := by

  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hp
    rw [zpow_eq_zpow_emod' n generatorPowFour]
    have hn : n % (4 : ℤ) = 0 ∨ n % (4 : ℤ) = 1 ∨
        n % (4 : ℤ) = 2 ∨ n % (4 : ℤ) = 3 := by
      omega
    rcases hn with h | h | h | h
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h, zpow_ofNat]
    · simp [h, zpow_ofNat, generatorPowThree]
  · intro hp

    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact group.one_mem
    · exact Subgroup.mem_zpowers generator
    · exact Subgroup.npow_mem_zpowers generator 2
    · exact group.inv_mem (Subgroup.mem_zpowers generator)


theorem SixPointAction.fixedBy_subgroup (g : group) :
    MulAction.fixedBy (Fin 6) g = MulAction.fixedBy (Fin 6) (group.subtype g) := by

  ext x
  simp only [MulAction.mem_fixedBy, Subgroup.smul_def, Subgroup.subtype_apply]



theorem SixPointAction.fixedBy_identity :
    MulAction.fixedBy (Fin 6) (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 6)) = Set.univ := by

  ext x
  simp only [MulAction.mem_fixedBy, one_smul, Set.mem_univ]



theorem SixPointAction.fixedBy_square :
    MulAction.fixedBy (Fin 6) (generator ^ 2) = {0, 1} := by

  rw [generator_sq]
  ext x
  simp only [MulAction.mem_fixedBy, Equiv.Perm.smul_def,
    Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  fin_cases x
  all_goals decide



theorem SixPointAction.fixedBy_generator :
    MulAction.fixedBy (Fin 6) generator = ∅ := by

  ext x
  simp only [MulAction.mem_fixedBy, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
    iff_false]
  fin_cases x
  all_goals decide



theorem SixPointAction.fixedBy_inverse :
    MulAction.fixedBy (Fin 6) generator⁻¹ = ∅ := by

  rw [generator_inv]
  ext x
  simp only [MulAction.mem_fixedBy, Equiv.Perm.smul_def, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
    iff_false]
  fin_cases x
  all_goals decide


private lemma SixPointAction.mem_image_stabilizer_iff {G α : Type*} [Group G]
    [MulAction G α] (S : Subgroup G) (x : α) (p : G) :
    p ∈ Set.image S.subtype (MulAction.stabilizer S x) ↔ p ∈ S ∧ p • x = x := by

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g.property, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨hp, hx⟩
    refine ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mpr hx




theorem SixPointAction.stabilizer_pair (x : Fin 6) (hx : x ∈ ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 6))) :
    Set.image group.subtype (MulAction.stabilizer group x) = {1, generator ^ 2} := by

  ext p
  rw [mem_image_stabilizer_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hfix⟩
    rcases (mem_group p).mp hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact Set.mem_insert 1 _
    · have hmem := MulAction.mem_fixedBy.mpr hfix
      rw [fixedBy_generator] at hmem
      exact hmem.elim
    · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
    · have hmem := MulAction.mem_fixedBy.mpr hfix
      rw [fixedBy_inverse] at hmem
      exact hmem.elim
  · intro hp

    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hp with rfl | hp
    · exact ⟨group.one_mem, one_smul _ _⟩
    · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp
      refine ⟨Subgroup.npow_mem_zpowers generator 2, ?_⟩
      exact MulAction.mem_fixedBy.mp (fixedBy_square.symm ▸ hx)



theorem SixPointAction.stabilizer_cycle (x : Fin 6)
    (hx : x ∈ ({2, 3, 4, 5} : Set (Fin 6))) :
    MulAction.stabilizer group x = ⊥ := by

  refine (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr ?_
  intro g hg
  have hfix : x ∈ MulAction.fixedBy (Fin 6) (group.subtype g) :=
    MulAction.mem_fixedBy.mpr (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp hg)
  rcases (mem_group (group.subtype g)).mp g.property with hid | hgen | hsq | hinv
  · exact Subtype.ext hid
  · rw [hgen, fixedBy_generator] at hfix
    exact hfix.elim
  · rw [hsq, fixedBy_square] at hfix

    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hfix
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    all_goals simp at hfix
  · rw [hinv, fixedBy_inverse] at hfix
    exact hfix.elim

variable {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}



def IsStable (M : G.Subgraph) (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e : Sym2 V), e ∈ G.edgeSet → e ∉ M.edgeSet →
    ∃ (f : Sym2 V), f ∈ M.edgeSet ∧
      ∃ (v : V) (he : e ∈ G.incidenceSet v) (hf : f ∈ G.incidenceSet v),
        (p v).lt ⟨e, he⟩ ⟨f, hf⟩


theorem isStable_iff (M : G.Subgraph) (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v)) :
    M.IsStable p ↔
      ∀ (e : Sym2 V), e ∈ G.edgeSet → e ∉ M.edgeSet →
        ∃ (f : Sym2 V), f ∈ M.edgeSet ∧
          ∃ (v : V) (he : e ∈ G.incidenceSet v) (hf : f ∈ G.incidenceSet v),
            (p v).lt ⟨e, he⟩ ⟨f, hf⟩ := by

  rfl


theorem isStable_congr (M N : G.Subgraph)
    (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v)) (h_edges : M.edgeSet = N.edgeSet) :
    M.IsStable p ↔ N.IsStable p := by

  simp only [IsStable, h_edges]



private def undominatedOn (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v))
    (C : Set V) (S : Set G.edgeSet) : Set G.edgeSet :=
  {e | ∀ v ∈ C, ∀ he : e.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v, ∀ f ∈ S,
    ∀ hf : f.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v, ¬ (p v).lt ⟨e.val, he⟩ ⟨f.val, hf⟩}


private lemma mem_undominatedOn (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v))
    (C : Set V) (S : Set G.edgeSet) (e : G.edgeSet) :
    e ∈ undominatedOn p C S ↔
      ∀ v ∈ C, ∀ he : e.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v, ∀ f ∈ S,
        ∀ hf : f.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v, ¬ (p v).lt ⟨e.val, he⟩ ⟨f.val, hf⟩ := by

  rfl


private lemma antitone_undominatedOn (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v))
    (C : Set V) : Antitone (undominatedOn p C) := by

  intro S T hST e he v hv hev f hf hfv
  exact he v hv hev f (hST hf) hfv


private lemma monotone_undominatedOn_comp (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v))
    (A B : Set V) : Monotone (fun S ↦ undominatedOn p A (undominatedOn p B S)) := by

  exact (antitone_undominatedOn p A).comp (antitone_undominatedOn p B)


private lemma existsMutuallyUndominatedSets
    (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v)) (A B : Set V) :
    ∃ X Y : Set G.edgeSet, X = undominatedOn p A Y ∧ Y = undominatedOn p B X := by

  let F : Set G.edgeSet →o Set G.edgeSet :=
    ⟨fun S ↦ undominatedOn p A (undominatedOn p B S),
      monotone_undominatedOn_comp p A B⟩
  exact ⟨F.lfp, undominatedOn p B F.lfp, F.map_lfp.symm, rfl⟩


private lemma independentEndpointUnique {C : Set V} (hC : G.IsIndepSet C)
    {e : Sym2 V} {v w : V} (hv : v ∈ C) (hw : w ∈ C)
    (hev : e ∈ G.incidenceSet v) (hew : e ∈ G.incidenceSet w) : v = w := by

  by_contra hne
  exact hC hv hw hne (G.adj_of_mem_incidenceSet hne hev hew)


private lemma existsUndominatedDominator [Finite V]
    (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v)) {C : Set V}
    (hC : G.IsIndepSet C) (S : Set G.edgeSet) {e : G.edgeSet}
    (he : e ∉ undominatedOn p C S) :
    ∃ f : G.edgeSet, f ∈ S ∧ f ∈ undominatedOn p C S ∧
      ∃ v ∈ C, ∃ (hev : e.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v) (hfv : f.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v),
        (p v).lt ⟨e.val, hev⟩ ⟨f.val, hfv⟩ := by
  classical

  rw [mem_undominatedOn] at he
  push Not at he
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hev, f, hf, hfv, hef⟩ := he
  let T : Set (G.incidenceSet v) := {x | (⟨x.val, x.property.1⟩ : G.edgeSet) ∈ S}
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmax⟩ := @Set.exists_max_image _ _ (p v) T id T.toFinite
    ⟨⟨f.val, hfv⟩, hf⟩
  let g : G.edgeSet := ⟨m.val, m.property.1⟩

  have hg : g ∈ undominatedOn p C S := by
    intro w hw hgw k hk hkw hlt
    have hwv := independentEndpointUnique hC hw hv hgw m.property
    subst w
    exact (@not_lt_of_ge _ (p v).toPreorder _ _ (hmax ⟨k.val, hkw⟩ hk)) hlt
  refine ⟨g, hm, hg, v, hv, hev, m.property, ?_⟩
  exact @lt_of_lt_of_le _ (p v).toPreorder _ _ _ hef (hmax ⟨f.val, hfv⟩ hf)


private lemma undominatedIntersectionIncidenceSubsingleton
    (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v)) (C : Set V)
    (S T : Set G.edgeSet) (hS : S ⊆ undominatedOn p C T) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C) :
    Set.Subsingleton {e : G.edgeSet | e ∈ S ∩ T ∧ e.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v} := by

  rintro e ⟨⟨heS, heT⟩, hev⟩ f ⟨⟨hfS, hfT⟩, hfv⟩
  rcases @lt_trichotomy _ (p v) ⟨e.val, hev⟩ ⟨f.val, hfv⟩ with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact False.elim (hS heS v hv hev f hfT hfv hlt)
  · exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun x : G.incidenceSet v ↦ x.val) heq)
  · exact False.elim (hS hfS v hv hfv e heT hev hgt)


private lemma bipartitionIndependent {A B : Set V} (h : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) :
    G.IsIndepSet A := by

  intro v hv w hw _ hadj
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h.disjoint hw (h.mem_of_mem_adj hv hadj)


private lemma existsMatchingWithEdgeSet (K : Set G.edgeSet)
    (hK : ∀ v : V, Set.Subsingleton {e : G.edgeSet | e ∈ K ∧ e.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v}) :
    ∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsMatching ∧ M.edgeSet = Subtype.val '' K := by
  classical

  let N : G.Subgraph := (⊤ : G.Subgraph).deleteEdges (Subtype.val '' K)ᶜ
  let M := N.induce N.support
  have hN {v w : V} : N.Adj v w ↔ s(v, w) ∈ Subtype.val '' K := by
    simp only [N, deleteEdges_adj, top_adj, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not]
    constructor
    · exact And.right
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨e, _, he⟩ := h
      exact ⟨G.mem_edgeSet.mp (he ▸ e.property), ⟨e, ‹e ∈ K›, he⟩⟩
  have hM {v w : V} : M.Adj v w ↔ s(v, w) ∈ Subtype.val '' K := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact hN.mp h.2.2
    · intro h
      have hn := hN.mpr h
      exact ⟨⟨w, hn⟩, ⟨v, hn.symm⟩, hn⟩
  have h_edges : M.edgeSet = Subtype.val '' K := by
    ext e
    induction e using Sym2.ind with
    | h v w => exact hM

  refine ⟨M, ?_, h_edges⟩
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨w, hvw⟩ := hv
  have hmvw : M.Adj v w := hM.mpr (hN.mp hvw)
  refine ⟨w, hmvw, ?_⟩
  intro z hvz
  obtain ⟨e, heK, he⟩ := hM.mp hmvw
  obtain ⟨f, hfK, hf⟩ := hM.mp hvz
  have hev : e.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v := by
    rw [he]
    exact G.mk'_mem_incidenceSet_left_iff.mpr (M.adj_sub hmvw)
  have hfv : f.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v := by
    rw [hf]
    exact G.mk'_mem_incidenceSet_left_iff.mpr (M.adj_sub hvz)
  have hef := congrArg Subtype.val (hK v ⟨heK, hev⟩ ⟨hfK, hfv⟩)
  rw [he, hf] at hef
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hef with h | h
  · exact h.2.symm
  · exact False.elim ((M.adj_sub hmvw).ne h.2.symm)

end SimpleGraph.Subgraph




theorem existsStableMatching {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (A B : Set V)
    (h_bipartite : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) (h_cover : A ∪ B = Set.univ)
    (p : (v : V) → LinearOrder (G.incidenceSet v)) :
    ∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsMatching ∧ M.IsStable p := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨X, Y, hX, hY⟩ := SimpleGraph.Subgraph.existsMutuallyUndominatedSets p A B
  have hK : ∀ v : V, Set.Subsingleton
      {e : G.edgeSet | e ∈ X ∩ Y ∧ e.val ∈ G.incidenceSet v} := by
    intro v
    have hv : v ∈ A ∪ B := h_cover.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ v
    rcases hv with hv | hv
    · exact SimpleGraph.Subgraph.undominatedIntersectionIncidenceSubsingleton p A X Y
        hX.le hv
    · simpa only [Set.inter_comm X Y] using
        SimpleGraph.Subgraph.undominatedIntersectionIncidenceSubsingleton p B Y X hY.le hv
  obtain ⟨M, hM, h_edges⟩ := SimpleGraph.Subgraph.existsMatchingWithEdgeSet (X ∩ Y) hK
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩

  intro e he heM
  let a : G.edgeSet := ⟨e, he⟩
  have ha : a ∉ X ∩ Y := by
    intro h
    exact heM (h_edges.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem Subtype.val h)
  by_cases haX : a ∈ X
  · have haY : a ∉ SimpleGraph.Subgraph.undominatedOn p B X := by
      rw [← hY]
      exact fun h ↦ ha ⟨haX, h⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hfX, hfY, v, _, hev, hfv, hlt⟩ :=
      SimpleGraph.Subgraph.existsUndominatedDominator p
        (SimpleGraph.Subgraph.bipartitionIndependent h_bipartite.symm) X haY
    rw [← hY] at hfY
    exact ⟨f.val, h_edges.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem Subtype.val ⟨hfX, hfY⟩,
      v, hev, hfv, hlt⟩
  · have haA : a ∉ SimpleGraph.Subgraph.undominatedOn p A Y := hX ▸ haX
    obtain ⟨f, hfY, hfX, v, _, hev, hfv, hlt⟩ :=
      SimpleGraph.Subgraph.existsUndominatedDominator p
        (SimpleGraph.Subgraph.bipartitionIndependent h_bipartite) Y haA
    rw [← hX] at hfX
    exact ⟨f.val, h_edges.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem Subtype.val ⟨hfX, hfY⟩,
      v, hev, hfv, hlt⟩

public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Clique

public section

universe u v

namespace SimpleGraph



def isGraphProperty (C : ∀ (V : Type u) [Finite V], SimpleGraph V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V W : Type u) [Finite V] [Finite W] (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W),
    (G ≃g H) → C V G → C W H


theorem isGraphProperty_iff (C : ∀ (V : Type u) [Finite V], SimpleGraph V → Prop) :
    isGraphProperty C ↔
      ∀ (V W : Type u) [Finite V] [Finite W] (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W),
        (G ≃g H) → (C V G ↔ C W H) := by

  constructor
  · intro hC V W _ _ G H e
    exact ⟨hC V W G H e, hC W V H G e.symm⟩
  · intro hC V W _ _ G H e
    exact (hC V W G H e).mp


theorem graphProperty_congr {C : ∀ (V : Type u) [Finite V], SimpleGraph V → Prop}
    (hC : isGraphProperty C) {V W : Type u} [Finite V] [Finite W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (e : G ≃g H) :
    C V G ↔ C W H := by

  exact (isGraphProperty_iff C).mp hC V W G H e


private lemma embeddingMapNClique {V W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G ↪g H) {n : ℕ} {s : Finset V}
    (hs : G.IsNClique n s) : H.IsNClique n (s.map f.toEmbedding) := by

  have hmap : G.map f.toEmbedding ≤ H :=
    (map_le_iff_le_comap f.toEmbedding G H).mpr f.toHom.le_comap
  exact IsNClique.mono hmap hs.map



theorem triangleProperty :
    isGraphProperty (fun V _ G ↦ ∃ s : Finset V, G.IsNClique 3 s) := by

  intro V W _ _ G H e hG
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hG
  exact ⟨s.map e.toEmbedding.toEmbedding, embeddingMapNClique e.toEmbedding hs⟩


theorem triangle_iff {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (∃ s : Finset V, G.IsNClique 3 s) ↔
      ∃ a b c : V, G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj a c ∧ G.Adj b c := by
  classical

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, hab, hac, hbc, _⟩ := is3Clique_iff.mp hs
    exact ⟨a, b, c, hab, hac, hbc⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, hab, hac, hbc⟩
    exact ⟨{a, b, c}, is3Clique_triple_iff.mpr ⟨hab, hac, hbc⟩⟩



def isGraphInvariant {A : Type v}
    (f : ∀ (V : Type u) [Finite V], SimpleGraph V → A) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V W : Type u) [Finite V] [Finite W] (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W),
    (G ≃g H) → f V G = f W H


theorem isGraphInvariant_iff {A : Type v}
    (f : ∀ (V : Type u) [Finite V], SimpleGraph V → A) :
    isGraphInvariant f ↔
      ∀ (V W : Type u) [Finite V] [Finite W] (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W),
        Nonempty (G ≃g H) → f V G = f W H := by

  constructor
  · intro hf V W _ _ G H he
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
    exact hf V W G H e
  · intro hf V W _ _ G H e
    exact hf V W G H ⟨e⟩


theorem graphInvariant_eq {A : Type v}
    {f : ∀ (V : Type u) [Finite V], SimpleGraph V → A}
    (hf : isGraphInvariant f) {V W : Type u} [Finite V] [Finite W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (e : G ≃g H) :
    f V G = f W H := by

  exact hf V W G H e



theorem vertexCountInvariant :
    isGraphInvariant (fun V _ _ ↦ Nat.card V) := by

  intro V W _ _ G H e
  exact Nat.card_congr e.toEquiv



theorem edgeCountInvariant :
    isGraphInvariant (fun _ _ G ↦ Nat.card G.edgeSet) := by

  intro V W _ _ G H e
  exact Nat.card_congr e.mapEdgeSet


private lemma cliqueNumLeOfEmbedding {V W : Type*} [Finite W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} (f : G ↪g H) :
    G.cliqueNum ≤ H.cliqueNum := by

  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := G.exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
  have himage : H.IsNClique G.cliqueNum (s.map f.toEmbedding) :=
    embeddingMapNClique f hs
  calc
    G.cliqueNum = (s.map f.toEmbedding).card := himage.card_eq.symm
    _ ≤ H.cliqueNum := himage.isClique.card_le_cliqueNum



theorem cliqueNumInvariant :
    isGraphInvariant (fun _ _ G ↦ G.cliqueNum) := by

  intro V W _ _ G H e
  exact le_antisymm (cliqueNumLeOfEmbedding e.toEmbedding)
    (cliqueNumLeOfEmbedding e.symm.toEmbedding)

end SimpleGraph

theorem doorSpace_iff (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] :
    DoorSpace X ↔ ∀ s : Set X, IsOpen s ∨ IsClosed s := by

  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.isOpen_or_isClosed, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩



instance instDoorSpaceOfDiscrete (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X] :
    DoorSpace X := by

  exact ⟨fun s ↦ Or.inl (isOpen_discrete s)⟩



theorem doorSpaceIndiscrete_iff (X : Type u) :
    @DoorSpace X (⊤ : TopologicalSpace X) ↔ Subsingleton X := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro x y

    have singleton_cases : ({x} : Set X) = ∅ ∨ ({x} : Set X) = Set.univ := by
      rcases h.isOpen_or_isClosed {x} with hopen | hclosed
      · exact (TopologicalSpace.isOpen_top_iff _).mp hopen
      · exact (@IndiscreteTopology.isClosed_iff X ⊤ inferInstance _).mp hclosed
    rcases singleton_cases with hempty | huniv
    · have hx : x ∈ (∅ : Set X) := hempty ▸ Set.mem_singleton x
      exact hx.elim
    · have hy : y ∈ ({x} : Set X) := huniv.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ y
      exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy).symm
  · intro h
    refine @DoorSpace.mk X ⊤ ?_
    intro s

    exact @Subsingleton.set_cases X h
      (fun s ↦ IsOpen[⊤] s ∨ IsClosed[⊤] s)
      (Or.inl (@isOpen_empty X ⊤)) (Or.inl (@isOpen_univ X ⊤)) s


private lemma existsInfiniteCoinfinite (X : Type u) [Infinite X] :
    ∃ s : Set X, s.Infinite ∧ sᶜ.Infinite := by
  let e := Infinite.natEmbedding X

  have even_injective : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ ↦ e (2 * n)) := by
    intro m n h
    have heq := e.injective h
    omega
  have odd_injective : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ ↦ e (2 * n + 1)) := by
    intro m n h
    have heq := e.injective h
    omega
  refine ⟨Set.range (fun n : ℕ ↦ e (2 * n)),
    Set.infinite_range_of_injective even_injective, ?_⟩
  refine (Set.infinite_range_of_injective odd_injective).mono ?_
  rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩ ⟨m, hm⟩
  have heq := e.injective hm
  omega



theorem not_doorSpaceCofinite (X : Type u) [Infinite X] :
    ¬ @DoorSpace X (TopologicalSpace.cofinite : TopologicalSpace X) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hc⟩ := existsInfiniteCoinfinite X

  rcases h.isOpen_or_isClosed s with hopen | hclosed
  · exact hc (hopen hs.nonempty)
  · have hfinite : (sᶜ)ᶜ.Finite := hclosed.isOpen_compl hc.nonempty
    exact hs (compl_compl s ▸ hfinite)


private lemma doorSpecializationCommonCoordinate {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (hdoor : DoorSpace X) {x y z w : X} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hzw : z ≠ w)
    (hfirst : x ⤳ y) (hsecond : z ⤳ w) : x = z ∨ y = w := by
  classical
  by_cases hxz : x = z
  · exact Or.inl hxz
  by_cases hyw : y = w
  · exact Or.inr hyw

  rcases hdoor.isOpen_or_isClosed {y, z} with hopen | hclosed
  · have hx := hfirst.mem_open hopen (Set.mem_insert y {z})
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    exact False.elim (hx.elim hxy hxz)
  · have hw := hsecond.mem_closed hclosed (Set.mem_insert_of_mem y (Set.mem_singleton z))
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hw
    exact False.elim (hw.elim (Ne.symm hyw) (Ne.symm hzw))


private lemma relationCommonCoordinateCenter {X : Type u} [Nonempty X]
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (h : ∀ a b c d, R a b → R c d → a = c ∨ b = d) :
    ∃ p : X, (∀ a b, R a b → a = p) ∨ (∀ a b, R a b → b = p) := by
  classical
  by_cases hex : ∃ a b, R a b
  · obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hex
    by_cases hsource : ∀ c d, R c d → c = a
    · exact ⟨a, Or.inl hsource⟩

    push Not at hsource
    obtain ⟨c, d, hcd, hca⟩ := hsource
    have hdb : d = b := (h c d a b hcd hab).resolve_left hca
    refine ⟨b, Or.inr ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy
    rcases h x y a b hxy hab with hxa | hyb
    · rcases h x y c d hxy hcd with hxc | hyd
      · exact False.elim (hca (hxc.symm.trans hxa))
      · exact hyd.trans hdb
    · exact hyb
  · obtain ⟨p⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
    refine ⟨p, Or.inl ?_⟩
    intro a b hab
    exact False.elim (hex ⟨a, b, hab⟩)


private lemma isOpen_iff_of_specializationTarget {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [AlexandrovDiscrete X] (p : X)
    (hp : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → x ⤳ y → y = p) (U : Set X) :
    IsOpen U ↔ (p ∈ U → {x | x ≠ p ∧ x ⤳ p} ⊆ U) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hopen hmem x hx
    exact hx.2.mem_open hopen hmem
  · intro hU

    refine isOpen_iff_forall_specializes.mpr ?_
    intro x y hxy hy
    by_cases heq : x = y
    · exact heq ▸ hy
    · have hyp := hp x y heq hxy
      subst y
      exact hU hy ⟨heq, hxy⟩


private lemma isOpen_iff_of_specializationSource {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [AlexandrovDiscrete X] (p : X)
    (hp : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → x ⤳ y → x = p) (U : Set X) :
    IsOpen U ↔ ((U ∩ {y | y ≠ p ∧ p ⤳ y}).Nonempty → p ∈ U) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro hopen ⟨y, hy, hleaf⟩
    exact hleaf.2.mem_open hopen hy
  · intro hU

    refine isOpen_iff_forall_specializes.mpr ?_
    intro x y hxy hy
    by_cases heq : x = y
    · exact heq ▸ hy
    · have hxp := hp x y heq hxy
      subst x
      exact hU ⟨y, hy, Ne.symm heq, hxy⟩







theorem doorSpaceFour_iff (t : TopologicalSpace (Fin 4)) :
    @DoorSpace (Fin 4) t ↔
      ∃ (p : Fin 4) (A : Set (Fin 4)), p ∉ A ∧
        ((∀ U : Set (Fin 4), IsOpen[t] U ↔ (p ∈ U → A ⊆ U)) ∨
         (∀ U : Set (Fin 4), IsOpen[t] U ↔ ((U ∩ A).Nonempty → p ∈ U))) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hdoor

    have hcoordinate (a b c d : Fin 4)
        (hab : a ≠ b ∧ @Specializes _ t a b)
        (hcd : c ≠ d ∧ @Specializes _ t c d) : a = c ∨ b = d := by
      exact doorSpecializationCommonCoordinate hdoor hab.1 hcd.1 hab.2 hcd.2
    obtain ⟨p, hsource | htarget⟩ := relationCommonCoordinateCenter
      (fun a b ↦ a ≠ b ∧ @Specializes _ t a b) hcoordinate
    · refine ⟨p, {y | y ≠ p ∧ @Specializes _ t p y}, ?_, Or.inr ?_⟩
      · exact fun hp ↦ hp.1 rfl
      · intro U
        exact @isOpen_iff_of_specializationSource _ t inferInstance p
          (fun x y hne hxy ↦ hsource x y ⟨hne, hxy⟩) U
    · refine ⟨p, {x | x ≠ p ∧ @Specializes _ t x p}, ?_, Or.inl ?_⟩
      · exact fun hp ↦ hp.1 rfl
      · intro U
        exact @isOpen_iff_of_specializationTarget _ t inferInstance p
          (fun x y hne hxy ↦ htarget x y ⟨hne, hxy⟩) U
  · rintro ⟨p, A, _hpA, htarget | hsource⟩
    · refine ⟨?_⟩
      intro U

      by_cases hpU : p ∈ U
      · right
        refine isOpen_compl_iff.mp ((htarget Uᶜ).mpr ?_)
        intro hpcompl
        exact False.elim (hpcompl hpU)
      · left
        exact (htarget U).mpr (fun hp ↦ False.elim (hpU hp))
    · refine ⟨?_⟩
      intro U

      by_cases hpU : p ∈ U
      · left
        exact (hsource U).mpr (fun _ ↦ hpU)
      · right
        exact isOpen_compl_iff.mp ((hsource Uᶜ).mpr (fun _ ↦ hpU))

private lemma topologyLEOfBasisRefinement {X : Type u}
    {τ₁ τ₂ : TopologicalSpace X} {𝓑₁ 𝓑₂ : Set (Set X)}
    (h₁ : @IsTopologicalBasis X τ₁ 𝓑₁)
    (h₂ : @IsTopologicalBasis X τ₂ 𝓑₂)
    (href : ∀ B ∈ 𝓑₁, ∀ x ∈ B, ∃ B' ∈ 𝓑₂, x ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B) :
    τ₂ ≤ τ₁ := by

  rw [@IsTopologicalBasis.eq_generateFrom X τ₁ 𝓑₁ h₁]
  refine le_generateFrom ?_
  intro B hB
  exact h₂.isOpen_iff.mpr (href B hB)




theorem topology_eq_iff_mutualRefinement {X : Type u} [Nonempty X]
    {τ₁ τ₂ : TopologicalSpace X} {𝓑₁ 𝓑₂ : Set (Set X)}
    (h₁ : @IsTopologicalBasis X τ₁ 𝓑₁)
    (h₂ : @IsTopologicalBasis X τ₂ 𝓑₂) :
    τ₁ = τ₂ ↔
      (∀ B ∈ 𝓑₁, ∀ x ∈ B, ∃ B' ∈ 𝓑₂, x ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B) ∧
      (∀ B ∈ 𝓑₂, ∀ x ∈ B, ∃ B' ∈ 𝓑₁, x ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B) := by
  constructor
  · intro hτ
    subst τ₂

    constructor
    · intro B hB x hx
      exact h₂.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx (h₁.isOpen hB)
    · intro B hB x hx
      exact h₁.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx (h₂.isOpen hB)
  · rintro ⟨href₁, href₂⟩

    exact le_antisymm (topologyLEOfBasisRefinement h₂ h₁ href₂)
      (topologyLEOfBasisRefinement h₁ h₂ href₁)

variable {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)




structure IsFactorCritical (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop where

  nonempty : Nonempty V

  noPerfectMatching : G.IsMatchingFree

  delete_hasPerfectMatching (v : V) :
    ∃ M : (G.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set V)).Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching


def IsFactorCritical.ofVertexDelete (hV : Nonempty V) (hfree : G.IsMatchingFree)
    (hdelete : ∀ v : V, ∃ M : (G.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set V)).Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching) :

def epsilonSubdifferential {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (f : E → EReal) (ε : ℝ) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {v | ∀ z, f x - Real.toEReal ε + Real.toEReal (inner ℝ v (z - x)) ≤ f z}


theorem mem_epsilonSubdifferential {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (f : E → EReal) (ε : ℝ) (x v : E) :
    v ∈ epsilonSubdifferential f ε x ↔
      ∀ z, f x - Real.toEReal ε + Real.toEReal (inner ℝ v (z - x)) ≤ f z := by

  rfl


theorem mem_epsilonSubdifferential_coe {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (g : E → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (x v : E) :
    v ∈ epsilonSubdifferential (fun y => Real.toEReal (g y)) ε x ↔
      ∀ z, (g x - ε) + inner ℝ v (z - x) ≤ g z := by

  rw [mem_epsilonSubdifferential]
  constructor
  · intro h z
    exact (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff).mp <| by
      simpa only [← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_add] using h z
  · intro h z
    have hz : (↑((g x - ε) + inner ℝ v (z - x)) : EReal) ≤ ↑(g z) :=
      EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (h z)
    simpa only [← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_add] using hz
