public import Mathlib.Order.BooleanAlgebra.Basic

public section

universe u

namespace BooleanAlgebra




structure Axioms {B : Type u} (sup inf : B → B → B) (I O : B) : Prop where

  sup_comm (a b : B) : sup a b = sup b a

  inf_comm (a b : B) : inf a b = inf b a

  sup_assoc (a b c : B) : sup a (sup b c) = sup (sup a b) c

  inf_assoc (a b c : B) : inf a (inf b c) = inf (inf a b) c

  inf_sup (a b c : B) : inf a (sup b c) = sup (inf a b) (inf a c)

  sup_inf (a b c : B) : sup a (inf b c) = inf (sup a b) (sup a c)

  sup_zero (a : B) : sup a O = a

  inf_one (a : B) : inf a I = a

  exists_compl (a : B) : ∃ a', sup a a' = I ∧ inf a a' = O

namespace Axioms


def ofBooleanAlgebra (B : Type u) [BooleanAlgebra B] :
    Axioms (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊔ b) (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊓ b) ⊤ ⊥ where

  sup_comm := _root_.sup_comm
  inf_comm := _root_.inf_comm
  sup_assoc := fun a b c ↦ (_root_.sup_assoc a b c).symm
  inf_assoc := fun a b c ↦ (_root_.inf_assoc a b c).symm
  inf_sup := inf_sup_left
  sup_inf := sup_inf_left
  sup_zero := sup_bot_eq
  inf_one := inf_top_eq

  exists_compl := fun a ↦ ⟨aᶜ, sup_compl_eq_top, inf_compl_eq_bot'⟩


theorem identity_spec {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) :
    (∀ a, sup a O = a) ∧ (∀ a, inf a I = a) := by

  exact ⟨h.sup_zero, h.inf_one⟩



private lemma operationIdempotence {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) (a : B) : sup a a = a ∧ inf a a = a := by

  obtain ⟨c, hcSup, hcInf⟩ := h.exists_compl a
  constructor
  · calc
      sup a a = inf (sup a a) I := (h.inf_one _).symm
      _ = inf (sup a a) (sup a c) := congrArg (inf (sup a a)) hcSup.symm
      _ = sup a (inf a c) := (h.sup_inf a a c).symm
      _ = sup a O := congrArg (sup a) hcInf
      _ = a := h.sup_zero a
  · calc
      inf a a = sup (inf a a) O := (h.sup_zero _).symm
      _ = sup (inf a a) (inf a c) := congrArg (sup (inf a a)) hcInf.symm
      _ = inf a (sup a c) := (h.inf_sup a a c).symm
      _ = inf a I := congrArg (inf a) hcSup
      _ = a := h.inf_one a



private lemma absorbingBounds {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) (a : B) : sup a I = I ∧ inf a O = O := by

  obtain ⟨c, hcSup, hcInf⟩ := h.exists_compl a
  constructor
  · calc
      sup a I = sup a (sup a c) := congrArg (sup a) hcSup.symm
      _ = sup (sup a a) c := h.sup_assoc a a c
      _ = sup a c := congrArg (fun x ↦ sup x c) (operationIdempotence h a).1
      _ = I := hcSup
  · calc
      inf a O = inf a (inf a c) := congrArg (inf a) hcInf.symm
      _ = inf (inf a a) c := h.inf_assoc a a c
      _ = inf a c := congrArg (fun x ↦ inf x c) (operationIdempotence h a).2
      _ = O := hcInf



private lemma absorption {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) (a b : B) :
    sup a (inf a b) = a ∧ inf a (sup a b) = a := by

  constructor
  · calc
      sup a (inf a b) = sup (inf a I) (inf a b) :=
        congrArg (fun x ↦ sup x (inf a b)) (h.inf_one a).symm
      _ = inf a (sup I b) := (h.inf_sup a I b).symm
      _ = inf a I := congrArg (inf a) ((h.sup_comm I b).trans (absorbingBounds h b).1)
      _ = a := h.inf_one a
  · calc
      inf a (sup a b) = inf (sup a O) (sup a b) :=
        congrArg (fun x ↦ inf x (sup a b)) (h.sup_zero a).symm
      _ = sup a (inf O b) := (h.sup_inf a O b).symm
      _ = sup a O := congrArg (sup a) ((h.inf_comm O b).trans (absorbingBounds h b).2)
      _ = a := h.sup_zero a



@[implicit_reducible]
private def latticeFromAxioms {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) : Lattice B :=

  @Lattice.mk' B ⟨sup⟩ ⟨inf⟩ h.sup_comm (fun a b c ↦ (h.sup_assoc a b c).symm)
    h.inf_comm (fun a b c ↦ (h.inf_assoc a b c).symm)
    (fun a b ↦ (absorption h a b).1) (fun a b ↦ (absorption h a b).2)



private lemma latticeFromAxiomsOperations {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) :
    ((latticeFromAxioms h).sup, (latticeFromAxioms h).inf) = (sup, inf) := by

  rfl



private lemma complementsExist {B : Type u} [Lattice B] [BoundedOrder B]
    (h : Axioms (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊔ b) (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊓ b) ⊤ ⊥) (a : B) :
    ∃ b : B, IsCompl a b := by

  obtain ⟨b, hbSup, hbInf⟩ := h.exists_compl a
  exact ⟨b, IsCompl.of_eq hbInf hbSup⟩



private lemma booleanAlgebraOfComplementedOperations {B : Type u}
    [DistribLattice B] [BoundedOrder B] [ComplementedLattice B] :
    let b := DistribLattice.booleanAlgebraOfComplemented B
    (b.sup, b.inf, b.top, b.bot) =
      ((fun a b : B ↦ a ⊔ b), (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊓ b), (⊤ : B), (⊥ : B)) := by

  rfl



theorem existsBooleanAlgebra {B : Type u} {sup inf : B → B → B} {I O : B}
    (h : Axioms sup inf I O) :
    ∃ b : BooleanAlgebra B, (b.sup, b.inf, b.top, b.bot) = (sup, inf, I, O) := by



  letI : Lattice B := latticeFromAxioms h


  letI : DistribLattice B :=
    { latticeFromAxioms h with
      le_sup_inf := fun a b c ↦ le_of_eq (h.sup_inf a b c).symm }


  letI : BoundedOrder B :=
    { top := I
      bot := O
      le_top := fun a ↦ sup_eq_right.mp (absorbingBounds h a).1
      bot_le := fun a ↦ sup_eq_right.mp ((h.sup_comm O a).trans (h.sup_zero a)) }


  letI : ComplementedLattice B := ⟨complementsExist h⟩

  refine ⟨DistribLattice.booleanAlgebraOfComplemented B, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = ((fun a b : B ↦ a ⊔ b), (fun a b : B ↦ a ⊓ b), (⊤ : B), (⊥ : B)) :=
      booleanAlgebraOfComplementedOperations
    _ = (sup, inf, I, O) :=
      congrArg (fun p : (B → B → B) × (B → B → B) ↦ (p.1, p.2, I, O))
        (latticeFromAxiomsOperations h)

end Axioms

end BooleanAlgebra

def IsEdgeConnected (G : Graph V E) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ F : Set E, F.encard < k → ∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet,
    Relation.ReflTransGen (G.deleteEdges F).Adj x y


private lemma deleteEdgesInterEdgeSet (G : Graph V E) (F : Set E) :
    G.deleteEdges (F ∩ G.edgeSet) = G.deleteEdges F := by

  simp only [← restrict_edgeSet_sdiff_eq_deleteEdges, Set.sdiff_inter_self_eq_sdiff]



theorem isEdgeConnected_iff_deleteEdges (G : Graph V E)
    (h_edges : G.edgeSet.Finite) (k : ℕ) :
    G.IsEdgeConnected k ↔
      ∀ F : Set E, F ⊆ G.edgeSet → F.ncard < k →
        ∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet,
          Relation.ReflTransGen (G.deleteEdges F).Adj x y := by
  constructor
  · intro h F hF hcard

    have hfinite := h_edges.subset hF
    have hencard : F.encard < k := by
      rw [← hfinite.cast_ncard_eq, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
      exact hcard
    exact h F hencard
  · intro h F hcard x hx y hy

    have hfinite := h_edges.subset (Set.inter_subset_right : F ∩ G.edgeSet ⊆ G.edgeSet)
    have hencard : (F ∩ G.edgeSet).encard < k :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Set.encard_le_encard Set.inter_subset_left) hcard
    have hncard : (F ∩ G.edgeSet).ncard < k := by
      rwa [← hfinite.cast_ncard_eq, ENat.coe_lt_coe] at hencard

    simpa only [deleteEdgesInterEdgeSet] using
      h (F ∩ G.edgeSet) Set.inter_subset_right hncard x hx y hy

end Graph

@[expose] public section

namespace MaxForm

variable {E1 : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E1] [NormedSpace ℝ E1]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E1]
variable {E2 : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E2] [NormedSpace ℝ E2]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E2]



noncomputable def objective (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) : E1 → ℝ :=
  fun x ↦ fhat x + sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2)


lemma objective_apply (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) (x : E1) :
    objective Q2 fhat phi A x = fhat x + sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2) := by

  rfl


theorem objective_congr {Q1 : Set E1} {Q2 : Set E2} {fhat ghat : E1 → ℝ}
    {phi psi : E2 → ℝ} (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hf : Set.EqOn fhat ghat Q1) (hphi : Set.EqOn phi psi Q2) :
    Set.EqOn (objective Q2 fhat phi A) (objective Q2 ghat psi A) Q1 := by

  intro x hx
  have himage : (fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2 =
      (fun u ↦ A x u - psi u) '' Q2 := by
    refine Set.image_congr ?_
    intro u hu
    rw [hphi hu]
  rw [objective_apply, objective_apply, hf hx, himage]


noncomputable def optimalValue (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ)
    (phi : E2 → ℝ) (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) : ℝ :=
  sInf (objective Q2 fhat phi A '' Q1)


lemma optimalValue_def (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ)
    (phi : E2 → ℝ) (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) :
    optimalValue Q1 Q2 fhat phi A = sInf (objective Q2 fhat phi A '' Q1) := by

  rfl


private lemma continuousPairing (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) :
    Continuous (fun p : E1 × E2 ↦ A p.1 p.2) := by

  let B : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap.comp A

  exact (B.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp continuous_fst).clm_apply continuous_snd


private lemma bddAboveDualImage (Q : Set E2) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) (hQ : IsCompact Q)
    (hphi : ContinuousOn phi Q) (x : E1) :
    BddAbove ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q) := by

  exact hQ.bddAbove_image ((A x).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.continuousOn.sub hphi)


private lemma continuousDualSup (Q : Set E2) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) (hQ : IsCompact Q)
    (hphi : ContinuousOn phi Q) :
    Continuous (fun x ↦ sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q)) := by

  have hpayoff : Continuous (fun p : E1 × Q ↦ A p.1 p.2 - phi p.2) :=
    ((continuousPairing A).comp
      (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))).sub
      (hphi.restrict.comp continuous_snd)

  have hsup := (isCompact_iff_isCompact_univ.mp hQ).continuous_sSup
    (f := fun x (u : Q) ↦ A x u - phi u) hpayoff

  simp only [Set.image_univ] at hsup
  simpa only [Set.image_eq_range] using hsup


private lemma convexDualSup (S : Set E1) (Q : Set E2) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2) (hS : Convex ℝ S) (hQ : Q.Nonempty)
    (hbdd : ∀ x ∈ S, BddAbove ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q)) :
    ConvexOn ℝ S (fun x ↦ sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q)) := by
  refine ⟨hS, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab

  refine csSup_le (hQ.image _) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  have hleft := le_csSup (hbdd x hx) (Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) hu)
  have hright := le_csSup (hbdd y hy) (Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun u ↦ A y u - phi u) hu)
  have hpenalty : (a + b) * phi u = phi u := by
    rw [hab, one_mul]
  have haffine : A (a • x + b • y) u - phi u =
      a * (A x u - phi u) + b * (A y u - phi u) := by
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith only [hpenalty]

  calc
    A (a • x + b • y) u - phi u =
        a * (A x u - phi u) + b * (A y u - phi u) := haffine
    _ ≤ a * sSup ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q) +
        b * sSup ((fun u ↦ A y u - phi u) '' Q) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hleft ha)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hright hb)


theorem continuousOn_objective (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ)
    (phi : E2 → ℝ) (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hQ2_closed : IsClosed Q2) (hQ2_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q2)
    (hQ2_nonempty : Q2.Nonempty) (hphi : ContinuousOn phi Q2)
    (hfhat : ContinuousOn fhat Q1) :
    ContinuousOn (objective Q2 fhat phi A) Q1 := by

  have hcompact : IsCompact Q2 :=
    Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨hQ2_closed, hQ2_bounded⟩

  exact hfhat.add (continuousDualSup Q2 phi A hcompact hphi).continuousOn


theorem convexOn_objective (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ)
    (phi : E2 → ℝ) (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hQ2_closed : IsClosed Q2) (hQ2_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q2)
    (hQ2_nonempty : Q2.Nonempty) (hphi : ContinuousOn phi Q2)
    (hfhat : ConvexOn ℝ Q1 fhat) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Q1 (objective Q2 fhat phi A) := by

  have hcompact : IsCompact Q2 :=
    Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨hQ2_closed, hQ2_bounded⟩
  have hbdd : ∀ x ∈ Q1, BddAbove ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2) :=
    fun x _ ↦ bddAboveDualImage Q2 phi A hcompact hphi x

  exact hfhat.add (convexDualSup Q1 Q2 phi A hfhat.1 hQ2_nonempty hbdd)

end MaxForm

private lemma neighborsMemSupportOfMaximumLength {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hmax : ∀ (x y : V) (q : G.Walk x y), q.IsPath → q.length ≤ p.length) :
    ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w ∈ p.support := by
  classical

  intro w hw
  by_contra hmissing
  have hlong := hmax w b (cons hw.symm p) (hp.cons hmissing)
  simp only [length_cons] at hlong
  omega


private lemma degreeLeLengthOfNeighborsMemSupport {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} [Fintype (G.neighborSet a)] (p : G.Walk a b)
    (hcover : ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w ∈ p.support) : G.degree a ≤ p.length := by
  classical

  have hsubset : insert a (G.neighborFinset a) ⊆ p.support.toFinset := by
    intro w hw
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hw with rfl | hw
    · exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr p.start_mem_support
    · exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (hcover w ((G.mem_neighborFinset a w).mp hw))
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (G.notMem_neighborFinset_self a),
    G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hcard
  have hsupport := List.toFinset_card_le p.support
  rw [length_support] at hsupport
  omega



private lemma existsAdjGetVertGe {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} [Fintype (G.neighborSet a)] (p : G.Walk a b)
    (hcover : ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w ∈ p.support)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hdegree : k ≤ G.degree a) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, k ≤ i ∧ i ≤ p.length ∧ G.Adj a (p.getVert i) := by
  classical

  by_contra hnone
  have hprefix : ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w ∈ (p.take (k - 1)).support := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨i, hiw, hilength⟩ := mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp (hcover w hw)
    have hi : i ≤ k - 1 := by
      by_contra hlarge
      have hki : k ≤ i := by omega
      exact hnone ⟨i, hki, hilength, hiw.symm ▸ hw⟩
    have hmem := (p.take (k - 1)).getVert_mem_support i
    simpa only [take_getVert, Nat.min_eq_right hi, hiw] using hmem
  have hbound := (p.take (k - 1)).degreeLeLengthOfNeighborsMemSupport hprefix
  rw [take_length] at hbound
  have hmin : min (k - 1) p.length ≤ k - 1 := Nat.min_le_left _ _
  omega


private lemma isCycleConsReverseOfIsPath {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} (q : G.Walk a b) (hq : q.IsPath) (hlength : 2 ≤ q.length)
    (h : G.Adj a b) : (cons h q.reverse).IsCycle := by

  refine isCycle_iff_isPath_tail_and_le_length.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [tail_cons]
    exact (isPath_copy _ _ _).mpr hq.reverse
  · simp only [length_cons, length_reverse]
    omega

end SimpleGraph.Walk



theorem existsPath_length_minDegree {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty V] :
    ∃ (u v : V) (p : G.Walk u v), p.IsPath ∧ p.length = G.minDegree := by

  obtain ⟨a, b, p, hp, hmax⟩ := Walk.exists_isPath_forall_isPath_length_le_length G
  have hcover := p.neighborsMemSupportOfMaximumLength hp hmax
  have hlength : G.minDegree ≤ p.length :=
    (G.minDegree_le_degree a).trans (p.degreeLeLengthOfNeighborsMemSupport hcover)

  refine ⟨a, p.getVert G.minDegree, p.take G.minDegree, hp.take _, ?_⟩
  rw [Walk.take_length, Nat.min_eq_left hlength]




theorem existsCycle_length_ge_minDegree {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) :
    ∃ (v : V) (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle ∧ G.minDegree + 1 ≤ c.length := by

  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl hempty =>
    have hzero := G.minDegree_of_subsingleton
    omega
  | inr hnonempty =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, p, hp, hmax⟩ := Walk.exists_isPath_forall_isPath_length_le_length G
    have hcover := p.neighborsMemSupportOfMaximumLength hp hmax
    have hpositive : 0 < G.minDegree := by omega

    obtain ⟨i, hδi, hi, hadj⟩ :=
      p.existsAdjGetVertGe hcover G.minDegree hpositive (G.minDegree_le_degree a)
    have hprefixLength : (p.take i).length = i := by
      rw [Walk.take_length, Nat.min_eq_left hi]
    have htwo : 2 ≤ (p.take i).length := by
      rw [hprefixLength]
      exact hδ.trans hδi
    refine ⟨a, Walk.cons hadj (p.take i).reverse,
      (p.take i).isCycleConsReverseOfIsPath (hp.take i) htwo hadj, ?_⟩
    simp only [Walk.length_cons, Walk.length_reverse, hprefixLength]
    omega

@[expose] public section

universe u

open SimpleGraph SimpleGraph.Path

variable {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}


private lemma matchingEdgeFiberCard {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (e : M.edgeSet) : Cardinal.mk (hM.toEdge ⁻¹' {e}) = 2 := by
  classical

  rcases e with ⟨⟨x, y⟩, he⟩
  rw [hM.toEdge_preimage_singleton he, Cardinal.mk_insert, Cardinal.mk_singleton]
  · exact one_add_one_eq_two
  · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Subtype.mk.injEq] using he.ne


private lemma matchingCardVerts {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching) :
    Cardinal.mk M.verts = 2 * Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet := by

  calc
    Cardinal.mk M.verts = Cardinal.mk (Σ e : M.edgeSet, {v // hM.toEdge v = e}) :=
      (Cardinal.mk_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv hM.toEdge)).symm
    _ = Cardinal.sum (fun _ : M.edgeSet ↦ (2 : Cardinal)) := by
      rw [Cardinal.mk_sigma]
      congr 1
      funext e
      exact matchingEdgeFiberCard hM e
    _ = 2 * Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet := by
      rw [Cardinal.sum_const', mul_comm]


private lemma matchingInduceClosed {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (C : Set V) (hC : ∀ ⦃v w⦄, M.Adj v w → v ∈ C → w ∈ C) :
    (M.induce (M.verts ∩ C)).IsMatching := by

  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨w, hvw, hw⟩ := hM hv.1
  refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨hv, ⟨hvw.snd_mem, hC hvw hv.2⟩, hvw⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact hw z hz.2.2


private lemma matchingSupIsAlternating {M N : G.Subgraph}
    (hM : M.IsMatching) (hN : N.IsMatching) :
    (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).IsAlternating M.spanningCoe := by

  intro v w z hwz hvw hvz
  constructor
  · intro hMw hMz
    exact hwz (hM.eq_of_adj_left hMw hMz)
  · intro hMz
    rcases hvw with hMw | hNw
    · exact hMw
    · rcases hvz with hMz' | hNz
      · exact False.elim (hMz hMz')
      · exact False.elim (hwz (hN.eq_of_adj_left hNw hNz))


private lemma matchingFiniteVerts {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (hE : M.edgeSet.Finite) : M.verts.Finite := by
  classical

  rw [hM.verts_eq_biUnion_edgeSet]
  refine hE.biUnion fun e _ ↦ ?_
  have he : (e : Set V) = (e.toFinset : Set V) := by
    ext v
    exact Sym2.mem_toFinset.symm
  rw [he]
  exact e.toFinset.finite_toSet


private lemma finiteSetCard {s : Set V} (hs : s.Finite) :
    Cardinal.mk s = (hs.toFinset.card : Cardinal) := by

  rw [@Set.Finite.card_toFinset V s hs.fintype hs]
  exact @Cardinal.mk_fintype s hs.fintype


private lemma matchingFiniteEven {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (hV : M.verts.Finite) : Even hV.toFinset.card := by

  exact @Subgraph.IsMatching.even_card V G M hV.fintype hM


private lemma existsLargerFiber {W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] (f : V → W) (s t : Finset V)
    (hlt : s.card < t.card) :
    ∃ c, (s.filter (fun v ↦ f v = c)).card < (t.filter (fun v ↦ f v = c)).card := by
  classical

  let cs := (s ∪ t).image f
  have hs : (s : Set V).MapsTo f cs := by
    intro v hv
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem f (Finset.mem_union_left t hv)
  have ht : (t : Set V).MapsTo f cs := by
    intro v hv
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem f (Finset.mem_union_right s hv)
  by_contra! h
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := cs) (fun c _ ↦ h c)
  rw [← Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise ht,
    ← Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hs] at hsum
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) hsum


private lemma existsPairOfEvenSurplus (s t : Finset V) (hs : Even s.card)
    (ht : Even t.card) (hlt : s.card < t.card) :
    ∃ x ∈ t, ∃ y ∈ t, x ≠ y ∧ x ∉ s ∧ y ∉ s := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ht
  have hinter := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.inter_subset_right : t ∩ s ⊆ s)
  have hsplit := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter t s
  have hdiff : 1 < (t \ s).card := by omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hne⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hdiff
  exact ⟨x, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).1, y, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).1,
    hne, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).2, (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).2⟩


private lemma matchingInUnionComponent {M N : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (c : (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).ConnectedComponent) :
    (M.induce (M.verts ∩ c.supp)).IsMatching := by

  refine matchingInduceClosed hM c.supp ?_
  intro v w hvw hv
  exact c.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp hv (Or.inl hvw)


private lemma componentIntersectionFinset {H : SimpleGraph V}
    [DecidableEq H.ConnectedComponent] {s : Set V}
    (hs : s.Finite) (c : H.ConnectedComponent) :
    (hs.subset Set.inter_subset_left : (s ∩ c.supp).Finite).toFinset =
      hs.toFinset.filter (fun v ↦ H.connectedComponentMk v = c) := by
  classical

  ext v
  simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_inter_iff, Finset.mem_filter,
    ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff]



private lemma existsUnmatchedPairInUnion {M N : G.Subgraph}
    (hM : M.IsMatching) (hN : N.IsMatching)
    (hME : M.edgeSet.Finite) (hNE : N.edgeSet.Finite)
    (hlt : Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet < Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet) :
    ∃ x y, x ∉ M.support ∧ y ∉ M.support ∧ x ≠ y ∧
      (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).Reachable x y := by
  classical

  have hMV := matchingFiniteVerts hM hME
  have hNV := matchingFiniteVerts hN hNE
  have hmcard := matchingCardVerts hM
  have hncard := matchingCardVerts hN
  rw [finiteSetCard hMV, finiteSetCard hME] at hmcard
  rw [finiteSetCard hNV, finiteSetCard hNE] at hncard
  have hmnat : hMV.toFinset.card = 2 * hME.toFinset.card := by
    exact Nat.cast_inj.mp (hmcard.trans (Nat.cast_mul 2 _).symm)
  have hnnat : hNV.toFinset.card = 2 * hNE.toFinset.card := by
    exact Nat.cast_inj.mp (hncard.trans (Nat.cast_mul 2 _).symm)
  rw [finiteSetCard hME, finiteSetCard hNE, Nat.cast_lt] at hlt
  have hvlt : hMV.toFinset.card < hNV.toFinset.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := existsLargerFiber
    (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).connectedComponentMk _ _ hvlt

  have hMc := matchingInUnionComponent (N := N) hM c
  have hNc : (N.induce (N.verts ∩ c.supp)).IsMatching := by
    refine matchingInduceClosed hN c.supp ?_
    intro v w hvw hv
    exact c.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp hv (Or.inr hvw)
  have hcm := matchingFiniteEven hMc (hMV.subset Set.inter_subset_left)
  have hcn := matchingFiniteEven hNc (hNV.subset Set.inter_subset_left)
  have hcm' := (congrArg (fun s : Finset V ↦ Even s.card)
    (componentIntersectionFinset hMV c)).mp hcm
  have hcn' := (congrArg (fun s : Finset V ↦ Even s.card)
    (componentIntersectionFinset hNV c)).mp hcn
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, hxm, hym⟩ := existsPairOfEvenSurplus _ _ hcm' hcn' hc
  have hxC : x ∈ c.supp := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
  have hyC : y ∈ c.supp := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
  refine ⟨x, y, ?_, ?_, hxy, c.reachable_of_mem_supp hxC hyC⟩
  · rw [hM.support_eq_verts]
    intro hxM
    exact hxm (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hMV.mem_toFinset.mpr hxM, hxC⟩)
  · rw [hM.support_eq_verts]
    intro hyM
    exact hym (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hMV.mem_toFinset.mpr hyM, hyC⟩)



private lemma augmentingPathOfUnionReachable {M N : G.Subgraph}
    (hM : M.IsMatching) (hN : N.IsMatching) {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∉ M.support) (hy : y ∉ M.support) (hne : x ≠ y)
    (hr : (M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe).Reachable x y) :
    ∃ p : G.Path x y, IsAugmenting M p := by

  have hle : M.spanningCoe ⊔ N.spanningCoe ≤ G :=
    sup_le M.spanningCoe_le N.spanningCoe_le
  refine hr.elim_path fun q ↦ ?_
  let p : G.Path x y := ⟨q.val.mapLe hle, q.property.mapLe hle⟩
  refine ⟨p, IsAugmenting.ofAlternatingFrom M p
    (ofIsAlternating Set.univ M p ⟨Set.mem_univ x, hx⟩ ?_) hy hne⟩
  intro v w z hwz hvw hvz
  exact matchingSupIsAlternating hM hN hwz
    ((Walk.adj_toSubgraph_mapLe hle).mp hvw).adj_sub
    ((Walk.adj_toSubgraph_mapLe hle).mp hvz).adj_sub


private lemma matchingToEdgeOfMem {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (v : M.verts) (e : M.edgeSet) (hv : v.val ∈ e.val) : hM.toEdge v = e := by

  rcases e with ⟨⟨x, y⟩, he⟩
  rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hv with hx | hy
  · subst x
    exact hM.toEdge_eq_of_adj he
  · subst y
    exact (hM.toEdge_eq_of_adj he.symm).trans (Subtype.ext (Sym2.eq_swap ..))



private lemma matchingCardLeVerts {M N : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsMatching)
    (hN : N.IsMatching)
    (hcover : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, N.Adj x y → x ∈ M.support ∨ y ∈ M.support) :
    Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet ≤ Cardinal.mk M.verts := by
  classical

  have hchoose : ∀ e : N.edgeSet, ∃ v : V, v ∈ M.verts ∧ v ∈ e.val := by
    rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, he⟩
    rcases hcover he with hx | hy
    · exact ⟨x, hM.support_eq_verts ▸ hx, Sym2.mem_mk_left ..⟩
    · exact ⟨y, hM.support_eq_verts ▸ hy, Sym2.mem_mk_right ..⟩
  choose f hfM hfE using hchoose
  let F : N.edgeSet → M.verts := fun e ↦ ⟨f e, hfM e⟩
  refine Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective (f := F) ?_
  intro e e' hee'
  have hval : f e = f e' := congrArg Subtype.val hee'
  have heN := N.mem_verts_of_mem_edge e.property (hfE e)
  have heN' : f e ∈ e'.val := hval.symm ▸ hfE e'
  exact (matchingToEdgeOfMem hN ⟨f e, heN⟩ e (hfE e)).symm.trans
    (matchingToEdgeOfMem hN ⟨f e, heN⟩ e' heN')


private lemma existsAugmentingPathOfCardinalLt {M N : G.Subgraph}
    (hM : M.IsMatching) (hN : N.IsMatching)
    (hlt : Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet < Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet) :
    ∃ (x y : V) (p : G.Path x y), IsAugmenting M p := by
  classical

  by_cases hcover : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, N.Adj x y → x ∈ M.support ∨ y ∈ M.support
  · have hbound := matchingCardLeVerts hM hN hcover
    rw [matchingCardVerts hM] at hbound
    by_cases hME : M.edgeSet.Finite
    · have hNE : N.edgeSet.Finite := by
        apply Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite.mp
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt hbound ?_
        rw [finiteSetCard hME, ← Nat.cast_ofNat, ← Nat.cast_mul]
        exact Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hr⟩ := existsUnmatchedPairInUnion hM hN hME hNE hlt
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := augmentingPathOfUnionReachable hM hN hx hy hxy hr
      exact ⟨x, y, p, hp⟩
    ·
      have hinf : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet := by
        exact le_of_not_gt (fun h ↦ hME (Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite.mp h))
      rw [Cardinal.mul_eq_right hinf
        (Cardinal.ofNat_le_aleph0.trans hinf) (OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero 2)] at hbound
      exact False.elim ((not_le_of_gt hlt) hbound)
  · push Not at hcover
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩ := hcover
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := augmentingPathOfUnionReachable hM hN hx hy hxy.ne
      (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable (Or.inr hxy))
    exact ⟨x, y, p, hp⟩



private lemma alternatingWalkEndpointParts {M : G.Subgraph} {x y : V}
    (p : G.Walk x y) :
    p.IsPath → p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating M.spanningCoe →
    y ∉ M.support → ¬p.Nil →
    ∀ (A B : Set V), G.IsBipartiteWith A B → x ∈ A →
      (¬M.Adj x p.snd → y ∈ B) ∧ (M.Adj x p.snd → y ∈ A) := by

  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro _ _ _ hnil
    exact False.elim (hnil Walk.nil_nil)
  | @cons x z y hxz q ih =>
    intro hp halt hend _ A B hAB hx
    have hz := hAB.mem_of_mem_adj hx hxz
    cases q with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨fun _ ↦ hz, ?_⟩
      intro hM
      exact False.elim (hend ⟨x, hM.symm⟩)
    | @cons z w y hzw r =>
      have hqp := (Walk.cons_isPath_iff hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).mp hp
      have hqa : (Walk.cons hzw r).toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating
          M.spanningCoe := halt.mono (Subgraph.spanningCoe_le_of_le le_sup_right)
      have htail := ih hqp.1 hqa hend Walk.not_nil_cons B A hAB.symm hz
      simp only [Walk.snd_cons] at htail
      have hxw : x ≠ w := by
        intro hxw
        apply hqp.2
        rw [hxw, Walk.support_cons]
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem z r.start_mem_support
      have hzx : (Walk.cons hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).toSubgraph.Adj z x :=
        ((Walk.cons hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).toSubgraph_adj_snd Walk.not_nil_cons).symm
      have hzw' : (Walk.cons hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).toSubgraph.Adj z w := by
        apply (le_sup_right : (Walk.cons hzw r).toSubgraph ≤
          (Walk.cons hxz (Walk.cons hzw r)).toSubgraph).2
        simpa only [Walk.snd_cons] using
          (Walk.cons hzw r).toSubgraph_adj_snd Walk.not_nil_cons
      have hphase := halt hxw hzx hzw'
      constructor
      · intro hfirst
        apply htail.2
        by_contra hnext
        exact hfirst (hphase.mpr hnext).symm
      · intro hfirst
        exact htail.1 (hphase.mp hfirst.symm)


private lemma augmentingPathBipartiteEndpoints {A B : Set V}
    (hAB : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) {M : G.Subgraph} {x y : V}
    {p : G.Path x y} (h : IsAugmenting M p) :
    (x ∈ A ∧ y ∈ B) ∨ (x ∈ B ∧ y ∈ A) := by

  have hnil : ¬p.val.Nil := Walk.not_nil_of_ne h.nontrivial
  have hfirst : ¬M.Adj x p.val.snd := by
    intro hx
    exact h.start_mem.2 ⟨p.val.snd, hx⟩
  rcases hAB.mem_of_adj (p.val.adj_snd hnil) with hparts | hparts
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hparts.1, (alternatingWalkEndpointParts p.val p.property
      h.alternating h.end_unmatched hnil A B hAB hparts.1).1 hfirst⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hparts.1, (alternatingWalkEndpointParts p.val p.property
      h.alternating h.end_unmatched hnil B A hAB.symm hparts.1).1 hfirst⟩




theorem existsAugmentingPath_bipartite (A B : Set V) (M : G.Subgraph)
    (h_bipartite : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) (h_matching : M.IsMatching)
    (h_suboptimal : ∃ N : G.Subgraph,
      N.IsMatching ∧ Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet < Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet) :
    ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ B, ∃ p : G.Path x y, IsAugmenting M p := by

  obtain ⟨N, hN, hlt⟩ := h_suboptimal
  obtain ⟨x, y, p, hp⟩ := existsAugmentingPathOfCardinalLt h_matching hN hlt
  rcases augmentingPathBipartiteEndpoints h_bipartite hp with hparts | hparts
  · exact ⟨x, hparts.1, y, hparts.2, p, hp⟩
  · exact ⟨y, hparts.2, x, hparts.1, p.reverse, hp.reverse⟩




theorem existsAugmentingPath (M : G.Subgraph) (h_matching : M.IsMatching)
    (h_suboptimal : ∃ N : G.Subgraph,
      N.IsMatching ∧ Cardinal.mk M.edgeSet < Cardinal.mk N.edgeSet) :
    ∃ (x y : V) (p : G.Path x y), IsAugmenting M p := by

  obtain ⟨N, hN, hlt⟩ := h_suboptimal
  exact existsAugmentingPathOfCardinalLt h_matching hN hlt

variable {V : Type u} {E : Type v}



structure IsTree (G : Graph V E) : Prop where

  vertexSet_nonempty : G.vertexSet.Nonempty

  connected : ∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet, Relation.ReflTransGen G.Adj x y

  edge_isBridge : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧
    ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b ↦ ∃ f, f ≠ e ∧ G.IsLink f a b) x y


def isTreeOfBridges (G : Graph V E) (h_nonempty : G.vertexSet.Nonempty)
    (h_connected : ∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet,
      Relation.ReflTransGen G.Adj x y)
    (h_bridges : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧
      ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b ↦ ∃ f, f ≠ e ∧ G.IsLink f a b) x y) :
    G.IsTree :=
  { vertexSet_nonempty := h_nonempty
    connected := h_connected
    edge_isBridge := h_bridges }


theorem isTree_iff (G : Graph V E) :
    G.IsTree ↔ G.vertexSet.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ x ∈ G.vertexSet, ∀ y ∈ G.vertexSet, Relation.ReflTransGen G.Adj x y) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧
        ¬Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b ↦ ∃ f, f ≠ e ∧ G.IsLink f a b) x y) := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.vertexSet_nonempty, h.connected, h.edge_isBridge⟩
  · rintro ⟨h_nonempty, h_connected, h_bridges⟩
    exact isTreeOfBridges G h_nonempty h_connected h_bridges


def crossEdges (G : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) : Set E :=
  {e | ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧ ¬P.Rel x y}


theorem mem_crossEdges (G : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) (e : E) :
    e ∈ G.crossEdges P ↔ ∃ x y, G.IsLink e x y ∧ ¬P.Rel x y := by

  rfl


theorem crossEdges_subset (G : Graph V E) (P : Partition G.vertexSet) :
    G.crossEdges P ⊆ G.edgeSet := by

  rintro e ⟨x, y, hxy, hne⟩
  exact hxy.edge_mem

end Graph

theorem projection_inner_le_zero {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x z : H) (hz : z ∈ C) :
    inner ℝ (x - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x)
      (z - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x) ≤ 0 := by

  have hp_mem : projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x ∈ C :=
    projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hp_min : ‖x - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x‖ =
      ⨅ w : C, ‖x - w‖ := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, infDist_eq_iInf] using
      dist_projection_eq_infDist C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  exact (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hCconvex hp_mem).mp hp_min z hz


theorem projection_nonexpansive {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x y : H) :
    ‖projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y‖ ≤
      ‖x - y‖ := by

  let p := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  let q := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y
  have hp_mem : p ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hq_mem : q ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y
  have hp_vi : inner ℝ (x - p) (q - p) ≤ 0 :=
    projection_inner_le_zero C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x q hq_mem
  have hq_vi : inner ℝ (y - q) (p - q) ≤ 0 :=
    projection_inner_le_zero C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y p hp_mem
  have hp_vi' : 0 ≤ inner ℝ (x - p) (p - q) := by
    have hneg : q - p = -(p - q) := by abel
    rw [hneg, inner_neg_right] at hp_vi
    linarith
  have hdecomp : x - y = (x - p) - (y - q) + (p - q) := by
    abel
  have hinner : inner ℝ (x - y) (p - q) =
      inner ℝ (x - p) (p - q) - inner ℝ (y - q) (p - q) + ‖p - q‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hdecomp, inner_add_left, inner_sub_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hnorm_sq_le : ‖p - q‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (x - y) (p - q) := by
    rw [hinner]
    nlinarith
  have hcs := abs_real_inner_le_norm (x - y) (p - q)
  have hprod : ‖p - q‖ * ‖p - q‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ * ‖p - q‖ := by
    calc
      ‖p - q‖ * ‖p - q‖ = ‖p - q‖ ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ inner ℝ (x - y) (p - q) := hnorm_sq_le
      _ ≤ ‖x - y‖ * ‖p - q‖ := (le_abs_self _).trans hcs

  by_cases hzero : ‖p - q‖ = 0
  · have hzero' : ‖projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x -
        projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y‖ = 0 := by
      simpa [p, q] using hzero
    simp [hzero']
  · have hpos : 0 < ‖p - q‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hzero)
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hprod hpos


theorem infDist_sq_remainder_bound {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x y : H) :
    |(infDist y C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      2 * inner ℝ (x - projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x) (y - x)| ≤ ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by

  let p := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  let q := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y
  have hp_mem : p ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hq_mem : q ∈ C := projection_mem C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y
  have hdx : infDist x C = ‖x - p‖ := by
    simpa only [p, dist_eq_norm] using
      (dist_projection_eq_infDist C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x).symm
  have hdy : infDist y C = ‖y - q‖ := by
    simpa only [q, dist_eq_norm] using
      (dist_projection_eq_infDist C hCne hCclosed hCconvex y).symm
  have hcompare_y : (infDist y C) ^ 2 ≤ dist y p ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (infDist_nonneg) dist_nonneg).mpr (infDist_le_dist_of_mem hp_mem)
  have hsplit_y : y - p = (x - p) + (y - x) := by
    abel
  have hexpand_y : dist y p ^ 2 =
      ‖x - p‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ (x - p) (y - x) + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hsplit_y, norm_add_sq_real]
  have hupper : (infDist y C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      2 * inner ℝ (x - p) (y - x) ≤ ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hdx]
    have hcompare_y' := hcompare_y
    rw [hexpand_y] at hcompare_y'
    linarith

  have hcompare_x : (infDist x C) ^ 2 ≤ dist x q ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (infDist_nonneg) dist_nonneg).mpr (infDist_le_dist_of_mem hq_mem)
  have hsplit_x : x - q = (y - q) - (y - x) := by
    abel
  have hexpand_x : dist x q ^ 2 =
      ‖y - q‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (y - q) (y - x) + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hsplit_x, norm_sub_sq_real]
  have hinner_diff : inner ℝ (y - q) (y - x) - inner ℝ (x - p) (y - x) =
      inner ℝ (p - q) (y - x) + ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hsplit : (y - q) - (x - p) = (p - q) + (y - x) := by
      abel
    rw [← inner_sub_left, hsplit, inner_add_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hproj : ‖p - q‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ := by
    calc
      ‖p - q‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := projection_nonexpansive C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x y
      _ = ‖y - x‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
  have hinner_lower : -(‖p - q‖ * ‖y - x‖) ≤ inner ℝ (p - q) (y - x) :=
    neg_le_of_abs_le (abs_real_inner_le_norm (p - q) (y - x))
  have hproj_mul : ‖p - q‖ * ‖y - x‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ * ‖y - x‖ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hproj (norm_nonneg _)
  have hlower : -‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (infDist y C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      2 * inner ℝ (x - p) (y - x) := by
    rw [hdx, hdy]
    have hcompare_x' := hcompare_x
    rw [hdx, hexpand_x] at hcompare_x'
    nlinarith [hcompare_x', hinner_diff, hinner_lower, hproj_mul]

  rw [abs_le]
  exact ⟨hlower, hupper⟩


theorem hasGradientAt_infDist_sq {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (C : Set H) (hCne : C.Nonempty)
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconvex : Convex ℝ C) (x : H) :
    HasGradientAt (fun y : H ↦ (Metric.infDist y C) ^ 2)
      (2 • (x - Metric.projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x)) x := by

  rw [hasGradientAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : H) hε] with h hh
  have hball : dist h 0 < ε := by simpa using hh
  have hnorm : ‖h‖ < ε := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] using hball
  let p := projection C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x
  have hrem := infDist_sq_remainder_bound C hCne hCclosed hCconvex x (x + h)
  have hnat : (2 : ℝ) • (x - p) = 2 • (x - p) :=
    Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ 2 (x - p)
  have hsmul : inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h = 2 * inner ℝ (x - p) h := by
    rw [← hnat]
    exact real_inner_smul_left (x - p) h 2
  have hrem' : |(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h| ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      |(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
          inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h| =
        |(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
          2 * inner ℝ (x - p) h| := by rw [hsmul]
      _ ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by simpa only [p, add_sub_cancel_left] using hrem
  have hbound : ‖(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
      inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h‖ ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hrem'
  calc
    ‖(infDist (x + h) C) ^ 2 - (infDist x C) ^ 2 -
        inner ℝ (2 • (x - p)) h‖ ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := hbound
    _ ≤ ε * ‖h‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg h]

end Metric

private lemma SimpleGraph.Reachable.existsAdjacentLowerDist
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {root v : V}
    (hv : G.Reachable root v) (hne : v ≠ root) :
    ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ G.dist root w < G.dist root v := by

  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hv.symm.exists_walk_length_eq_dist
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, q, rfl⟩ := p.exists_eq_cons_of_ne hne
  refine ⟨w, hadj, ?_⟩
  calc
    G.dist root w = G.dist w root := G.dist_comm
    _ ≤ q.length := G.dist_le q
    _ < (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hadj q).length := Nat.lt_succ_self _
    _ = G.dist v root := hp
    _ = G.dist root v := G.dist_comm


private lemma SimpleGraph.connectedInduceOfDecreasingRank
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : Set V} {root : V}
    (rank : V → ℕ) (hroot : root ∈ s)
    (hstep : ∀ v ∈ s, v ≠ root → ∃ w ∈ s, G.Adj v w ∧ rank w < rank v) :
    (G.induce s).Connected := by

  have reachesRoot : ∀ k (v : s), rank v = k →
      (G.induce s).Reachable v ⟨root, hroot⟩ := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro v hv
      by_cases heq : v.val = root
      · have hvroot : v = ⟨root, hroot⟩ := Subtype.ext heq
        rw [hvroot]
      · obtain ⟨w, hw, hadj, hrank⟩ := hstep v v.property heq
        have hlt : rank w < k := by
          rwa [← hv]
        have hedge : (G.induce s).Adj v ⟨w, hw⟩ := SimpleGraph.induce_adj.mpr hadj
        exact hedge.reachable.trans (ih (rank w) hlt ⟨w, hw⟩ rfl)

  refine (SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable _).mpr ⟨⟨root, hroot⟩, ?_⟩
  intro v
  exact (reachesRoot (rank v) v rfl).symm


private lemma SimpleGraph.Connected.connectedInduceImageIicOfMonotoneDist
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.Connected) (root : V)
    {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ V) (hmono : Monotone (fun j ↦ G.dist root (e j)))
    (i : Fin n) : (G.induce (e '' Set.Iic i)).Connected := by

  have hroot : root ∈ e '' Set.Iic i := by
    rcases le_total (e.symm root) i with hle | hle
    · exact ⟨e.symm root, hle, e.apply_symm_apply root⟩
    · have hdist := hmono hle
      simp only [e.apply_symm_apply, SimpleGraph.dist_self, Nat.le_zero] at hdist
      exact ⟨i, Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl, (hG.dist_eq_zero_iff.mp hdist).symm⟩
  refine SimpleGraph.connectedInduceOfDecreasingRank (G.dist root) hroot ?_

  intro v hv hne
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨w, hadj, hdist⟩ := (hG root (e j)).existsAdjacentLowerDist hne
  have hdistIndex : G.dist root (e (e.symm w)) < G.dist root (e j) := by
    simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hdist
  have hindex : e.symm w < j := hmono.reflect_lt hdistIndex
  exact ⟨w, ⟨e.symm w, hindex.le.trans hj, e.apply_symm_apply w⟩, hadj, hdist⟩





theorem SimpleGraph.Connected.existsConnectedEnumeration
    {V : Type u} [Finite V] {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.Connected) :
    ∃ e : Fin (Nat.card V) ≃ V, ∀ i : Fin (Nat.card V),
      (G.induce (e '' Set.Iic i)).Connected := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨root⟩ := hG.nonempty
  let e₀ := (Finite.equivFin V).symm
  let f := fun j ↦ G.dist root (e₀ j)
  let e := (Tuple.sort f).trans e₀
  have hmono : Monotone (fun j ↦ G.dist root (e j)) := Tuple.monotone_sort f

  exact ⟨e, fun i ↦ hG.connectedInduceImageIicOfMonotoneDist root e hmono i⟩

theorem SimpleGraph.Path.ofIsAlternating_spec (A : Set V) (M : G.Subgraph)
    (p : G.Path x y) (hstart : x ∈ A \ M.support)
    (halt : (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating M.spanningCoe) :
    (ofIsAlternating A M p hstart halt).start_mem = hstart ∧
      (ofIsAlternating A M p hstart halt).alternating = halt := by

  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩


private lemma SimpleGraph.Path.isAlternating_iff_consecutive (p : G.Path x y)
    (H : SimpleGraph V) :
    (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating H ↔
      ∀ i : ℕ, i + 1 < (p : G.Walk x y).length →
        (H.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert i) ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 1)) ↔
          ¬ H.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 1))
            ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 2))) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro halt i hi

    have hi₀ : i ≤ (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    have hi₂ : i + 2 ≤ (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    have hne : (p : G.Walk x y).getVert i ≠ (p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 2) := by
      intro heq
      have heqIndex := p.isPath.getVert_injOn hi₀ hi₂ heq
      omega
    have hi' : i < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    have hleft := ((p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph_adj_getVert hi').symm
    have hright := (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph_adj_getVert hi
    simpa only [H.adj_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using halt hne hleft hright
  · intro htoggle v w w' hne hvw hvw'

    have hnonempty := Walk.not_nil_of_adj_toSubgraph hvw
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hjle⟩ := Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp
      (Walk.mem_support_of_adj_toSubgraph hvw)
    have hw : w ∈ (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.neighborSet v := hvw
    have hw' : w' ∈ (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.neighborSet v := hvw'
    by_cases hjzero : j = 0
    · have hv : v = x := by simpa only [hjzero, Walk.getVert_zero] using hj.symm
      rw [hv, p.isPath.neighborSet_toSubgraph_startpoint hnonempty] at hw hw'
      exact (hne ((Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw).trans
        (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw').symm)).elim
    by_cases hjend : j = (p : G.Walk x y).length
    · have hv : v = y := by simpa only [hjend, Walk.getVert_length] using hj.symm
      rw [hv, p.isPath.neighborSet_toSubgraph_endpoint hnonempty] at hw hw'
      exact (hne ((Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw).trans
        (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw').symm)).elim

    have hjlt : j < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    rw [← hj, p.isPath.neighborSet_toSubgraph_internal hjzero hjlt] at hw hw'
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hw hw'
    have hpred : j - 1 + 1 = j := by omega
    have hsucc : j - 1 + 2 = j + 1 := by omega
    have hbound : j - 1 + 1 < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    have ht := htoggle (j - 1) hbound
    rw [hpred, hsucc, H.adj_comm] at ht
    rw [← hj]
    rcases hw with hw | hw
    · rcases hw' with hw' | hw'
      · exact (hne (hw.trans hw'.symm)).elim
      · simpa only [hw, hw'] using ht
    · rcases hw' with hw' | hw'
      · simp only [hw, hw']
        exact not_not.symm.trans (not_congr ht).symm
      · exact (hne (hw.trans hw'.symm)).elim


private lemma SimpleGraph.Path.isAlternating_iff_odd_edges (M : G.Subgraph)
    (p : G.Path x y) (hunmatched : x ∉ M.support) :
    (p : G.Walk x y).toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating M.spanningCoe ↔
      ∀ i : ℕ, i < (p : G.Walk x y).length →
        (M.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert i) ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 1)) ↔
          Odd i) := by
  classical
  rw [isAlternating_iff_consecutive]
  simp only [Subgraph.spanningCoe_adj]
  constructor
  · intro htoggle i

    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      have hfirst : ¬ M.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert 0)
          ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (0 + 1)) := by
        intro hadj
        rw [Walk.getVert_zero] at hadj
        exact hunmatched (M.mem_support.mpr ⟨_, hadj⟩)
      simp only [hfirst, Nat.not_odd_zero, iff_self]
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have hiprev : i < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
      have ht := htoggle i hi
      rw [ih hiprev] at ht
      rw [Nat.odd_add_one, Nat.add_assoc]
      exact not_not.symm.trans (not_congr ht).symm
  · intro hodd i hi

    have hiprev : i < (p : G.Walk x y).length := by omega
    rw [hodd i hiprev, hodd (i + 1) hi, Nat.odd_add_one, not_not]





theorem isAlternatingFrom_iff (A B : Set V) (M : G.Subgraph)
    (h_bipartite : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) (h_cover : A ∪ B = Set.univ)
    (h_matching : M.IsMatching) (p : G.Path x y) :
    IsAlternatingFrom A M p ↔ x ∈ A \ M.support ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, i < (p : G.Walk x y).length →
        (M.Adj ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert i) ((p : G.Walk x y).getVert (i + 1)) ↔
          Odd i) := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.start_mem, (p.isAlternating_iff_odd_edges M h.start_mem.2).mp h.alternating⟩
  · rintro ⟨hstart, hodd⟩
    exact ofIsAlternating A M p hstart ((p.isAlternating_iff_odd_edges M hstart.2).mpr hodd)


theorem SimpleGraph.Path.isAlternatingFrom_nil_iff (A : Set V) (M : G.Subgraph) :
    IsAlternatingFrom A M (Path.nil : G.Path x x) ↔ x ∈ A \ M.support := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h.start_mem
  · intro hstart
    refine ofIsAlternating A M Path.nil hstart ?_
    refine (isAlternating_iff_odd_edges M Path.nil hstart.2).mpr ?_
    intro i hi
    simp only [Path.nil, Walk.length_nil] at hi
    omega

private lemma Walk.IsPath.eqOfLengthAddLtGirth {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b : V} {p q : G.Walk a b} (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hlen : p.length + q.length < G.girth) : p = q := by

  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨w, _, _, c, hc, hle⟩ := hp.exists_isCycle_length_le_add_of_ne hq hne
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlen) ((girth_le_length hc).trans hle)


private lemma Walk.IsPath.neighborInSupportEqPenultimate {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b x : V} {p : G.Walk a b} (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hlen : p.length + 1 < G.girth) (hx : G.Adj b x) (hmem : x ∈ p.support) :
    x = p.penultimate := by
  classical

  have heq : p.dropUntil x hmem = hx.symm.toWalk :=
    (hp.dropUntil hmem).eqOfLengthAddLtGirth (Walk.IsPath.of_adj hx.symm)
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.add_le_add_right (p.length_dropUntil_le_length hmem) 1) hlen)
  apply hp.eq_penultimate_of_mem_edges
  apply p.edges_dropUntil_subset_edges hmem
  rw [heq]
  simp


private lemma Walk.IsPath.degreeLeFreshCardAddOne {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b : V} {p : G.Walk a b}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hlen : p.length + 1 < G.girth) :
    G.degree b ≤ Fintype.card {x // G.Adj b x ∧ x ∉ p.support} + 1 := by
  classical

  have hsub : (G.neighborFinset b).erase p.penultimate ⊆
      Finset.univ.filter (fun x ↦ G.Adj b x ∧ x ∉ p.support) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hne, hadj⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hx
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ⟨(G.mem_neighborFinset b x).mp hadj, ?_⟩⟩
    intro hmem
    exact hne (hp.neighborInSupportEqPenultimate hlen ((G.mem_neighborFinset b x).mp hadj) hmem)
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have herase := Finset.pred_card_le_card_erase (s := G.neighborFinset b) (a := p.penultimate)
  rw [card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at herase
  rw [← Fintype.card_subtype] at hcard
  omega


private abbrev BoundedPaths {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (a : V) (r : ℕ) :=
  Σ b : V, {p : G.Path a b // p.val.length ≤ r}


private def boundedNil {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (a : V) (r : ℕ) :
    BoundedPaths G a r := ⟨a, ⟨Path.nil, Nat.zero_le r⟩⟩


private abbrev FreshNeighbors {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ}
    (p : BoundedPaths G a r) := {x // G.Adj p.1 x ∧ x ∉ p.2.val.val.support}


private lemma boundedConcatLength {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ}
    (p : BoundedPaths G a r) (x : FreshNeighbors p) :
    (p.2.val.val.concat x.property.1).length ≤ r + 1 := by

  rw [Walk.length_concat]
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right p.2.property 1


private def boundedConcat {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ}
    (p : BoundedPaths G a r) (x : FreshNeighbors p) : BoundedPaths G a (r + 1) :=
  ⟨x.val, ⟨⟨p.2.val.val.concat x.property.1,
    p.2.val.property.concat x.property.2 x.property.1⟩, boundedConcatLength p x⟩⟩


private lemma boundedConcatInjective {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (fun z : Σ p : BoundedPaths G a r, FreshNeighbors p ↦
      boundedConcat z.1 z.2) := by

  rintro ⟨⟨b, ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpr⟩⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩ ⟨⟨c, ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, hqr⟩⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩⟩ heq
  have hxy : x = y := congrArg Sigma.fst heq
  subst y
  have hw : p.concat hx.1 = q.concat hy.1 :=
    congrArg (fun z : {p : G.Path a x // p.val.length ≤ r + 1} ↦ z.val.val)
      (eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp heq).2)
  obtain ⟨hbc, hpq⟩ := Walk.concat_inj hw
  subst c
  simp only [Walk.copy_rfl_rfl] at hpq
  subst q
  rfl


private def boundedStep {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ} :
    Option (Σ p : BoundedPaths G a r, FreshNeighbors p) → BoundedPaths G a (r + 1)
  | none => boundedNil G a (r + 1)
  | some z => boundedConcat z.1 z.2


private lemma boundedStepInjective {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {r : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (boundedStep (G := G) (a := a) (r := r)) := by

  intro x y h
  cases x with
  | none =>
    cases y with
    | none => rfl
    | some z =>
      have hl := congrArg (fun p : BoundedPaths G a (r + 1) ↦ p.2.val.val.length) h
      simp [boundedStep, boundedNil, boundedConcat, Walk.length_concat] at hl
  | some z =>
    cases y with
    | none =>
      have hl := congrArg (fun p : BoundedPaths G a (r + 1) ↦ p.2.val.val.length) h
      simp [boundedStep, boundedNil, boundedConcat, Walk.length_concat] at hl
    | some w => exact congrArg some (boundedConcatInjective h)


private lemma freshNilCard {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (a : V) (r : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors (boundedNil G a r)) = G.degree a := by

  rw [← card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  apply Fintype.card_of_subtype
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hadj := (G.mem_neighborFinset a x).mp hx
    refine ⟨hadj, ?_⟩
    simpa only [boundedNil, Path.nil, Walk.support_nil, List.mem_singleton] using hadj.ne'
  · intro hx
    exact (G.mem_neighborFinset a x).mpr hx.1


private lemma boundedPathCountLowerBound {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 3 ≤ G.minDegree) (a : V) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < G.girth) :
    3 * 2 ^ r ≤ Fintype.card (BoundedPaths G a r) + 2 := by
  classical

  induction r with
  | zero =>
    have hpos := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr (Nonempty.intro (boundedNil G a 0))
    norm_num only [pow_zero, mul_one]
    omega
  | succ k ih =>
    have hkg : k < G.girth := by omega
    have hprev := ih hkg
    have hbranch : ∀ p : BoundedPaths G a k, 2 ≤ Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors p) := by
      intro p
      have hlen : p.2.val.val.length + 1 < G.girth := by
        have hpr := p.2.property
        omega
      have hdeg := hδ.trans (G.minDegree_le_degree p.1)
      have hfresh : G.degree p.1 ≤ Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors p) + 1 :=
        p.2.val.property.degreeLeFreshCardAddOne hlen
      omega
    have hroot : 2 < Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors (boundedNil G a k)) := by
      rw [freshNilCard]
      have htwo : 2 < (3 : ℕ) := by decide
      exact htwo.trans_le (hδ.trans (G.minDegree_le_degree a))
    have hsum : 2 * Fintype.card (BoundedPaths G a k) <
        ∑ p : BoundedPaths G a k, Fintype.card (FreshNeighbors p) := by
      have hs := Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun p _ ↦ hbranch p)
        ⟨boundedNil G a k, Finset.mem_univ _, hroot⟩
      simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hs
    have hstep := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _
      (boundedStepInjective (G := G) (a := a) (r := k))
    rw [Fintype.card_option, Fintype.card_sigma] at hstep
    rw [pow_succ]
    omega


private lemma threeMulTwoPowLeCardAddTwo {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 3 ≤ G.minDegree) (a : V) (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 * r < G.girth) :
    3 * 2 ^ r ≤ Fintype.card V + 2 := by
  classical

  have hinj : Function.Injective (Sigma.fst : BoundedPaths G a r → V) := by
    rintro ⟨b, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩ ⟨c, ⟨q, hq⟩⟩ heq
    dsimp at heq
    subst c
    have hlen : p.val.length + q.val.length < G.girth := by omega
    have hpq := p.property.eqOfLengthAddLtGirth q.property hlen
    have hpath : p = q := Subtype.ext hpq
    subst q
    rfl
  have hcount : Fintype.card (BoundedPaths G a r) ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
  have hrg : r < G.girth := by omega
  have hgrowth := boundedPathCountLowerBound G hδ a r hrg
  omega


private lemma twoPowGirthLtCardSq {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 3 ≤ G.minDegree) :
    2 ^ G.girth < (Fintype.card V) ^ 2 := by
  classical

  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl hempty =>
    have hz := G.minDegree_of_subsingleton
    omega
  | inr hnonempty =>
    have hn := G.minDegree_lt_card
    have hn4 : 4 ≤ Fintype.card V := by omega
    by_cases hnEq : Fintype.card V = 4
    ·
      have htop : G = ⊤ := by
        rw [eq_top_iff_forall_isUniversal]
        intro v
        apply (G.degree_eq_card_sub_one v).mp
        have hdeg := G.degree_lt_card_verts v
        have hlo := hδ.trans (G.minDegree_le_degree v)
        omega
      have hcard : 3 ≤ ENat.card V := by
        rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hnEq]
        norm_num
      rw [htop, girth_top hcard, hnEq]
      norm_num
    · have hn5 : 5 ≤ Fintype.card V := by omega
      by_cases hg : G.girth ≤ 4
      · have htwo : 1 ≤ (2 : ℕ) := by decide
        have hpow := pow_le_pow_right' htwo hg
        norm_num at hpow
        nlinarith
      ·
        let r := (G.girth - 1) / 2
        have hr : 2 * r < G.girth := by
          dsimp [r]
          omega
        have hr2 : 2 ≤ r := by
          dsimp [r]
          omega
        have hgr : G.girth ≤ 2 * r + 2 := by
          dsimp [r]
          omega
        obtain ⟨a⟩ := hnonempty
        have hbound := threeMulTwoPowLeCardAddTwo G hδ a r hr
        have htwo : 1 ≤ (2 : ℕ) := by decide
        have hfour := pow_le_pow_right' htwo hr2
        norm_num at hfour
        have hstrict : 2 * 2 ^ r < Fintype.card V := by omega
        have hpowers := pow_le_pow_right' htwo hgr
        have hnormalize : 2 ^ (2 * r + 2) = (2 * 2 ^ r) ^ 2 := by
          rw [pow_add, mul_comm 2 r, pow_mul]
          ring
        rw [hnormalize] at hpowers
        nlinarith

end SimpleGraph




theorem SimpleGraph.girthLtTwoLogbCard {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 3 ≤ G.minDegree) :
    (G.girth : ℝ) < 2 * Real.logb 2 (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by

  have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ G.girth < (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast SimpleGraph.twoPowGirthLtCardSq G hδ
  have hbase : 1 < (2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have htwo : 0 < (2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have hpos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ G.girth := pow_pos htwo _
  have hlog := Real.logb_lt_logb hbase hpos hpow
  simpa only [Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one hbase, mul_one, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hlog

theorem orbitEquivalence (G : Type u) [Group G] (X : Type v) [MulAction G X] :
    Equivalence (fun x y : X ↦ ∃ g : G, g • x = y) := by
  constructor
  · intro x

    exact MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp (MulAction.mem_orbit_self x)
  · intro x y hxy

    exact MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp
      (MulAction.mem_orbit_symm.mp (MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr hxy))
  · intro x y z hxy hyz

    have hy : (MulAction.orbitRel G X) y x := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr hxy
    have hz : (MulAction.orbitRel G X) z y := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr hyz
    exact MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp ((MulAction.orbitRel G X).iseqv.trans hz hy)

private lemma pairIntersectionNotMemFamily :
    (({0, 5} : Set (Fin 6)) ∩ {1, 5}) ∉
      ({Set.univ, ∅, {0}, {0, 5}, {1, 5}, {0, 1, 5}} : Set (Set (Fin 6))) := by

  intro hm
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hm
  rcases hm with he | he | he | he | he | he
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (0 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (5 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (5 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (0 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (1 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (0 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp




theorem singletonPairFamilyNotTopology :
    ¬ ∃ t : TopologicalSpace (Fin 6),
      {s : Set (Fin 6) | IsOpen[t] s} =
        ({Set.univ, ∅, {0}, {0, 5}, {1, 5}, {0, 1, 5}} : Set (Set (Fin 6))) := by

  rintro ⟨t, h⟩
  have hleft : ({0, 5} : Set (Fin 6)) ∈ {s | IsOpen[t] s} := by
    rw [h]
    simp
  have hright : ({1, 5} : Set (Fin 6)) ∈ {s | IsOpen[t] s} := by
    rw [h]
    simp

  have hinter : (({0, 5} : Set (Fin 6)) ∩ {1, 5}) ∈ {s | IsOpen[t] s} :=
    @IsOpen.inter _ t _ _ hleft hright
  rw [h] at hinter
  exact pairIntersectionNotMemFamily hinter


private lemma tripleIntersectionNotMemFamily :
    (({0, 1, 5} : Set (Fin 6)) ∩ {0, 1, 3}) ∉
      ({Set.univ, ∅, {0, 1, 5}, {0, 1, 3}, {0, 1, 3, 5}} : Set (Set (Fin 6))) := by

  intro hm
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hm
  rcases hm with he | he | he | he | he
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (2 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (0 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (5 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (3 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (3 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp




theorem overlappingTripleFamilyNotTopology :
    ¬ ∃ t : TopologicalSpace (Fin 6),
      {s : Set (Fin 6) | IsOpen[t] s} =
        ({Set.univ, ∅, {0, 1, 5}, {0, 1, 3}, {0, 1, 3, 5}} : Set (Set (Fin 6))) := by

  rintro ⟨t, h⟩
  have hleft : ({0, 1, 5} : Set (Fin 6)) ∈ {s | IsOpen[t] s} := by
    rw [h]
    simp
  have hright : ({0, 1, 3} : Set (Fin 6)) ∈ {s | IsOpen[t] s} := by
    rw [h]
    simp

  have hinter : (({0, 1, 5} : Set (Fin 6)) ∩ {0, 1, 3}) ∈ {s | IsOpen[t] s} :=

private lemma pairUnionNotMemFamily :

      ({Set.univ, ∅, {5}, {4, 5}, {0, 5}} : Set (Set (Fin 6))) := by

  intro hm
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hm
  rcases hm with he | he | he | he | he
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (2 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (0 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (0 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (0 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he
    simp at hp
  · have hp := congrArg (fun s : Set (Fin 6) ↦ (4 : Fin 6) ∈ s) he

    simp
  have hright : ({0, 5} : Set (Fin 6)) ∈ {s | IsOpen[t] s} := by

    simp
  have hopen : ∀ s ∈ ({({4, 5} : Set (Fin 6)), {0, 5}} : Set (Set (Fin 6))),

    @isOpen_sUnion _ t _ hopen
  rw [Set.sUnion_pair, h] at hunion
  exact pairUnionNotMemFamily hunion

private lemma SimpleGraph.girth_le_add_length_of_distinct_paths {V : Type u}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} {p q : G.Walk a b}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath) (hne : p ≠ q) :
    G.girth ≤ p.length + q.length := by

  obtain ⟨_, _, _, c, hc, hlength⟩ := hp.exists_isCycle_length_le_add_of_ne hq hne
  exact (SimpleGraph.girth_le_length hc).trans hlength


private lemma SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.length_eq_dist_of_two_mul_length_le_girth
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} {p : G.Walk a b}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hshort : 2 * p.length ≤ G.girth) : p.length = G.dist a b := by

  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqLength⟩ := p.reachable.exists_path_of_dist
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (SimpleGraph.dist_le p)
  by_contra hle
  have hne : p ≠ q := by
    intro heq
    have hlength := congrArg SimpleGraph.Walk.length heq
    omega
  have hgirth := SimpleGraph.girth_le_add_length_of_distinct_paths hp hq hne
  omega


private lemma SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.exists_path_length_eq_half {V : Type u}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a : V} {c : G.Walk a a} (hc : c.IsCycle) :
    ∃ (b : V) (p : G.Walk a b), p.IsPath ∧ p.length = c.length / 2 := by

  have hlength : (c.dropLast.take (c.length / 2)).length = c.length / 2 := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.take_length, SimpleGraph.Walk.length_dropLast]
    have hthree := hc.three_le_length
    omega
  exact ⟨_, _, hc.isPath_dropLast.take _, hlength⟩




theorem SimpleGraph.egirth_le_two_mul_ediam_add_one {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hcycle : ¬ G.IsAcyclic) :
    G.egirth ≤ 2 * G.ediam + 1 := by

  obtain ⟨a, c, hc, hmin⟩ := SimpleGraph.exists_egirth_eq_length.mpr hcycle
  have hgirth : G.girth = c.length := by
    simp only [SimpleGraph.girth, hmin, ENat.toNat_coe]
  obtain ⟨b, p, hp, hpLength⟩ := hc.exists_path_length_eq_half
  have hshort : 2 * p.length ≤ G.girth := by
    rw [hpLength, hgirth]
    omega
  have hgeo := hp.length_eq_dist_of_two_mul_length_le_girth hshort

  have hdiam : (↑(c.length / 2) : ℕ∞) ≤ G.ediam := by
    calc
      (↑(c.length / 2) : ℕ∞) = (G.dist a b : ℕ∞) := by rw [← hgeo, hpLength]
      _ = G.edist a b := p.reachable.coe_dist_eq_edist
      _ ≤ G.ediam := SimpleGraph.edist_le_ediam
  have hround : c.length ≤ 2 * (c.length / 2) + 1 := by omega

  calc
    G.egirth = (c.length : ℕ∞) := hmin
    _ ≤ 2 * (↑(c.length / 2) : ℕ∞) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hround
    _ ≤ 2 * G.ediam + 1 := by gcongr


theorem SimpleGraph.girth_le_two_mul_diam_add_one {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hconn : G.Connected) (hcycle : ¬ G.IsAcyclic) :
    G.girth ≤ 2 * G.diam + 1 := by

  have hfinite : G.ediam ≠ ⊤ :=
    (@SimpleGraph.connected_iff_ediam_ne_top V G hconn.nonempty _).mp hconn
  have hdiam : (G.diam : ℕ∞) = G.ediam := ENat.coe_toNat hfinite
  have hbound : G.egirth ≤ (2 * G.diam + 1 : ℕ) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one, hdiam] using
      G.egirth_le_two_mul_ediam_add_one hcycle
  exact ENat.toNat_le_of_le_coe hbound

theorem isSmoothOn_iff (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) :
    IsSmoothOn f L D ↔
      (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ≠ ⊤) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ D, DifferentiableAt ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ y ∈ D,
        ‖gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y‖ ≤
          (L : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖) := by

  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, hgradient⟩ := IsSmoothOn.spec f L D h
    refine ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hgradient.dist_le_mul x hx y hy
  · rintro ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, hgradient⟩
    refine ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, ?_⟩
    apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x hx y hy
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hgradient x hx y hy



theorem IsSmoothOn.subset_interior_dom (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E)
    (h : IsSmoothOn f L D) : D ⊆ interior {x | f x ≠ ⊤} := by

  intro x hx
  rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds]
  simpa only [Filter.Eventually] using h.finiteNearby x hx






theorem isSmoothOn_univ_iff (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) :
    IsSmoothOn f L Set.univ ↔
      (∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤) ∧ Differentiable ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) ∧
      LipschitzWith L (gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f)) := by


  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, hgradient⟩ := IsSmoothOn.spec f L Set.univ h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      exact (hfinite x (Set.mem_univ x)).self_of_nhds
    · intro x
      exact hdifferentiable x (Set.mem_univ x)
    · apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro x y
      exact hgradient.dist_le_mul x (Set.mem_univ x) y (Set.mem_univ y)
  · rintro ⟨hfinite, hdifferentiable, hgradient⟩

    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hfinite y
    · intro x hx
      exact hdifferentiable.differentiableAt
    · apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro x hx y hy
      exact hgradient.dist_le_mul x y

private lemma DihedralGroup.squareVertexEquiv_mul (a b : DihedralGroup 4) :

    simp only [r_mul_r, r_mul_sr, sr_mul_r, sr_mul_sr, squareVertexEquiv,
      Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_addRight, Equiv.neg_apply]

theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_sr_apply (i x : ZMod 4) :

theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_injective : Function.Injective squarePerm := by

  intro a b h
  have hzero := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) ↦ p 0) h
  have hone := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) ↦ p 1) h
  cases a
  all_goals cases b
  all_goals rename_i i j
  all_goals fin_cases i
  all_goals fin_cases j
  all_goals
    simp only [squarePerm_r_apply, squarePerm_sr_apply] at hzero hone
    revert hzero hone
    decide

theorem subdifferential_domain_subset (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f) :
    ∀ z, (Subdifferential.subdifferential f z).Nonempty → z ∈ Subdifferential.domain f := by

  intro z hz
  rcases hf.1 with ⟨y, hy⟩
  rcases hz with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hineq := (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f z u).mp hu y
  change f z ≠ ⊤
  intro htop
  have htopLe : ⊤ ≤ f y := by
    simpa [htop] using hineq
  exact (Subdifferential.mem_domain f y).mp hy (top_le_iff.mp htopLe)


theorem subdifferential_eq_support (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hx : x ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) :
    Subdifferential.subdifferential f x =
      {u | ∀ y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f,
        (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x} := by

  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hx
  ext u
  constructor
  · intro hu y hy
    have hglobal := (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f x u).mp hu y
    rw [EReal.le_sub_iff_add_le (Or.inl (hf.2 x)) (Or.inl hxTop)]
    simpa [add_comm] using hglobal
  · intro hu
    apply (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f x u).mpr
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f
    · have hle := hu y hy
      rw [EReal.le_sub_iff_add_le (Or.inl (hf.2 x)) (Or.inl hxTop)] at hle
      simpa [add_comm] using hle
    · have htop : f y = ⊤ := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hy ((Subdifferential.mem_domain f y).mpr hne)
      rw [htop]
      exact le_top


theorem isClosed_subdifferential (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hx : x ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) : IsClosed (Subdifferential.subdifferential f x) := by

  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hx
  have hreal (y : H) (hy : y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) (u : H) :
      (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x ↔
        ⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ ≤ (f y).toReal - (f x).toReal := by
    have hyTop : f y ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f y).mp hy
    have hfiniteY : f y = ((f y).toReal : EReal) :=
      (EReal.coe_toReal hyTop (hf.2 y)).symm
    have hfiniteX : f x = ((f x).toReal : EReal) :=
      (EReal.coe_toReal hxTop (hf.2 x)).symm
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [hfiniteY, hfiniteX] at h
      rw [← EReal.coe_sub] at h
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp h
    · intro h
      have hcoe : (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤
          (((f y).toReal - (f x).toReal : ℝ) : EReal) := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr h
      rw [EReal.coe_sub] at hcoe
      rw [hfiniteY, hfiniteX]
      exact hcoe
  have hset :
      {u : H | ∀ y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f,
          (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x} =
        ⋂ y : {y : H // y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f},
          {u : H | ⟪y.1 - x, u⟫_ℝ ≤ (f y.1).toReal - (f x).toReal} := by
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro hu y
      exact (hreal y.1 y.2 u).mp (hu y.1 y.2)
    · intro hu y hy
      exact (hreal y hy u).mpr (hu ⟨y, hy⟩)
  rw [subdifferential_eq_support hf hx, hset]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro y
  exact IsClosed.preimage (innerSL ℝ (y.1 - x)).continuous isClosed_Iic


theorem convex_subdifferential (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hx : x ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) : Convex ℝ (Subdifferential.subdifferential f x) := by

  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hx
  have hreal (y : H) (hy : y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f) (u : H) :
      (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x ↔
        ⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ ≤ (f y).toReal - (f x).toReal := by
    have hyTop : f y ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f y).mp hy
    have hfiniteY : f y = ((f y).toReal : EReal) :=
      (EReal.coe_toReal hyTop (hf.2 y)).symm
    have hfiniteX : f x = ((f x).toReal : EReal) :=
      (EReal.coe_toReal hxTop (hf.2 x)).symm
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [hfiniteY, hfiniteX] at h
      rw [← EReal.coe_sub] at h
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp h
    · intro h
      have hcoe : (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤
          (((f y).toReal - (f x).toReal : ℝ) : EReal) := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr h
      rw [EReal.coe_sub] at hcoe
      rw [hfiniteY, hfiniteX]
      exact hcoe
  have hset :
      {u : H | ∀ y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f,
          (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y - f x} =
        ⋂ y : {y : H // y ∈ Subdifferential.domain f},
          {u : H | ⟪y.1 - x, u⟫_ℝ ≤ (f y.1).toReal - (f x).toReal} := by
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro hu y
      exact (hreal y.1 y.2 u).mp (hu y.1 y.2)
    · intro hu y hy
      exact (hreal y hy u).mpr (hu ⟨y, hy⟩)
  rw [subdifferential_eq_support hf hx, hset]
  apply convex_iInter
  intro y
  exact (convex_Iic ((f y.1).toReal - (f x).toReal)).linear_preimage
    (innerSL ℝ (y.1 - x)).toLinearMap


theorem lowerSemicontinuousAt_of_mem_subdifferential (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hsub : (Subdifferential.subdifferential f x).Nonempty) : LowerSemicontinuousAt f x := by

  rcases hsub with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hxDomain := subdifferential_domain_subset hf x ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hxDomain
  have hxBot : f x ≠ ⊥ := hf.2 x
  have hglobal := (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f x u).mp hu
  let g : H → ℝ := fun z => (f x).toReal + ⟪z - x, u⟫_ℝ
  have hminorant (z : H) : (g z : EReal) ≤ f z := by
    simp only [g, EReal.coe_add]
    rw [EReal.coe_toReal hxTop hxBot]
    exact hglobal z
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    dsimp [g]
    exact continuous_const.add <|
      (innerSLFlip ℝ u).continuous.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  rw [lowerSemicontinuousAt_iff]
  intro a ha
  by_cases habot : a = ⊥
  · subst a
    filter_upwards [] with z
    exact bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr (hf.2 z)
  · have haTop : a ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le ha le_top)
    have hcastA : (a.toReal : EReal) = a := EReal.coe_toReal haTop habot
    have hcastX : ((f x).toReal : EReal) = f x := EReal.coe_toReal hxTop hxBot
    have hreal : a.toReal < (f x).toReal := by
      rw [← hcastA, ← hcastX] at ha
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp ha
    have hAt : a.toReal < g x := by simpa [g] using hreal
    have hnear := hg.continuousAt.eventually_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hAt)
    filter_upwards [hnear] with z hz
    calc
      a = (a.toReal : EReal) := hcastA.symm
      _ < (g z : EReal) := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hz
      _ ≤ f z := hminorant z


theorem weakLowerSemicontinuousAt_of_mem_subdifferential
    (hf : Subdifferential.IsProper f)
    (hsub : (Subdifferential.subdifferential f x).Nonempty) :
    LowerSemicontinuousAt (f ∘ (toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm) (toWeakSpace ℝ H x) := by

  rcases hsub with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hxDomain := subdifferential_domain_subset hf x ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hxTop : f x ≠ ⊤ := (Subdifferential.mem_domain f x).mp hxDomain
  have hxBot : f x ≠ ⊥ := hf.2 x
  have hglobal := (Subdifferential.mem_subdifferential_iff f x u).mp hu
  let g : WeakSpace ℝ H → ℝ := fun z =>
    (f x).toReal + ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z - x, u⟫_ℝ
  have hminorant (z : WeakSpace ℝ H) : (g z : EReal) ≤ f ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z) := by
    simp only [g, EReal.coe_add]
    rw [EReal.coe_toReal hxTop hxBot]
    exact hglobal ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z)
  have hEval : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
      ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z, u⟫_ℝ := by
    have hmapBase : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
        fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ => (topDualPairing ℝ H).flip z v := by
      change @Continuous (WeakSpace ℝ H) ((H →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ)
        (TopologicalSpace.induced
          (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H => fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ =>
            (topDualPairing ℝ H).flip z v) Pi.topologicalSpace)
        Pi.topologicalSpace _
      exact continuous_induced_dom
    have hmap : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
        fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ => v ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z) := by
      have heq : (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
          fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ => v ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z)) =
          (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H => fun v : H →L[ℝ] ℝ =>
            (topDualPairing ℝ H).flip z v) := by
        funext z v
        rfl
      rw [heq]
      exact hmapBase
    have heval : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
        innerSL ℝ u ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z) :=
      (continuous_apply (innerSL ℝ u)).comp hmap
    simpa only [innerSL_apply_apply, real_inner_comm] using heval
  have hinner : Continuous fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H =>
      ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z - x, u⟫_ℝ := by
    have heq : (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H => ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z - x, u⟫_ℝ) =
        (fun z : WeakSpace ℝ H => ⟪(toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z, u⟫_ℝ) -
          (fun _ : WeakSpace ℝ H => ⟪x, u⟫_ℝ) := by
      ext z
      rw [Pi.sub_apply]
      rw [inner_sub_left]
    rw [heq]
    exact hEval.sub (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : WeakSpace ℝ H => ⟪x, u⟫_ℝ)
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    dsimp [g]
    exact continuous_const.add hinner
  rw [lowerSemicontinuousAt_iff]
  intro a ha
  by_cases habot : a = ⊥
  · subst a
    filter_upwards [] with z
    exact bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr (hf.2 ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z))
  · have haTop : a ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le ha le_top)
    have hcastA : (a.toReal : EReal) = a := EReal.coe_toReal haTop habot
    have hcastX : ((f x).toReal : EReal) = f x := EReal.coe_toReal hxTop hxBot
    have ha' : a < f x := by simpa using ha
    have hreal : a.toReal < (f x).toReal := by
      rw [← hcastA, ← hcastX] at ha'
      exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp ha'
    have hAt : a.toReal < g (toWeakSpace ℝ H x) := by simpa [g] using hreal
    have hnear := hg.continuousAt.eventually_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hAt)
    filter_upwards [hnear] with z hz
    calc
      a = (a.toReal : EReal) := hcastA.symm
      _ < (g z : EReal) := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr hz
      _ ≤ f ((toWeakSpace ℝ H).symm z) := hminorant z

end
