private lemma sumNeighborsSwap {V R : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite]
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (s t : Finset V) (f : V → V → R)
    (hclosed : ∀ a ∈ s, G.neighborFinset a ⊆ t) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, ∑ b ∈ G.neighborFinset a, f a b) =
      ∑ b ∈ t, ∑ a ∈ s.filter (fun a ↦ G.Adj a b), f a b := by

  have hrow (a : V) (ha : a ∈ s) :
      G.neighborFinset a = t.bipartiteAbove G.Adj a := by
    ext b
    simp only [mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_bipartiteAbove]
    exact ⟨fun hab ↦ ⟨hclosed a ha ((G.mem_neighborFinset a b).mpr hab), hab⟩,
      fun hb ↦ hb.2⟩
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ b ∈ t.bipartiteAbove G.Adj a, f a b := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro a ha
      rw [hrow a ha]
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_sum_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_sum_bipartiteBelow G.Adj f


private lemma sumNeighborReciprocalDegrees_le_one {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] (b : V) (hb : 0 < G.degree b)
    (hdom : ∀ a, G.Adj b a → G.degree b ≤ G.degree a) :
    (∑ a ∈ G.neighborFinset b, (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹) ≤ 1 := by

  have hbq : (0 : ℚ) < G.degree b := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hb
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ G.neighborFinset b, (G.degree b : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro a ha
      exact inv_anti₀ hbq (Nat.cast_le.mpr (hdom a ((G.mem_neighborFinset b a).mp ha)))
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, nsmul_eq_mul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hbq.ne']


private lemma card_le_card_neighborBiUnion {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {A B : Set V} (hbip : G.IsBipartiteWith A B)
    (hpos : ∀ v, 0 < G.degree v)
    (hdeg : ∀ ⦃a b⦄, a ∈ A → b ∈ B → G.Adj a b → G.degree b ≤ G.degree a)
    (s : Finset V) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, a ∈ A) :
    s.card ≤ (s.biUnion (fun a ↦ G.neighborFinset a)).card := by
  let t := s.biUnion (fun a ↦ G.neighborFinset a)

  have hclosed (a : V) (ha : a ∈ s) : G.neighborFinset a ⊆ t := by
    intro b hb
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨a, ha, hb⟩
  have hrow (a : V) : (∑ _b ∈ G.neighborFinset a, (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, nsmul_eq_mul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (hpos a).ne')]
  have ht (b : V) (hb : b ∈ t) : b ∈ B := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hb
    exact hbip.mem_of_mem_adj (hs a ha) ((G.mem_neighborFinset a b).mp hab)

  have hincoming (b : V) (hb : b ∈ t) :
      (∑ a ∈ s.filter (fun a ↦ G.Adj a b), (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ G.neighborFinset b, (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
        · intro a ha
          exact (G.mem_neighborFinset b a).mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2.symm
        · intro a _ _
          exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        refine sumNeighborReciprocalDegrees_le_one G b (hpos b) ?_
        intro a hba
        exact hdeg (hbip.symm.mem_of_mem_adj (ht b hb) hba) (ht b hb) hba.symm
  have hcard : (s.card : ℚ) ≤ t.card := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ _b ∈ G.neighborFinset a, (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
        simp only [hrow, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      _ = ∑ b ∈ t, ∑ a ∈ s.filter (fun a ↦ G.Adj a b), (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹ :=
        sumNeighborsSwap G s t (fun a _ ↦ (G.degree a : ℚ)⁻¹) hclosed
      _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ t, (1 : ℚ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hincoming
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact Nat.cast_le.mp hcard

end SimpleGraph






theorem existsMatchingOfDegreeLe {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite]
    (A B : Set V) (h_bipartite : G.IsBipartiteWith A B) (h_cover : A ∪ B = Set.univ)
    (h_positive : ∀ v : V, 1 ≤ G.degree v)
    (h_degree : ∀ ⦃a b : V⦄, a ∈ A → b ∈ B → G.Adj a b → G.degree b ≤ G.degree a) :
    ∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsMatching ∧ A ⊆ M.support := by
  classical

  have hhall (S : Set V) (hS : S ⊆ A) :
      S.ncard ≤ (⋃ x ∈ S, G.neighborSet x).ncard := by
    rcases S.finite_or_infinite with hfinite | hinfinite
    · have hs (a : V) (ha : a ∈ hfinite.toFinset) : a ∈ A :=
        hS (hfinite.mem_toFinset.mp ha)
      have hcard := SimpleGraph.card_le_card_neighborBiUnion G h_bipartite
        (fun v ↦ h_positive v) h_degree hfinite.toFinset hs
      have hunion : (hfinite.toFinset.biUnion (fun a ↦ G.neighborFinset a) : Set V) =
          ⋃ x ∈ S, G.neighborSet x := by
        simp only [Finset.coe_biUnion, coe_neighborFinset, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card S hfinite, ← hunion, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
      exact hcard
    · rw [hinfinite.ncard]
      exact Nat.zero_le _

  obtain ⟨M, hA, hM⟩ := G.exists_isMatching_of_forall_ncard_le h_bipartite hhall
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩
  rwa [hM.support_eq_verts]

structure IsSmoothOn (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) : Prop where

  finiteNearby (x : E) (hx : x ∈ D) : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ≠ ⊤

  differentiableAt (x : E) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x

theorem gradientLipschitzOfHasGradientAt (g : E → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) (G : E → E)
    (hgradient : ∀ x ∈ D, HasGradientAt g (G x) x)
    (hLipschitz : LipschitzOnWith L G D) :
    LipschitzOnWith L (gradient g) D := by

  apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [(hgradient x hx).gradient, (hgradient y hy).gradient]
  exact hLipschitz.dist_le_mul x hx y hy



theorem ofGradient (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) (G : E → E)
    (hfinite : ∀ x ∈ D, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ≠ ⊤)
    (hgradient : ∀ x ∈ D, HasGradientAt (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) (G x) x)
    (hLipschitz : LipschitzOnWith L G D) : IsSmoothOn f L D where
  finiteNearby := hfinite
  differentiableAt := fun x hx => (hgradient x hx).differentiableAt
  gradientLipschitz := gradientLipschitzOfHasGradientAt _ _ _ _ hgradient hLipschitz


theorem spec (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) (h : IsSmoothOn f L D) :
    (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y ≠ ⊤) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ D, DifferentiableAt ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x) ∧
    LipschitzOnWith L (gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f)) D := by

  exact ⟨h.finiteNearby, h.differentiableAt, h.gradientLipschitz⟩


theorem mono (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D S : Set E)
    (h : IsSmoothOn f L D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) : IsSmoothOn f L S := by

  refine ⟨fun x hx => h.finiteNearby x (hSD hx),
    fun x hx => h.differentiableAt x (hSD hx), ?_⟩
  exact h.gradientLipschitz.mono hSD


theorem dualBound (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E)
    (h : IsSmoothOn f L D) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ D) (y : E) (hy : y ∈ D) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - fderiv ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ := by

  calc
    ‖fderiv ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - fderiv ℝ (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y‖ =
        ‖InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E
          (gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y)‖ := by
      rw [← toDual_gradient, ← toDual_gradient, ← map_sub]
    _ = ‖gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) x - gradient (WithTop.untopD 0 ∘ f) y‖ := by
      rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ := by
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using h.gradientLipschitz.dist_le_mul x hx y hy

end IsSmoothOn



def smoothOnClass (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) : Set (E → WithTop ℝ) :=
  {f | IsSmoothOn f L D}


@[simp] theorem mem_smoothOnClass (f : E → WithTop ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (D : Set E) :
    f ∈ smoothOnClass L D ↔ IsSmoothOn f L D := by

  rfl


def smoothClass : Set (E → WithTop ℝ) :=
  {f | ∃ L : ℝ≥0, IsSmoothOn f L Set.univ}


@[simp] theorem mem_smoothClass (f : E → WithTop ℝ) :
    f ∈ smoothClass ↔ ∃ L : ℝ≥0, IsSmoothOn f L Set.univ := by

  rfl

end WithTop

lemma Subgroup.precompOneMem (G : Subgroup (Perm X)) (Y : Type v) :
    ∃ σ ∈ G, Equiv.arrowCongr σ.symm (Equiv.refl Y) = (1 : Perm (X → Y)) := by

  refine ⟨1, G.one_mem, ?_⟩
  ext f x
  rfl


lemma Subgroup.precompMulMem (G : Subgroup (Perm X)) (Y : Type v)
    {a b : Perm (X → Y)}
    (ha : ∃ σ ∈ G, Equiv.arrowCongr σ.symm (Equiv.refl Y) = a)
    (hb : ∃ ρ ∈ G, Equiv.arrowCongr ρ.symm (Equiv.refl Y) = b) :
    ∃ η ∈ G, Equiv.arrowCongr η.symm (Equiv.refl Y) = a * b := by

  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, rfl⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨ρ * σ, G.mul_mem hρ hσ, ?_⟩
  ext f x
  rfl


lemma Subgroup.precompInvMem (G : Subgroup (Perm X)) (Y : Type v)
    {a : Perm (X → Y)}
    (ha : ∃ σ ∈ G, Equiv.arrowCongr σ.symm (Equiv.refl Y) = a) :
    ∃ η ∈ G, Equiv.arrowCongr η.symm (Equiv.refl Y) = a⁻¹ := by

  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨σ⁻¹, G.inv_mem hσ, ?_⟩
  ext f x
  rfl



def Subgroup.precomp (G : Subgroup (Perm X)) (Y : Type v) :
    Subgroup (Perm (X → Y)) where

  carrier := {τ | ∃ σ ∈ G, Equiv.arrowCongr σ.symm (Equiv.refl Y) = τ}
  one_mem' := Subgroup.precompOneMem G Y
  mul_mem' := Subgroup.precompMulMem G Y
  inv_mem' := Subgroup.precompInvMem G Y



theorem Subgroup.mem_precomp (G : Subgroup (Perm X)) (Y : Type v)
    (τ : Perm (X → Y)) :
    τ ∈ G.precomp Y ↔ ∃ σ ∈ G, ∀ f : X → Y, τ f = f ∘ σ := by

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨σ, hσ, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, hτ⟩
    refine ⟨σ, hσ, ?_⟩
    ext f x
    exact (congrFun (hτ f) x).symm


private lemma Equiv.Perm.apply_zpow_invariant (σ : Perm X) (f : X → Y)
    (h : f ∘ σ = f) (k : ℤ) : ∀ x, f ((σ ^ k) x) = f x := by

  have hstep (x : X) : f (σ x) = f x := congrFun h x
  refine zpow_induction_left (P := fun τ : Perm X ↦ ∀ x, f (τ x) = f x) ?_ ?_ ?_ k
  · intro x
    rfl
  · intro τ hτ x
    exact (hstep (τ x)).trans (hτ x)
  · intro τ hτ x
    calc
      f ((σ⁻¹ * τ) x) = f (σ (σ⁻¹ (τ x))) := (hstep _).symm
      _ = f (τ x) := congrArg f (σ.apply_symm_apply (τ x))
      _ = f x := hτ x



theorem Equiv.Perm.fixedPoints_precomp_iff (σ : Perm X) (f : X → Y) :
    f ∈ Function.fixedPoints (fun g : X → Y ↦ g ∘ σ) ↔
      ∀ x y : X, σ.SameCycle x y → f x = f y := by
  rw [Function.mem_fixedPoints_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x y hxy

    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hxy
    exact (σ.apply_zpow_invariant f h k x).symm
  · intro h

    funext x
    exact h (σ x) x (SameCycle.refl σ x).apply_left


private lemma Equiv.Perm.fixedPoints_precomp_iff_sameCycle_le_ker
    (σ : Perm X) (f : X → Y) :
    f ∈ Function.fixedPoints (fun g : X → Y ↦ g ∘ σ) ↔
      SameCycle.setoid σ ≤ Setoid.ker f := by

  rw [fixedPoints_precomp_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x y hxy
    exact h x y hxy
  · intro h x y hxy
    exact h hxy




theorem Equiv.Perm.mk_fixedPoints_precomp (σ : Perm X) (n : ℕ)
    (hcycles : Cardinal.mk (Quotient (SameCycle.setoid σ)) = (n : Cardinal.{u})) :
    Cardinal.mk (Function.fixedPoints (fun f : X → Y ↦ f ∘ σ)) =
      Cardinal.lift.{u} (Cardinal.mk Y) ^ (n : Cardinal.{max u v}) := by

  let e := (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight
    (σ.fixedPoints_precomp_iff_sameCycle_le_ker (Y := Y))).trans
    (Setoid.liftEquiv (SameCycle.setoid σ))
  calc
    Cardinal.mk (Function.fixedPoints (fun f : X → Y ↦ f ∘ σ)) =
        Cardinal.mk (Quotient (SameCycle.setoid σ) → Y) := Cardinal.mk_congr e

    _ = Cardinal.lift.{u} (Cardinal.mk Y) ^ (n : Cardinal.{max u v}) := by
      rw [Cardinal.mk_arrow, hcycles, Cardinal.lift_natCast]

private lemma SimpleGraph.exists_adj_edist_eq_pred {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {c v : V} {n : ℕ} (hv : G.edist c v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ G.edist c w = (n : ℕ∞) := by

  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := G.exists_walk_of_edist_eq_coe ((G.edist_comm).trans hv)
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | @cons v w c a p =>
    have hlength : p.length = n := by simpa using hp
    have hupper : G.edist c w ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [G.edist_comm, ← hlength]
      exact p.edist_le
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmn⟩ := ENat.le_coe_iff.mp hupper
    have htriangle := G.edist_triangle (u := c) (v := w) (w := v)
    rw [hv, hm, G.edist_eq_one_iff_adj.mpr a.symm] at htriangle
    have hlower : n + 1 ≤ m + 1 := by exact_mod_cast htriangle
    have heq : m = n := by omega
    exact ⟨w, a, hm.trans (congrArg Nat.cast heq)⟩


private lemma SimpleGraph.encard_forwardNeighbors_le {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {c v : V} {n d : ℕ} (hv : G.edist c v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hdegree : (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞)) :
    {w | G.Adj v w ∧ G.edist c w = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)}.encard ≤
      ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

  obtain ⟨p, hp, hdist⟩ := G.exists_adj_edist_eq_pred hv
  have hsubset : {w | G.Adj v w ∧ G.edist c w = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} ⊆
      G.neighborSet v \ {p} := by
    intro w hw
    refine ⟨hw.1, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    have hfalse : (n : ℕ∞) = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp heq, hdist] using hw.2
    have : n = n + 2 := Nat.cast_injective hfalse
    omega
  calc
    _ ≤ (G.neighborSet v \ {p}).encard := Set.encard_mono hsubset
    _ = (G.neighborSet v).encard - 1 := Set.encard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem hp
    _ ≤ (d : ℕ∞) - 1 := tsub_le_tsub_right hdegree 1
    _ = ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := (ENat.coe_sub d 1).symm


private lemma SimpleGraph.encard_distanceLayer_le {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (c : V) {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞))
    (n : ℕ) : {v | G.edist c v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)}.encard ≤
      ((d * (d - 1) ^ n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
  classical

  induction n with
  | zero => simpa only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_zero, mul_one,
      G.edist_eq_one_iff_adj, SimpleGraph.neighborSet] using hdegree c
  | succ n ih =>
    let layer := {v | G.edist c v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)}
    have hfinite : layer.Finite := Set.finite_of_encard_le_coe ih
    let forward := fun v => {w | G.Adj v w ∧ G.edist c w = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)}
    have hcover : {w | G.edist c w = ((n + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} ⊆
        ⋃ v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, forward v := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨v, hvw, hv⟩ := G.exists_adj_edist_eq_pred hw
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨v, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, hvw.symm, hw⟩⟩
    have hsum : (∑ v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, (forward v).encard) ≤
        ∑ _v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro v hv
      exact G.encard_forwardNeighbors_le (hfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hv) (hdegree v)
    calc
      _ ≤ (⋃ v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, forward v).encard := Set.encard_mono hcover
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, (forward v).encard :=
        Finset.set_encard_biUnion_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _v ∈ hfinite.toFinset, ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := hsum
      _ = layer.encard * ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ← hfinite.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card]
      _ ≤ ((d * (d - 1) ^ n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
        mul_le_mul_left ih _
      _ = ((d * (d - 1) ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
        simp only [pow_succ, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc]


private lemma SimpleGraph.encard_closedDistance_le {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (c : V) {d : ℕ} (hdegree : ∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞))
    (k : ℕ) : {v | G.edist c v ≤ (k : ℕ∞)}.encard ≤
      ((1 + d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (d - 1) ^ i : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, G.edist_eq_zero_iff,
      Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero, add_zero, Nat.cast_one]
    simp only [Set.setOf_eq_eq_singleton', Set.encard_singleton, le_refl]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hsplit : {v | G.edist c v ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} =
        {v | G.edist c v ≤ (k : ℕ∞)} ∪
        {v | G.edist c v = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} := by
      ext v
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
      constructor
      · intro hv
        obtain ⟨m, hm, hmk⟩ := ENat.le_coe_iff.mp hv
        rw [hm]
        have hm' : m ≤ k ∨ m = k + 1 := by omega
        exact hm'.imp (fun h => Nat.cast_le.mpr h) (fun h => congrArg Nat.cast h)
      · rintro (hv | hv)
        · exact hv.trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.le_succ k))
        · exact hv.le
    rw [hsplit]
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := Set.encard_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ ((1 + d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (d - 1) ^ i : ℕ) : ℕ∞) +
          ((d * (d - 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
        add_le_add ih (G.encard_distanceLayer_le c hdegree k)
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, Nat.cast_add, add_assoc]


private lemma mooreSum_mul_add_two (d k : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    (1 + d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (d - 1) ^ i) * (d - 2) + 2 =
      d * (d - 1) ^ k := by

  have hbase : d - 2 + 1 = d - 1 := by omega
  have hconstant : d - 2 + 2 = d := by omega
  have hgeom := geom_sum_mul_add (d - 2) k
  rw [hbase] at hgeom
  nlinarith





theorem SimpleGraph.card_mul_lt_of_radius_le {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {k d : ℕ} (hradius : G.radius ≤ (k : ℕ∞))
    (hdegree : ∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞)) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    ENat.card V * ((d - 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) < ((d * (d - 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by

  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl hempty =>
    rw [G.radius_eq_top_of_isEmpty] at hradius
    exact (not_le_of_gt (ENat.coe_lt_top k) hradius).elim
  | inr hnonempty =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := G.exists_eccent_eq_radius
    have hall : {v | G.edist c v ≤ (k : ℕ∞)} = Set.univ := by
      apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
      intro v
      exact G.edist_le_eccent.trans (hc ▸ hradius)
    have hcard := G.encard_closedDistance_le c hdegree k
    rw [hall, Set.encard_univ] at hcard
    have hstrict : (1 + d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (d - 1) ^ i) * (d - 2) <
        d * (d - 1) ^ k := by
      have hdtwo : 2 ≤ d := by omega
      have hidentity := mooreSum_mul_add_two d k hdtwo
      omega
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_left hcard ((d - 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
      _ < _ := by exact_mod_cast hstrict


theorem SimpleGraph.card_lt_of_radius_le {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {k d : ℕ}
    (hradius : G.radius ≤ (k : ℕ∞)) (hdegree : G.maxDegree ≤ d) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℚ) < (d : ℚ) / ((d : ℚ) - 2) * ((d : ℚ) - 1) ^ k := by

  have hneighbors : ∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).encard ≤ (d : ℕ∞) := by
    intro v
    rw [← Set.coe_fintypeCard, G.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
    exact_mod_cast (G.degree_le_maxDegree v).trans hdegree
  have hbound := G.card_mul_lt_of_radius_le hradius hneighbors hd
  rw [ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card, ← Nat.cast_mul] at hbound
  have hnat : Fintype.card V * (d - 2) < d * (d - 1) ^ k :=
    ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp hbound
  have htwo : 2 ≤ d := by omega
  have hone : 1 ≤ d := by omega
  have hrat : (Fintype.card V : ℚ) * ((d : ℚ) - 2) <
      (d : ℚ) * ((d : ℚ) - 1) ^ k := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hpositive : (0 : ℚ) < (d : ℚ) - 2 := by
    have hcast : (3 : ℚ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    linarith
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, lt_div_iff₀ hpositive]
  exact hrat

    t.bipartiteAbove G.Adj x = G.neighborFinset x := by

  ext y

private lemma card_bipartiteBelow_le_degree {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] [DecidableRel G.Adj] (s : Finset V) (y : V) :
    (s.bipartiteBelow G.Adj y).card ≤ G.degree y := by

  rw [← G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree y]
  refine Finset.card_le_card ?_
  intro x hx

private lemma card_le_card_neighborUnion_of_regular {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hRegular : G.IsRegularOfDegree k) (s : Finset V) :
    s.card ≤ (s.biUnion (fun x ↦ G.neighborFinset x)).card := by

  have hCount : s.card * k ≤ (s.biUnion (fun x ↦ G.neighborFinset x)).card * k := by
    refine Finset.card_mul_le_card_mul G.Adj ?_ ?_
    · intro x hx
      have hNeighbors : G.neighborFinset x ⊆ s.biUnion (fun x ↦ G.neighborFinset x) := by
        intro y hy
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
      rw [G.bipartiteAbove_eq_neighborFinset _ x hNeighbors,
        G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hRegular.degree_eq]
    · intro y _
      exact (G.card_bipartiteBelow_le_degree s y).trans (hRegular.degree_eq y).le

  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hCount hk


private lemma ncard_le_ncard_neighborUnion_of_regular {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [G.LocallyFinite] {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hRegular : G.IsRegularOfDegree k)
    (s : Set V) : s.ncard ≤ (⋃ x ∈ s, G.neighborSet x).ncard := by
  classical

  rcases s.finite_or_infinite with hs | hs
  · have hCount := G.card_le_card_neighborUnion_of_regular hk hRegular hs.toFinset
    have hUnion : (hs.toFinset.biUnion (fun x ↦ G.neighborFinset x) : Set V) =
        ⋃ x ∈ s, G.neighborSet x := by
      simp only [Finset.coe_biUnion, coe_neighborFinset, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]
    rw [← hUnion, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card s hs]
    exact hCount
  · rw [hs.ncard]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

    [G.LocallyFinite] {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hRegular : G.IsRegularOfDegree k)

open DihedralGroup


def DihedralGroup.squareVertexPerm : DihedralGroup 4 → Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4)
  | r i => Equiv.addLeft i
  | sr i => Equiv.subLeft (-i)


lemma DihedralGroup.squareVertexPerm_one :
    squareVertexPerm (1 : DihedralGroup 4) = 1 := by

  ext x
  simp only [one_def, squareVertexPerm, Equiv.coe_addLeft, zero_add,
    Equiv.Perm.one_apply]


lemma DihedralGroup.squareVertexPerm_mul (g h : DihedralGroup 4) :
    squareVertexPerm (g * h) = squareVertexPerm g * squareVertexPerm h := by

  cases g
  all_goals cases h
  all_goals
    ext x
    simp only [r_mul_r, r_mul_sr, sr_mul_r, sr_mul_sr, squareVertexPerm,
      Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.coe_addLeft, Equiv.subLeft_apply]
    ring



def DihedralGroup.squarePerm : DihedralGroup 4 →* Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) where

  toFun := squareVertexPerm
  map_one' := squareVertexPerm_one
  map_mul' := squareVertexPerm_mul


theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_r_apply (i x : ZMod 4) :
    squarePerm (r i) x = i + x := by

  rfl


theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_sr_apply (i x : ZMod 4) :
    squarePerm (sr i) x = -i - x := by

  rfl



theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_injective : Function.Injective squarePerm := by

  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_one squarePerm).2 ?_
  intro g hg
  have hzero := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) ↦ p 0) hg
  cases g with
  | r i =>
    have hi : i = 0 := by
      simpa only [squarePerm_r_apply, add_zero, Equiv.Perm.one_apply] using hzero
    rw [hi, r_zero]
  | sr i =>
    have hi : i = 0 := by
      simpa only [squarePerm_sr_apply, sub_zero, Equiv.Perm.one_apply,
        neg_eq_zero] using hzero

    have hone := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (ZMod 4) ↦ p 1) hg
    rw [squarePerm_sr_apply, hi] at hone
    have hne : (-1 : ZMod 4) ≠ 1 := by
      decide
    exact (hne hone).elim


private lemma DihedralGroup.squarePerm_rotationImages :
    squarePerm (r 0) = 1 ∧
    squarePerm (r 1) = ([0, 1, 2, 3] : List (ZMod 4)).formPerm ∧
    squarePerm (r 2) = Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 1 3 ∧
    squarePerm (r 3) = ([0, 3, 2, 1] : List (ZMod 4)).formPerm := by

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    ext x
    fin_cases x
    all_goals
      simp only [squarePerm_r_apply, List.formPerm_cons_cons,
        List.formPerm_singleton, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.one_apply,
        Equiv.swap_apply_def]
      decide


private lemma DihedralGroup.squarePerm_reflectionImages :
    squarePerm (sr 0) = Equiv.swap 1 3 ∧
    squarePerm (sr 1) = Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 1 2 ∧
    squarePerm (sr 2) = Equiv.swap 0 2 ∧
    squarePerm (sr 3) = Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 2 3 := by

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    ext x
    fin_cases x
    all_goals
      simp only [squarePerm_sr_apply, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
      decide



theorem DihedralGroup.squarePerm_range :
    Set.range squarePerm =
      {1, Equiv.swap 0 2, Equiv.swap 1 3,
        ([0, 3, 2, 1] : List (ZMod 4)).formPerm,
        ([0, 1, 2, 3] : List (ZMod 4)).formPerm,
        Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 2 3,
        Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 1 2,
        Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 1 3} := by

  obtain ⟨hr0, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ := squarePerm_rotationImages
  obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, hs2, hs3⟩ := squarePerm_reflectionImages
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    cases g with
    | r i =>
      fin_cases i
      · exact Or.inl hr0
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hr1))))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr hr2))))))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hr3)))
    | sr i =>
      fin_cases i
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hs0))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hs1))))))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hs2)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hs3)))))
  · intro hp
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with hp | hp | hp | hp | hp | hp | hp | hp
    · exact ⟨r 0, hr0.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨sr 2, hs2.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨sr 0, hs0.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨r 3, hr3.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨r 1, hr1.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨sr 3, hs3.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨sr 1, hs1.trans hp.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨r 2, hr2.trans hp.symm⟩



instance DihedralGroup.squareAction : MulAction (DihedralGroup 4) (ZMod 4) :=
  MulAction.compHom (ZMod 4) squarePerm


theorem DihedralGroup.squareAction_smul (g : DihedralGroup 4) (x : ZMod 4) :
    g • x = squarePerm g x := by

  rfl



theorem DihedralGroup.squareHalfTurn :
    squarePerm (r 2) = Equiv.swap 0 2 * Equiv.swap 1 3 := by

  exact squarePerm_rotationImages.2.2.1


theorem DihedralGroup.squareHalfTurn_apply (x : ZMod 4) :
    (r 2 : DihedralGroup 4) • x = x + 2 := by

  rw [squareAction_smul, squarePerm_r_apply, add_comm]

variable {n : ℕ}



theorem subgradient_iff (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal)
    (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x ↔
      ∀ z, f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z := by

  exact EReal.mem_subdifferential f x v



theorem subdifferentiableAt_iff (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    EReal.subdifferentiableAt f x ↔ (EReal.subdifferential f x).Nonempty := by

  rfl




theorem subgradient_iff_supportsEpigraph (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal)
    (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (r : ℝ) (hfinite : f x = (r : EReal)) :
    v ∈ EReal.subdifferential f x ↔
      (let h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun z ↦ r + inner ℝ v (z - x)
       h x = r ∧ ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ),
         f z ≤ (t : EReal) → h z ≤ t) := by

  have coe_le_iff_forall_real_le (a : ℝ) (q : EReal) :
      (a : EReal) ≤ q ↔ ∀ t : ℝ, q ≤ (t : EReal) → a ≤ t := by
    cases q with
    | bot =>
      constructor
      · intro h
        simp at h
      · intro h
        have h' := h (a - 1) (by simp)
        linarith
    | coe b =>
      simp only [EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
      constructor
      · intro hab t hbt
        exact hab.trans hbt
      · intro h
        exact h b le_rfl
    | top =>
      simp

  dsimp only
  rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential]
  constructor
  · intro hsub
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · intro z t hzt
      have hz := hsub z
      have hz' : ((r + inner ℝ v (z - x) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ f z := by
        simpa [hfinite, ← EReal.coe_add] using hz
      exact (coe_le_iff_forall_real_le _ _).mp hz' t hzt
  · rintro ⟨_, hsupport⟩ z
    have hz : ((r + inner ℝ v (z - x) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ f z :=
      (coe_le_iff_forall_real_le _ _).mpr (fun t hzt => hsupport z t hzt)
    simpa [hfinite, ← EReal.coe_add] using hz



theorem isClosed_subdifferential (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    IsClosed (EReal.subdifferential f x) := by

  have constraintClosed (a b : EReal) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
      IsClosed {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | a + (inner ℝ v w : EReal) ≤ b} := by
    cases a with
    | bot => simp
    | coe r =>
      cases b with
      | bot => simp
      | coe s =>
        have hset :
            {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | (r : EReal) + (inner ℝ v w : EReal) ≤ (s : EReal)} =
              {v | inner ℝ v w ≤ s - r} := by
          ext v
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
          constructor
          · intro hv
            linarith
          · intro hv
            linarith
        rw [hset]
        have hcontinuous : Continuous fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => inner ℝ v w := by
          simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply]
          exact continuous_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i hi =>
            (PiLp.continuous_apply (p := 2) (β := fun _ : Fin n => ℝ) i).mul
              continuous_const
        exact isClosed_Iic.preimage hcontinuous
      | top => simp
    | top =>
      cases b with
      | bot => simp
      | coe s => simp
      | top => simp

  rw [EReal.subdifferential]
  have hset :
      {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | ∀ z, f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z} =
        ⋂ z, {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) |
          f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z} := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [hset]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun z => constraintClosed (f x) (f z) (z - x)



theorem convex_subdifferential (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EReal)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}) :
    Convex ℝ (EReal.subdifferential f x) := by

  have constraintConvex (a b : EReal) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
      Convex ℝ {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | a + (inner ℝ v w : EReal) ≤ b} := by
    cases a with
    | bot =>
      simpa using (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
    | coe r =>
      cases b with
      | bot =>
        simpa using (convex_empty : Convex ℝ (∅ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
      | coe s =>
        have hset :
            {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | (r : EReal) + (inner ℝ v w : EReal) ≤ (s : EReal)} =
              {v | inner ℝ v w ≤ s - r} := by
          ext v
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
          constructor
          · intro hv
            linarith
          · intro hv
            linarith
        rw [hset]
        have hlinear : IsLinearMap ℝ fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => inner ℝ v w :=
          ⟨fun v u => inner_add_left v u w,
            fun (c : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) => real_inner_smul_left v w c⟩
        exact convex_halfSpace_le hlinear (s - r)
      | top =>
        simpa using (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
    | top =>
      cases b with
      | bot =>
        simpa using (convex_empty : Convex ℝ (∅ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
      | coe s =>
        simpa using (convex_empty : Convex ℝ (∅ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))
      | top =>
        simpa using (convex_univ : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))))

  rw [EReal.subdifferential]
  have hset :
      {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | ∀ z, f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z} =
        ⋂ z, {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) |
          f x + (inner ℝ v (z - x) : EReal) ≤ f z} := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [hset]
  exact convex_iInter fun z => constraintConvex (f x) (f z) (z - x)



theorem exists_empty_subdifferential :
    ∃ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EReal) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)),
      Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} ∧
        EReal.subdifferential f x = ∅ := by

  let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EReal := fun y => if y = 0 then 0 else ⊤
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hx0 := congrArg (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => y 0) hx
    simp [x] at hx0
  have hepi :
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} =
        ({0} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))) ×ˢ Set.Ici 0 := by
    ext p
    by_cases hp : p.1 = 0
    · simp [f, hp]
    · simp [f, hp]
  refine ⟨f, x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hepi]
    exact (convex_singleton (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))).prod (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ))
  · ext v
    rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential]
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro hv
    have hz := hv (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    simp [f, hx] at hz



theorem exists_singleton_subdifferential :
    ∃ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EReal) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)),
      Convex ℝ {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} ∧
        EReal.subdifferential f x = {v} := by

  let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) → EReal := fun _ => 0
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) := 0
  let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) := 0
  have hepi :
      {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) × ℝ | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} =
        Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0 := by
    ext p
    simp [f]
  refine ⟨f, x, v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hepi]
    exact convex_univ.prod (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ))
  · ext y
    rw [EReal.mem_subdifferential]
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hyy := hy y
      have hinner : (inner ℝ y y : EReal) ≤ 0 := by
        simpa [f, x] using hyy
      have hnonpos : inner ℝ y y ≤ 0 := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hinner
      have hyzero : y = 0 := real_inner_self_nonpos.mp hnonpos
      simpa [v] using hyzero
    · intro hy
      subst y
      intro z
      simp [f, x, v]

theorem firmlyNonexpansive_to_lipschitzWith_one (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    RestrictedMap.FirmlyNonexpansive T → LipschitzWith 1 T := by
  intro h

  apply LipschitzWith.mk_one
  intro x y
  have hres : 0 ≤ dist (RestrictedMap.residual T x) (RestrictedMap.residual T y) ^ 2 :=
    sq_nonneg _
  have hsquare : dist (T x) (T y) ^ 2 ≤ dist x y ^ 2 := by
    calc
      dist (T x) (T y) ^ 2 ≤
          dist (T x) (T y) ^ 2 +
            dist (RestrictedMap.residual T x) (RestrictedMap.residual T y) ^ 2 :=
        le_add_of_nonneg_right hres
      _ ≤ dist x y ^ 2 := h x y
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).mp hsquare


theorem lipschitzWith_one_to_quasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    LipschitzWith 1 T → RestrictedMap.Quasinonexpansive T := by
  intro h x y hy

  have hyT : T y = y := (RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mp hy
  simpa [hyT] using h.dist_le_mul x y


theorem firmlyNonexpansive_to_firmlyQuasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    RestrictedMap.FirmlyNonexpansive T → RestrictedMap.FirmlyQuasinonexpansive T := by
  intro h x y hy

  have hyT : T y = y := (RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mp hy
  simpa [RestrictedMap.residual_apply, hyT, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using h x y


theorem firmlyQuasinonexpansive_to_strictlyQuasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    RestrictedMap.FirmlyQuasinonexpansive T → RestrictedMap.StrictlyQuasinonexpansive T := by
  intro h x hx y hy

  have hxT : T x ≠ x := by
    intro hxT
    exact hx ((RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mpr hxT)
  have hdisp : 0 < dist (T x) x := dist_pos.mpr hxT
  have hdisp_sq : 0 < dist (T x) x ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using mul_pos hdisp hdisp
  have hstrict_sq : dist (T x) y ^ 2 < dist x y ^ 2 := by
    have hfirm := h x y hy
    nlinarith
  exact (sq_lt_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).mp hstrict_sq


theorem strictlyQuasinonexpansive_to_quasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :
    RestrictedMap.StrictlyQuasinonexpansive T → RestrictedMap.Quasinonexpansive T := by
  classical
  intro h x y hy

  by_cases hx : x ∈ RestrictedMap.fixedPoints T
  · have hxT : T x = x := (RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mp hx
    simp [hxT, Subtype.dist_eq]
  · exact le_of_lt (h x hx y hy)


theorem strictlyNonexpansive_to_strictlyQuasinonexpansive (hD : D.Nonempty) (T : D → H) :

  have hxy : x ≠ y := by
    intro hxy
    subst y
    exact hx hy
  have hyT : T y = y := (RestrictedMap.fixedPoints_spec).mp hy
  simpa [hyT] using h x y hxy

theorem maxFormObjective_spec
    {E1 : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E1] [NormedSpace ℝ E1] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E1]
    {E2 : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E2] [NormedSpace ℝ E2] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E2]
    (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hQ1_closed : IsClosed Q1) (hQ1_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q1)
    (hQ1_convex : Convex ℝ Q1) (hQ2_closed : IsClosed Q2)
    (hQ2_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q2) (hQ2_convex : Convex ℝ Q2)
    (hfhat_continuous : ContinuousOn fhat Q1) (hfhat_convex : ConvexOn ℝ Q1 fhat)
    (hphi_continuous : ContinuousOn phi Q2) (hphi_convex : ConvexOn ℝ Q2 phi)
    (hQ2_nonempty : Q2.Nonempty) :
    ∀ x ∈ Q1,
      IsGreatest ((fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) '' Q2)
        (MaxForm.objective Q2 fhat phi A x - fhat x) := by
  intro x _

  have hcompact : IsCompact Q2 :=
    Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨hQ2_closed, hQ2_bounded⟩
  have hpayoff : ContinuousOn (fun u ↦ A x u - phi u) Q2 :=
    (A x).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.continuousOn.sub hphi_continuous

  simpa only [MaxForm.objective_apply, add_sub_cancel_left] using
    (hcompact.image_of_continuousOn hpayoff).isGreatest_sSup (hQ2_nonempty.image _)


theorem maxFormOptimalValue_spec
    {E1 : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E1] [NormedSpace ℝ E1] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E1]
    {E2 : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E2] [NormedSpace ℝ E2] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E2]
    (Q1 : Set E1) (Q2 : Set E2) (fhat : E1 → ℝ) (phi : E2 → ℝ)
    (A : E1 →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ E2)
    (hQ1_closed : IsClosed Q1) (hQ1_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q1)
    (hQ1_convex : Convex ℝ Q1) (hQ2_closed : IsClosed Q2)
    (hQ2_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q2) (hQ2_convex : Convex ℝ Q2)
    (hfhat_continuous : ContinuousOn fhat Q1) (hfhat_convex : ConvexOn ℝ Q1 fhat)
    (hphi_continuous : ContinuousOn phi Q2) (hphi_convex : ConvexOn ℝ Q2 phi)
    (hQ1_nonempty : Q1.Nonempty) (hQ2_nonempty : Q2.Nonempty) :
    IsLeast (MaxForm.objective Q2 fhat phi A '' Q1)
      (MaxForm.optimalValue Q1 Q2 fhat phi A) := by

  have hcompact : IsCompact Q1 :=
    Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨hQ1_closed, hQ1_bounded⟩
  have hobjective : ContinuousOn (MaxForm.objective Q2 fhat phi A) Q1 :=
    MaxForm.continuousOn_objective Q1 Q2 fhat phi A hQ2_closed hQ2_bounded
      hQ2_nonempty hphi_continuous hfhat_continuous

  rw [MaxForm.optimalValue_def]
  exact (hcompact.image_of_continuousOn hobjective).isLeast_sInf (hQ1_nonempty.image _)

lemma dualPairing_le_norm_mul_norm {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (s : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) : s h ≤ ‖s‖ * ‖h‖ := by

  calc
    s h ≤ |s h| := le_abs_self (s h)
    _ = ‖s h‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs (s h)).symm
    _ ≤ ‖s‖ * ‖h‖ := s.le_opNorm h



lemma sqDiscrepancy_nonpos (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (a b : ℝ) :
    b * a - (1 / (2 * L)) * b ^ 2 ≤ (L / 2) * a ^ 2 := by

  field_simp [hL.ne']
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b - L * a)]


lemma dualQuadraticBound {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (s g : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) :
    s h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖s - g‖ ^ 2 ≤ g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by

  have hshift : s h = g h + (s - g) h := by
    rw [sub_apply]
    abel

  have hpair := dualPairing_le_norm_mul_norm (s - g) h
  have hquad := sqDiscrepancy_nonpos L hL ‖h‖ ‖s - g‖
  rw [hshift]
  linarith



lemma dualQuadratic_at_normingDual {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (g u : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) (hu₁ : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hu₂ : u h = ‖h‖) :
    (g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖(g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) - g‖ ^ 2 =
      g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by

  have heval : (g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) h = g h + L * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, hu₂]
    ring

  have hsub : ((g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) - g : StrongDual ℝ E) = (L * ‖h‖) • u := by
    abel

  have hnorm : ‖(g + (L * ‖h‖) • u) - g‖ = L * ‖h‖ := by
    rw [hsub]
    rw [norm_smul_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL.le (norm_nonneg h)) u]
    simp only [hu₁, mul_one]
  rw [heval, hnorm]
  field_simp [hL.ne']
  ring



lemma exists_dual_attaining {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (g : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) :
    ∃ s : StrongDual ℝ E,
      s h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖s - g‖ ^ 2 = g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  by_cases hz : h = 0
  ·
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    simp [hz]
  ·
    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := exists_dual_vector ℝ h ((norm_ne_zero_iff).mpr hz)
    refine ⟨g + (L * ‖h‖) • u, dualQuadratic_at_normingDual hL g u h hu₁ hu₂⟩












theorem fenchelConjSqNormEq {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (g : StrongDual ℝ E) (h : E) :
    g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 = ⨆ s : StrongDual ℝ E, s h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖s - g‖ ^ 2 := by
  let F : StrongDual ℝ E → ℝ := fun s ↦ s h - (1 / (2 * L)) * ‖s - g‖ ^ 2

  ·
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_dual_attaining hL g h

      g h + (L / 2) * ‖h‖ ^ 2 = F s := hs.symm
      _ ≤ ⨆ s : StrongDual ℝ E, F s := le_ciSup hbdd s
  ·


    letI : Nonempty (StrongDual ℝ E) := ⟨0⟩
    refine ciSup_le ?_
    intro s
    exact dualQuadraticBound hL s g h

private lemma intrinsicInteriorChartImage {E D : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace D] (C : Set E)
    (e : D ≃ₜ affineSpan ℝ C) :
    intrinsicInterior ℝ C = (Subtype.val ∘ e) '' interior ((Subtype.val ∘ e) ⁻¹' C) := by

private lemma intrinsicClosureChartImage {E D : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace D] (C : Set E)
    (e : D ≃ₜ affineSpan ℝ C) :
    intrinsicClosure ℝ C = (Subtype.val ∘ e) '' closure ((Subtype.val ∘ e) ⁻¹' C) := by

private lemma affineMapCombo {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℝ W] (f : V →ᵃ[ℝ] W) (u v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    f (t • u + (1 - t) • v) = t • f u + (1 - t) • f v := by

  simpa only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, add_comm] using f.apply_lineMap v u t




theorem Convex.combo_mem_intrinsicInterior {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {C : Set E} (hC : Convex ℝ C)
    {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C) (hy : y ∈ closure C)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    t • x + (1 - t) • y ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ C := by

  obtain ⟨p, _, _⟩ := mem_intrinsicInterior.mp hx


  letI : Nonempty (affineSpan ℝ C) := ⟨p⟩
  let e := (AffineIsometryEquiv.constVSub ℝ p).symm
  let f := (affineSpan ℝ C).subtype.comp e.toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap

  have interiorChart : intrinsicInterior ℝ C = f '' interior (f ⁻¹' C) :=
    intrinsicInteriorChartImage C e.toHomeomorph
  have closureChart : closure C = f '' closure (f ⁻¹' C) :=
    (intrinsicClosure_eq_closure ℝ C).symm.trans (intrinsicClosureChartImage C e.toHomeomorph)
  rw [interiorChart] at hx ⊢
  rw [closureChart] at hy
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hux⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvy⟩ := hy

  refine ⟨t • u + (1 - t) • v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hC.affine_preimage f).combo_interior_closure_mem_interior hu hv ht.1
      (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) (add_sub_cancel _ _)
  · rw [affineMapCombo, hux, hvy]

    {H : SimpleGraph α} {K : SimpleGraph β} (f : H →g K)

    (hclosed : ∀ a b, K.Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f) :
    ∃ C : K.oddComponents, C.val.supp = Set.range f := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := existsComponentOfClosedImage f hconn hclosed

  have hcard : C.supp.ncard = Nat.card α := by
    rw [hC, Set.ncard_range_of_injective hf]

    rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq,
      Nat.card_congr (ConnectedComponent.isoEquivSupp e C)]
  have himage : e.connectedComponentEquiv '' H.oddComponents = K.oddComponents := by
    ext D

    · rintro ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩

    · intro hD
      obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ := e.connectedComponentEquiv.surjective D
      exact ⟨C, (hodd C).mpr hD, rfl⟩
  rw [← himage, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ e.connectedComponentEquiv.injective]

    true_and, x.property.2, y.property.2, not_false_eq_true]


private def topDeleteVertsIso {α : Type*} (H : SimpleGraph α) (A : Set α) :
    ((⊤ : H.Subgraph).deleteVerts A).coe ≃g H.induce Aᶜ :=
  { toEquiv := Equiv.setCongr (topDeleteVerts_verts H A)
    map_rel_iff' := fun {x y} ↦ topDeleteVerts_adj H A x y }


private lemma existsInducedTutteObstruction {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (hfree : H.IsMatchingFree) :
    ∃ A : Set α, A.ncard < (H.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard := by

  have hnot : ¬ ∃ M : H.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching := by
    rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
    exact hfree M hM
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := not_forall.mp (fun h ↦ hnot (tutte.mpr h))
  have hviol : H.IsTutteViolator A := Classical.not_not.mp hA
  refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
  simpa only [IsTutteViolator, oddComponents_ncard_iso (topDeleteVertsIso H A)] using hviol


private lemma oddComponents_ncard_induce_induce {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    (H : SimpleGraph α) (U : Set α) (B : Set U) :
    ((H.induce U).induce B).oddComponents.ncard =
      (H.induce (Subtype.val '' B)).oddComponents.ncard := by

  let f : ((H.induce U).induce B) ↪g H :=
    (Embedding.induce U).comp (Embedding.induce B)
  have hrange : Set.range f = Subtype.val '' B := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨v.val, v.property, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩
  have hiso := oddComponents_ncard_iso f.isoInduceRange
  rwa [hrange] at hiso


private lemma imageComplementInComplement {α : Type*} (S : Set α) (B : Set (Sᶜ : Set α)) :
    Subtype.val '' Bᶜ = (S ∪ Subtype.val '' B)ᶜ := by

  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ (hs | ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩)
    · exact y.property hs
    · exact hy (Subtype.val_injective hzy ▸ hz)
  · intro hx
    have hs : x ∉ S := fun h ↦ hx (Or.inl h)
    refine ⟨⟨x, hs⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    intro hB
    exact hx (Or.inr ⟨⟨x, hs⟩, hB, rfl⟩)


private lemma ncard_union_complement_image {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    (S : Set α) (B : Set (Sᶜ : Set α)) :
    (S ∪ Subtype.val '' B).ncard = S.ncard + B.ncard := by

  have hd : Disjoint S (Subtype.val '' B) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro x hx ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact y.property hx
  rw [Set.ncard_union_eq hd, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]


private lemma oddComponents_ncard_enlarge {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    (H : SimpleGraph α) (S : Set α) (B : Set (Sᶜ : Set α)) :
    (H.induce (S ∪ Subtype.val '' B)ᶜ).oddComponents.ncard =
      ((H.induce Sᶜ).induce Bᶜ).oddComponents.ncard := by

  rw [oddComponents_ncard_induce_induce, imageComplementInComplement]


private noncomputable def oddDeficiency {α : Type*} (H : SimpleGraph α) (S : Set α) : ℤ :=
  ((H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents.ncard : ℤ) - S.ncard


private lemma existsMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α] (H : SimpleGraph α) :
    ∃ S : Set α, (∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S) ∧
      ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S → T.ncard ≤ S.ncard := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨R, _, hR⟩ := Set.exists_max_image Set.univ (oddDeficiency H)
    (Set.toFinite _) Set.univ_nonempty
  have hlevel : {S | oddDeficiency H S = oddDeficiency H R}.Nonempty := ⟨R, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcard⟩ := Set.exists_max_image _ Set.ncard (Set.toFinite _) hlevel
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro T
    rw [hS]
    exact hR T (Set.mem_univ T)
  · intro T hT
    exact hcard T (hT.trans hS)


private lemma not_mem_componentImage_of_mem_other {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) {D : H.ConnectedComponent} (hDC : D ≠ C)
    {v : α} (hv : v ∈ D.supp) : v ∉ Subtype.val '' A := by

  rintro ⟨a, ha, heq⟩
  exact hDC (ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hv (heq ▸ a.property))


private def componentDeletionSurvivorHom {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (D : H.ConnectedComponent) (hDC : D ≠ C) :
    D.toSimpleGraph →g H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ :=
  ⟨fun v ↦ ⟨v.val, not_mem_componentImage_of_mem_other C A hDC v.property⟩, id⟩


private lemma componentDeletionSurvivorHom_val {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (D : H.ConnectedComponent) (hDC : D ≠ C)
    (v : D) : (componentDeletionSurvivorHom C A D hDC v).val = v.val := by

  rfl


private lemma oddComponentSurvivesComponentDeletion {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C)
    (D : H.oddComponents) (hDC : D.val ≠ C) :
    ∃ E : (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).oddComponents,
      Subtype.val '' E.val.supp = D.val.supp := by
  let f := componentDeletionSurvivorHom C A D.val hDC
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : ((Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ : Set α) ↦ z.val) hxy)

  have hclosed : ∀ a b, (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f := by
    intro a b hab
    have hb : b.val ∈ D.val.supp := D.val.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp a.property hab
    refine ⟨⟨b.val, hb⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    exact componentDeletionSurvivorHom_val C A D.val hDC ⟨b.val, hb⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := existsOddComponentOfClosedImage f hf D.val.connected_toSimpleGraph
    D.property hclosed
  refine ⟨E, ?_⟩
  rw [hE]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact a.property
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨f ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩


private lemma not_mem_componentImage {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (v : C) (hv : v ∉ A) :
    v.val ∉ Subtype.val '' A := by

  rintro ⟨w, hw, heq⟩
  exact hv (Subtype.val_injective heq ▸ hw)


private def componentDeleteHom {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) :
    (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ) →g H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ :=
  ⟨fun v ↦ ⟨v.val.val, not_mem_componentImage C A v.val v.property⟩, id⟩


private lemma componentDeleteHom_val {α : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (v : (Aᶜ : Set C)) :
    (componentDeleteHom C A v).val = v.val.val := by

  rfl


private lemma oddComponentLiftsComponentDeletion {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C)
    (D : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents) :
    ∃ E : (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).oddComponents,
      Subtype.val '' E.val.supp =
        (fun x : (Aᶜ : Set C) ↦ x.val.val) '' D.val.supp := by
  let f := (componentDeleteHom C A).comp D.val.toSimpleGraph_hom
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : ((Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ : Set α) ↦ z.val) hxy)

  have hclosed : ∀ a b, (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f := by
    intro a b hab
    have hbC : b.val ∈ C.supp := C.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp a.val.val.property hab
    let c : C := ⟨b.val, hbC⟩
    have hc : c ∉ A := by
      intro hcA
      exact b.property ⟨c, hcA, rfl⟩
    have hbD : (⟨c, hc⟩ : (Aᶜ : Set C)) ∈ D.val.supp :=
      D.val.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp a.property hab
    refine ⟨⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hbD⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    exact componentDeleteHom_val C A ⟨c, hc⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := existsOddComponentOfClosedImage f hf D.val.connected_toSimpleGraph
    D.property hclosed
  refine ⟨E, ?_⟩
  rw [hE]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a.val, a.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f ⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩


private lemma oddComponents_ncard_componentDeletion {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (C : H.ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) :
    (H.oddComponents \ {C}).ncard + (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard ≤
      (H.induce (Subtype.val '' A)ᶜ).oddComponents.ncard := by
  classical

  have hs (D : (H.oddComponents \ {C} : Set H.ConnectedComponent)) :=
    oddComponentSurvivesComponentDeletion C A ⟨D.val, D.property.1⟩ D.property.2
  choose f hf using hs
  choose g hg using oddComponentLiftsComponentDeletion C A
  have hfinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro D E heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ConnectedComponent.supp_injective
    rw [← hf D, ← hf E, heq]
  have hginj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro D E heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ConnectedComponent.supp_injective
    apply (Subtype.val_injective.comp Subtype.val_injective).image_injective
    exact (hg D).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun F ↦ Subtype.val '' F.val.supp) heq).trans (hg E))
  have hfg (D : (H.oddComponents \ {C} : Set H.ConnectedComponent))
      (E : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents) : f D ≠ g E := by
    intro heq
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := E.val.nonempty_supp
    have hmem : v.val.val ∈ Subtype.val '' (g E).val.supp := by
      rw [hg E]
      exact ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    rw [← heq, hf D] at hmem
    exact D.property.2 (ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hmem v.val.property)

  have hinj : Function.Injective (Sum.elim f g) := by
    intro x y hxy
    cases x with
    | inl D =>
      cases y with
      | inl E => exact congrArg Sum.inl (hfinj hxy)
      | inr E => exact (hfg D E hxy).elim
    | inr D =>
      cases y with
      | inl E => exact (hfg E D hxy.symm).elim
      | inr E => exact congrArg Sum.inr (hginj hxy)
  simpa only [Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_coe_set_eq] using
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (Sum.elim f g) hinj


private lemma componentDeletionBoundOfMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (htie : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S → T.ncard ≤ S.ncard)
    (C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (A : Set C) (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard <
      A.ncard + if Odd C.supp.ncard then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  let B : Set (Sᶜ : Set α) := Subtype.val '' A
  let T : Set α := S ∪ Subtype.val '' B
  have hcard : T.ncard = S.ncard + A.ncard := by
    rw [ncard_union_complement_image, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]
  have hcount : ((H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents \ {C}).ncard +
      (C.toSimpleGraph.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard ≤
      ((H.induce Sᶜ).induce Bᶜ).oddComponents.ncard :=
    oddComponents_ncard_componentDeletion C A
  have hflatten : (H.induce Tᶜ).oddComponents.ncard =
      ((H.induce Sᶜ).induce Bᶜ).oddComponents.ncard :=
    oddComponents_ncard_enlarge H S B
  have hremoved : ((H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents \ {C}).ncard +
      (if Odd C.supp.ncard then 1 else 0) = (H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents.ncard := by
    split_ifs with hodd
    · exact Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hodd
    · have heq : (H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents \ {C} =
          (H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents := by
        exact Set.sdiff_singleton_eq_self hodd
      rw [heq, Nat.add_zero]

  by_contra! hbad
  have hge : oddDeficiency H S ≤ oddDeficiency H T := by
    unfold oddDeficiency
    rw [hcard, hflatten]
    omega
  have heq : oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S := le_antisymm (hmax T) hge
  have ht := htie T heq
  have hpos := hA.ncard_pos
  omega


private lemma oddComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (htie : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S → T.ncard ≤ S.ncard)
    (C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) : Odd C.supp.ncard := by
  classical

  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := C.nonempty_supp
  let c : C := ⟨v, hv⟩
  by_contra hodd
  have hbound := componentDeletionBoundOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie C {c}
    (Set.singleton_nonempty c)
  simp only [Set.ncard_singleton, if_neg hodd, Nat.add_zero] at hbound
  have htotal := Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl ({c} : Set C)
  have hparity := odd_ncard_oddComponents (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({c}ᶜ : Set C))
  simp only [Set.ncard_singleton, Nat.card_coe_set_eq] at htotal hparity
  have hcardC : Nat.card C = C.supp.ncard := Nat.card_coe_set_eq C.supp
  rw [hcardC] at htotal
  simp only [Nat.odd_iff] at hodd hparity
  omega


private lemma oddComponents_lt_ncard_of_odd {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (hodd : Odd (Nat.card α)) (A : Set α)
    (hle : (H.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard ≤ A.ncard) :
    (H.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard < A.ncard := by

  have htotal := Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl A
  have hparity := odd_ncard_oddComponents (H.induce Aᶜ)
  simp only [Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.odd_iff] at hparity
  simp only [Nat.odd_iff] at hodd
  omega


private lemma factorCriticalOfDeletionBounds {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (hodd : Odd (Nat.card α))
    (hbound : ∀ A : Set α, A.Nonempty → (H.induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard < A.ncard) :
    H.IsFactorCritical := by
  classical
  constructor
  · exact (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp hodd.pos).1
  · intro M hM

    cases nonempty_fintype α
    apply (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd)
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hM.even_card
  · intro v

    by_contra! hfree
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := existsInducedTutteObstruction hfree
    let T : Set α := {v} ∪ Subtype.val '' A
    have hT : T.Nonempty := ⟨v, Or.inl rfl⟩
    have hcard : T.ncard = 1 + A.ncard := by
      rw [ncard_union_complement_image, Set.ncard_singleton]
    have hcount : (H.induce Tᶜ).oddComponents.ncard =
        ((H.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set α)).induce Aᶜ).oddComponents.ncard :=
      oddComponents_ncard_enlarge H {v} A
    have ht := hbound T hT
    rw [hcard, hcount] at ht
    omega


private lemma factorCriticalComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (htie : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T = oddDeficiency H S → T.ncard ≤ S.ncard) :
    ∀ C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, C.toSimpleGraph.IsFactorCritical := by
  intro C
  have hodd := oddComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie C
  have hcard : Nat.card C = C.supp.ncard := Nat.card_coe_set_eq C.supp
  have hoddCard : Odd (Nat.card C) := hcard.symm ▸ hodd
  refine factorCriticalOfDeletionBounds hoddCard ?_
  intro A hA

  have hbound := componentDeletionBoundOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie C A hA
  rw [if_pos hodd] at hbound
  exact oddComponents_lt_ncard_of_odd hoddCard A (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hbound)


private lemma oddComponentSurvivesRestoration {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} (S : Set α) (X : Set S)
    (C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (hodd : Odd C.supp.ncard)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ s : S, s ∈ X ∧ ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c) :
    ∃ D : (H.induce (S \ Subtype.val '' X)ᶜ).oddComponents,
      Subtype.val '' D.val.supp = Subtype.val '' C.supp := by
  classical
  let T := S \ Subtype.val '' X
  have hinc : Sᶜ ⊆ Tᶜ := Set.compl_subset_compl.mpr Set.sdiff_subset
  let f : C.toSimpleGraph →g H.induce Tᶜ :=
    (H.induceHomOfLE hinc).toHom.comp C.toSimpleGraph_hom
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : (Tᶜ : Set α) ↦ z.val) hxy
  have hclosed : ∀ a b, (H.induce Tᶜ).Adj (f a) b → b ∈ Set.range f := by
    intro a b hab

    have hb : b.val ∉ S := by
      intro hbs
      have hbX : b.val ∈ Subtype.val '' X := by
        by_contra hbX
        exact b.property ⟨hbs, hbX⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hs, heq⟩ := hbX
      exact hno ⟨s, hs, a.val, a.property, heq.symm ▸ hab.symm⟩
    have hbC : (⟨b.val, hb⟩ : (Sᶜ : Set α)) ∈ C.supp :=
      C.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp a.property hab
    refine ⟨⟨⟨b.val, hb⟩, hbC⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (H.induceHomOfLE_apply hinc ⟨b.val, hb⟩)
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := existsOddComponentOfClosedImage f hf C.connected_toSimpleGraph hodd hclosed
  refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
  rw [hD]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a.val, a.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f ⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩


private lemma componentNeighborhoodCardBound {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (hodd : ∀ C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, Odd C.supp.ncard) (X : Set S) :
    X.ncard ≤ {C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent |
      ∃ s : S, s ∈ X ∧ ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c}.ncard := by
  classical
  let N : Set (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent :=
    {C | ∃ s : S, s ∈ X ∧ ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c}
  let T := S \ Subtype.val '' X

  have hsurv (C : (Nᶜ : Set (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent)) :=
    oddComponentSurvivesRestoration S X C.val (hodd C.val) C.property
  choose f hf using hsurv
  have hfinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro C D heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ConnectedComponent.supp_injective
    apply Subtype.val_injective.image_injective
    rw [← hf C, ← hf D, heq]
  have hsurvCard : Nᶜ.ncard ≤ (H.induce Tᶜ).oddComponents.ncard :=
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f hfinj
  have htotal := Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl N
  have hcard : T.ncard + X.ncard = S.ncard := by
    have hsubset : Subtype.val '' X ⊆ S := by
      rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact s.property
    simpa only [Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective] using
      Set.ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset hsubset
  have hallodd : (H.induce Sᶜ).oddComponents = Set.univ := by
    ext C
    exact iff_of_true (hodd C) (Set.mem_univ C)

  have hmaxT := hmax T
  unfold oddDeficiency at hmaxT
  rw [hallodd, Set.ncard_univ] at hmaxT
  have hbound : X.ncard ≤ N.ncard := by
    omega
  exact hbound


private lemma matchableToComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    {H : SimpleGraph α} {S : Set α}
    (hmax : ∀ T, oddDeficiency H T ≤ oddDeficiency H S)
    (hodd : ∀ C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, Odd C.supp.ncard) :
    H.matchableToComponents S := by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent
  let r (s : S) (C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :=
    ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c
  have hhall : ∀ A : Finset S,
      A.card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun C ↦ ∃ s ∈ A, r s C)).card := by
    intro A
    have hbound := componentNeighborhoodCardBound hmax hodd (A : Set S)
    have hN : {C : (H.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent |
        ∃ s : S, s ∈ (A : Set S) ∧ ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set α), c ∈ C.supp ∧ H.Adj s c} =
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun C ↦ ∃ s ∈ A, r s C) : Set _) := by
      ext C
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq, r]
    rwa [hN, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Set.ncard_coe_finset] at hbound

  obtain ⟨f, hfinj, hf⟩ :=
    (Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective r).mp hhall
  exact (H.matchableToComponents_iff_exists_embedding S).mpr ⟨⟨f, hfinj⟩, hf⟩


private lemma existsMatchingOnImage {α β : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph α}
    {K : SimpleGraph β} (f : H →g K) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (h : ∃ M : H.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    ∃ N : K.Subgraph, N.IsMatching ∧ N.verts = Set.range f := by

  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h
  refine ⟨M.map f, hM.1.map f hf, ?_⟩
  rw [Subgraph.map_verts, hM.2.verts_eq_univ, Set.image_univ]


private lemma matchingFreeComponentHasExternalMatchingEdge {V : Type u}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V} {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching)
    (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (hfree : C.toSimpleGraph.IsMatchingFree) :
    ∃ s : S, ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ C.supp ∧ M.Adj c s := by
  classical

  by_contra! h
  let f : C.toSimpleGraph →g G :=
    (Embedding.induce Sᶜ).toHom.comp C.toSimpleGraph_hom
  apply hfree (M.comap f)
  rw [Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff]
  intro v
  obtain ⟨w, hvw, huniq⟩ := (Subgraph.isPerfectMatching_iff.mp hM) (f v)
  have hw : w ∉ S := by
    intro hws
    exact h ⟨w, hws⟩ v.val v.property hvw
  have hwC : (⟨w, hw⟩ : (Sᶜ : Set V)) ∈ C.supp :=
    C.mem_supp_of_adj_mem_supp v.property (M.adj_sub hvw)
  refine ⟨⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hwC⟩, ⟨M.adj_sub hvw, hvw⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact huniq _ hy.2


private lemma card_components_le_of_isPerfectMatching {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V} {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching)
    (hfree : ∀ C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, C.toSimpleGraph.IsMatchingFree) :
    Nat.card (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent ≤ Nat.card S := by
  classical

  have hex (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) :=
    matchingFreeComponentHasExternalMatchingEdge hM C (hfree C)
  choose s c hc hadj using hex
  refine Nat.card_le_card_of_injective s ?_
  intro C D hCD
  have hvertex : c C = c D := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hM.1.eq_of_adj_right (hadj C) (hCD.symm ▸ hadj D)
  exact ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex (hc C) (hvertex.symm ▸ hc D)


private lemma existsMatchingOnComponentDelete {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {S : Set V} (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (c : (Sᶜ : Set V))
    (hc : c ∈ C.supp)
    (hdelete : ∀ v : C, ∃ M : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)).Subgraph,
      M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    ∃ N : G.Subgraph, N.IsMatching ∧
      N.verts = (Subtype.val '' C.supp) \ {c.val} := by
  classical

  let v : C := ⟨c, hc⟩
  let f : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)) →g G :=
    (Embedding.induce Sᶜ).toHom.comp
      (C.toSimpleGraph_hom.comp (Embedding.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)).toHom)
  have hf : Function.Injective f :=
    Subtype.val_injective.comp (Subtype.val_injective.comp Subtype.val_injective)
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hverts⟩ := existsMatchingOnImage f hf (hdelete v)
  refine ⟨N, hN, hverts.trans ?_⟩
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨y.val.val, y.val.property, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    apply y.property
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subtype.ext heq
  · rintro ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hne⟩
    have hyne : (⟨y, hy⟩ : C) ∈ ({v}ᶜ : Set C) := by
      intro heq
      apply hne
      exact congrArg (fun z : C ↦ z.val.val) heq
    exact ⟨⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hyne⟩, rfl⟩


private lemma existsMatchingOnComponentPatch {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {S : Set V} (s : S) (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent)
    (hattach : ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ C.supp ∧ G.Adj s c)
    (hdelete : ∀ v : C, ∃ M : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)).Subgraph,
      M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    ∃ N : G.Subgraph, N.IsMatching ∧
      N.verts = {s.val} ∪ Subtype.val '' C.supp := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hsc⟩ := hattach
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hverts⟩ := existsMatchingOnComponentDelete C c hc hdelete

  have hd : Disjoint (G.subgraphOfAdj hsc).support N.support := by
    rw [(Subgraph.IsMatching.subgraphOfAdj hsc).support_eq_verts,
      hN.support_eq_verts, subgraphOfAdj_verts, hverts]
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro x (rfl | rfl) ⟨hx, hne⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := hx
      exact y.property (heq.symm ▸ s.property)
    · exact hne rfl
  refine ⟨G.subgraphOfAdj hsc ⊔ N, (Subgraph.IsMatching.subgraphOfAdj hsc).sup hN hd, ?_⟩
  rw [Subgraph.verts_sup, subgraphOfAdj_verts, hverts]
  have hcimage : c.val ∈ Subtype.val '' C.supp := ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩

  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_sdiff]
  constructor
  · rintro ((hs | hcx) | ⟨hx, hne⟩)
    · exact Or.inl hs
    · exact Or.inr (hcx.symm ▸ hcimage)
    · exact Or.inr hx
  · rintro (hs | hx)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hs)
    · by_cases hcx : x = c.val
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hcx)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, hcx⟩


private lemma existsPerfectMatchingOfComponentEquiv {V : Type u}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V} (e : S ≃ (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent)
    (hattach : ∀ s : S, ∃ c : (Sᶜ : Set V), c ∈ (e s).supp ∧ G.Adj s c)
    (hdelete : ∀ (C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent) (v : C),
      ∃ M : (C.toSimpleGraph.induce ({v}ᶜ : Set C)).Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching) :
    ∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching := by
  classical

  have hpatch (s : S) :=
    existsMatchingOnComponentPatch s (e s) (hattach s) (hdelete (e s))
  choose N hN hverts using hpatch
  have hd : Pairwise fun s t ↦ Disjoint (N s).support (N t).support := by
    intro s t hst
    rw [(hN s).support_eq_verts, (hN t).support_eq_verts, hverts s, hverts t]
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro x (hs | ⟨c, hc, hcx⟩) (ht | ⟨d, hd, hdx⟩)
    · exact hst (Subtype.ext (hs.symm.trans ht))
    · exact d.property (hdx.trans hs ▸ s.property)
    · exact c.property (hcx.trans ht ▸ t.property)
    · have hcd : c = d := Subtype.ext (hcx.trans hdx.symm)
      exact hst (e.injective (ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hc (hcd.symm ▸ hd)))
  refine ⟨⨆ s, N s, Subgraph.IsMatching.iSup hN hd, ?_⟩

  intro v
  rw [Subgraph.verts_iSup, Set.mem_iUnion]
  by_cases hv : v ∈ S
  · refine ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hverts]
    exact Or.inl rfl
  · let c : (Sᶜ : Set V) := ⟨v, hv⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := e.surjective ((G.induce Sᶜ).connectedComponentMk c)
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    rw [hverts]
    right
    refine ⟨c, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [hs]
    exact ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_mem

end SimpleGraph




theorem SimpleGraph.existsFactorCriticalComponents {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    ∃ S : Set V, G.matchableToComponents S ∧
      ∀ C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, C.toSimpleGraph.IsFactorCritical := by

  obtain ⟨S, hmax, htie⟩ := SimpleGraph.existsMaximalOddDeficiency G
  refine ⟨S, ?_, SimpleGraph.factorCriticalComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie⟩

  exact SimpleGraph.matchableToComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax
    (SimpleGraph.oddComponentsOfMaximalOddDeficiency hmax htie)





theorem SimpleGraph.existsPerfectMatching_iff_card_eq {V : Type u} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (S : Set V) (hmatch : G.matchableToComponents S)
    (hcritical : ∀ C : (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent, C.toSimpleGraph.IsFactorCritical) :
    (∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching) ↔
      Nat.card S = Nat.card (G.induce Sᶜ).ConnectedComponent := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (G.matchableToComponents_iff_exists_embedding S).mp hmatch
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, hM⟩

    exact Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f f.injective)
      (SimpleGraph.card_components_le_of_isPerfectMatching hM
        (fun C ↦ (hcritical C).noPerfectMatching))
  · intro hcard

    have hbij : Function.Bijective f :=
      (Nat.bijective_iff_injective_and_card f).mpr ⟨f.injective, hcard⟩
    exact SimpleGraph.existsPerfectMatchingOfComponentEquiv (Equiv.ofBijective f hbij) hf
      (fun C ↦ (hcritical C).delete_hasPerfectMatching)

theorem continuous_iff_exists_open_image_subset {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ (a : X) (U : Set Y), IsOpen U → f a ∈ U →
      ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ a ∈ V ∧ f '' V ⊆ U := by
  constructor
  · intro hf a U hU ha

    exact ⟨f ⁻¹' U, hU.preimage hf, ha, Set.image_preimage_subset f U⟩
  · intro h

    refine continuous_def.mpr ?_
    intro U hU
    refine isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr ?_
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨V, hV, haV, hVU⟩ := h a U hU ha
    exact mem_nhds_iff.mpr ⟨V, Set.image_subset_iff.mp hVU, hV, haV⟩

def domain {H : Type u} (f : H → EReal) : Set H := {x | f x ≠ ⊤}


theorem mem_domain {H : Type u} (f : H → EReal) (x : H) :
    x ∈ domain f ↔ f x ≠ ⊤ := Iff.rfl


def IsProper {H : Type u} (f : H → EReal) : Prop :=
  (domain f).Nonempty ∧ ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥


theorem isProper_iff {H : Type u} (f : H → EReal) :
    IsProper f ↔ (domain f).Nonempty ∧ ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥ := Iff.rfl


def subdifferential {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (f : H → EReal) (x : H) : Set H :=
  {u | ∀ y, f x + (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y}


theorem mem_subdifferential_iff {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (f : H → EReal) (x u : H) :
    u ∈ subdifferential f x ↔ ∀ y, f x + (⟪y - x, u⟫_ℝ : EReal) ≤ f y := Iff.rfl

end Subdifferential
